Abstract: Enterprise AI agent skills evolve as tool APIs, models, and specifications change, yet final-output evaluation can miss process-level behavioral drift. We present a continuous evaluation framework combining outcome-level and process-level checks, applied to Revenue and Productivity variants of a Business Value Determination skill in an enterprise Value Aware Resiliency system. The framework independently computes per-run ground truth, materializes reusable template tests, and evaluates tool selection, arguments, execution order, and database integrity through programmatic checks and a narrowly scoped LLM judge. We evaluate 240 trials across two skills, two specification variants, two agent harnesses, and three models. Of 175 trials passing all applicable final numerical checks, 162 (92.6 percent; Wilson 95 percent CI: 87.7-95.6 percent) contained another evaluator-detected deviation. Under a broader seven-check final-state definition, 151 of 164 passing runs (92.1 percent; 95 percent CI: 86.9-95.3 percent) still violated a trajectory check. Dependency attribution reduced a mean of 6.34 failed checks per run to 2.65 roots. Specification sensitivity varied by model and harness, with exploratory bootstrap interaction intervals excluding zero for all three Revenue comparisons and one of three Productivity comparisons. Runtime-resolved templates provided reusable regression coverage across the evaluated configurations; longitudinal validation under actual API evolution remains future work.

</details>


### [246] [Code Owns the Simulation, Jev Owns the Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01834)
*Yaodong Yang,Hongyao Tang,Yi Ma,Xingyu Fan,Weixun Wang,Jinpeng Li,Tianpei Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文测试JEV类判断模型的能力边界，发现其擅长"评估"（从输入描述中判断正确选项）但在"模拟"（预测输入外信息）上失败；将模拟交给代码后，JEV可成为专家级控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 判断模型单次调用即返回各选项概率且无需推理文本，适合作为智能体的动作选择层，但尚不清楚哪些决策可以信任它们。

Method: 在反事实反思测试、单次矩阵博弈、文本游戏ALFWorld和机器人控制上测试JEV模型，并对比"直接判断"与"代码提供模拟/预测"两种设置。

Result: JEV能解99%的反直觉认知反思测试题；但在博弈中把理性对手当作随机行动，在ALFWorld中偏好提及任务描述中物体/地点的命令（如不洗刀直接放入抽屉）。这些失败并非知识缺乏——单独询问对手行动时它通常答对；问题在于单次调用同时完成模拟与评估。由代码提供前瞻或物理模拟后，JEV成为专家级控制器。

Conclusion: JEV能力存在清晰边界：评估成功、模拟失败。实际应用应让代码负责预测/模拟，JEV负责评估。

Abstract: Judgment models such as \jev{} return, in a single call and without reasoning text, a probability for each described option. This makes them attractive as an agent's action-selection layer, but it is unclear which decisions they can be trusted with. We test \jev{} on reflection tests, one-shot matrix games, the text game ALFWorld and robot control, and find a sharp boundary. \jev{} succeeds when the right option can be judged from what the input describes, which we call \emph{evaluation}. Specifically, it solves 99\% of the counterintuitive Cognitive Reflection Test questions. However, it fails when the right option depends on \emph{simulation} (i.e., predicting something not in the input), such as the opponent's action or the subgoal that must come first. In games, \jev{} plays suboptimally as if its rational opponent acted at random, because the opponent's action is not given. In ALFWorld, \jev{} favors commands that mention an object or place named in the task description. For example, given the task ``put a clean knife in the drawer'', \jev{} carries an unwashed knife straight to the drawer instead of first washing it at the sink. Surprisingly, many of these failures are not due to a lack of knowledge. Asked separately what the opponent will do, \jev{} usually answers correctly, and it responds well given the opponent's action. It fails when one call must both perform the simulation and evaluate based on it. This suggests letting code make the prediction or simulation. When code supplies it, such as a lookahead in ALFWorld and physics simulation in robot control, \jev{} becomes an expert controller through its general evaluation ability.

</details>


### [247] [On the Divergence of Accuracy and Mechanism Consistency in Time Series World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01842)
*Haochen Zhang,Jiaheng Guo,Zhen Xu,Zachary Plotkin,Nicholas Konz,Zhen Tan,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文形式化并基准测试了时间序列世界模型（TSWM），指出低预测误差与机制一致性会分离，并给出提升准确性与一致性的设计配方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前TSWM以动作作为协变量训练，仅在已执行计划下评估预测误差，却未检验其对未经执行的、变化后的计划的响应是否与真实系统一致。作者质疑哪些设计选择重要，以及准确预测器是否真的能像真实系统一样响应计划变化。

Method: 提出形式化框架，分离状态、动作与外生输入，区分连续、模式与事件动作，并引入机制一致性指标（基于已知方向的声明性动作-状态关系，如升压药升高血压）。构建基准，整合八个真实动作的公开数据集（工程基础设施与临床护理），在七种骨干网络和五个随机种子上变化预测空间、计划融合与计划编码。

Result: 冻结的隐空间预测空间相比观测空间平均降低MAE 9.9%，门控输出融合相比输入拼接平均降低12.7%，二者在全部八个数据集上均改善；时间计划编码对平均MAE影响至多2.2%。预测误差与机制一致性出现分离：误差最低的配置在五个有声明机制数据集中的四个上一致性处于或低于随机水平，且无任何设计选择可避免。方向性监督（惩罚对偏移动作响应中符号错误部分的损失）在MAE不变的情况下显著提高被惩罚机制的一致性。

Conclusion: 为TSWM提供配方：采用冻结隐空间与输出侧融合以提升准确性，并引入训练目标以保障机制一致性。

Abstract: A time series world model (TSWM) predicts a controlled system's state from its observed history and planned actions and exogenous inputs. Current approaches build forecasters with actions as covariates, trained and evaluated on prediction error under the executed plan. Yet world models compare unexecuted plans, but their responses to changed plans remain untested. We ask which design choices matter and whether accurate forecasters respond to changed plans as real systems do. We address both with a formalization and benchmark. The formalization separates state, actions and exogenous inputs, distinguishes continuous, mode and event actions, and introduces mechanism consistency, a metric built on declared action-state relations with known directions, such as a vasopressor raising blood pressure: it checks whether shifting an action moves the forecast in the declared direction. The benchmark consolidates eight public datasets with real actions from engineered infrastructure and clinical care, varying prediction space, plan fusion and plan encoding across seven backbones and five seeds. First, a frozen latent prediction space lowers MAE by 9.9% over observation space and gated output fusion lowers it by 12.7% over input concatenation on average, with both improving all eight datasets; temporal plan encoding changes average MAE by at most 2.2%. Second, prediction error and mechanism consistency diverge: the lowest-error configuration is at or below chance in consistency on four of five datasets with declared mechanisms, and no design choice avoids this. Finally, directional supervision, a loss penalizing the wrong-signed part of the response to a shifted action, significantly raises consistency on penalized mechanisms with no change in MAE. Together they give TSWMs a recipe: a frozen latent space and output-side fusion for accuracy, and a training objective for mechanism consistency.

</details>


### [248] [Temporal-Difference Learning for Dragonchess](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01845)
*Jim O'Connor,Annika Hoag,Sarah Goyette,Gary B. Parker*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在三维国际象棋Dragonchess中研究了两种自适应AI方法（进化迁移学习与TD(lambda)），通过将PyGame引擎改写为C++提升效率，进行10000局比赛。两种方法均优于其他智能体，且相互无显著差异，证明了自适应方法在结构复杂新游戏领域的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Dragonchess具有独特的棋盘结构和较高计算负载，是研究自适应方法在新环境中更新评估启发式的理想场景。

Method: 将Dragonchess引擎从PyGame重写为C++以加速对局；采用进化迁移学习与TD(lambda)两种自适应方法，并与多种智能体进行循环赛，引入置信区间和显著性检验。

Result: 两种自适应方法均击败所有其他智能体；进化评估与学习评估之间无显著性能差异。

Conclusion: 自适应方法在结构复杂、新颖的游戏领域中具有良好有效性。

Abstract: Our research investigates how two adaptive AI methods, evolutionary transfer learning and TD(lambda), perform in the three-dimensional chess environment Dragonchess. The game challenges players with its unique board structure and computational load, making it an ideal setting to study how adaptive methods can update evaluation heuristics in novel environments. In this work we re-implement the Dragonchess engine, changing it from a PyGame engine to C++. This enables faster gameplay, allowing us to run 10,000 games with confidence intervals and significance tests, rather than a single small tournament. Both adaptive methods outperform all other agents in the round-robin tournament. Our results showed that there is no significant difference in the performance between the evolved and learned evaluations. This research establishes the efficacy of adaptive methods in structurally complex, novel game domains.

</details>


### [249] [AVSD-Scenes: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Description of Urban Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01861)
*Dhanunjaya Varma Devalraju,Arshdeep Singh,Mark D. Plumbley*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 AVSD-Scenes，一个面向城市场景的配对音视频场景描述数据集，含 12,291 条描述，并验证多模态描述在语义对齐、检索和分类等任务上的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言可提供丰富的音视频城市场景语义表示，但联合描述听觉与视觉信息的数据集仍然稀缺。

Method: 基于 TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes 数据集构建：先用 Qwen2-Audio-7B 和 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 分别生成音频与视觉描述，再用 Qwen3-14B、Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506 和 Gemma-3-27B-it 融合为多模态描述。

Result: 通过语义对齐、跨模态检索、场景分类、LLM-as-a-judge 和人工主观评估进行基准测试。多模态描述优于单模态描述；城市场景分类准确率达 94.5%，融合音频、视觉和描述嵌入后升至 95.4%；去掉标签提示后描述仍具强区分性。

Conclusion: 多模态描述能提升语义对齐与跨模态检索性能并保留场景判别力，其语义来自音视频内容本身而非标签信息。

Abstract: Natural language descriptions can provide rich semantic representations of audio-visual urban scenes, yet datasets that jointly describe both auditory and visual information remain limited. In this paper, we introduce AVSD-Scenes, a paired audio-visual scene description dataset for urban environments. The dataset contains 12,291 audio-visual scene descriptions generated from the TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes dataset. To construct the dataset, we first generate audio- and visual-based descriptions using Qwen2-Audio-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, respectively. These modality-specific descriptions are then combined using large language models, namely Qwen3-14B, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506, and Gemma-3-27B-it, to produce multimodal descriptions that capture complementary information from both modalities. We benchmark AVSD-Scenes using semantic alignment, cross-modal retrieval, scene classification, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and human subjective assessment. Results show that multimodal descriptions improve semantic alignment and cross-modal retrieval performance compared with modality-specific descriptions while preserving strong scene-discriminative information. The generated descriptions achieve up to 94.5% accuracy in urban scene classification, while combining audio, visual, and description embeddings further improves accuracy to 95.4%. Furthermore, the descriptions remain highly scene-discriminative even when scene labels are removed from the prompting instructions, indicating that they capture semantic information derived from the audio-visual content rather than merely reflecting label information.

</details>


### [250] [Mapping the RAG Landscape: A Four Axis Taxonomy of Efficiency, Defense, Interactivity, and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01936)
*Meghana Sunil,Shravya V,Shravan Venkatraman,Joe Dhanith PR*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇RAG（检索增强生成）综述，提出四轴分类法（检索效率、鲁棒性与安全、用户驱动交互流程、多步复杂推理），系统梳理当代RAG发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM受限于静态参数化知识和幻觉问题，RAG通过引入外部检索缓解，但已有综述多聚焦核心架构与标准流程，未覆盖近期更广泛的挑战与能力。

Method: 综述形式：形式化RAG框架关键组件，按四轴分类法组织文献，涵盖稠密/稀疏检索、融合策略、嵌入优化、基于强化学习的检索策略，并整理评测实践、领域应用及Naive/Advanced/Modular等架构变体。

Result: 综合呈现当代RAG进展，揭示这些技术如何影响实际部署与系统设计，并归纳各类架构变体与评估方法。

Conclusion: 指出检索质量、可靠性、领域适配、可扩展性与可解释性等持续挑战，并提出构建更可靠、可适应、透明RAG系统的机会方向。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable fluency across many tasks but remain limited by their static, parameter bound knowledge and their susceptibility to hallucinating information. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses these issues by incorporating external retrieval into the generation process, grounding model outputs in verifiable and up to date sources. While prior surveys primarily focus on core RAG architectures and standard pipelines, recent research explores broader challenges and capabilities that extend beyond these foundational designs. This survey provides a consolidated and structured examination of contemporary RAG developments, organizing the field into a four axis taxonomy: improving retrieval efficiency, strengthening robustness and security, supporting user driven and interactive workflows, and enabling multi step or complex reasoning. We formalize key components of the RAG framework and review methods spanning dense and sparse retrieval, fusion strategies, embedding optimizations, and reinforcement learning based retrieval policies, highlighting how these advances influence practical deployment and system design. We also synthesize evaluation practices, domain specific applications, and architectural variants such as Naive, Advanced, and Modular RAG. Finally, we outline persistent challenges related to retrieval quality, reliability, domain adaptation, scalability, and explainability, and identify opportunities for building RAG systems that are more reliable, adaptable, and transparent.

</details>


### [251] [Counterfactual Auditing of Bias in Open-Source Large Language Models for Clinical Triage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01963)
*Manar Aljohani,Brandon Ho,Kenneth McKinley,Dennis Ren,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对10个开源大语言模型进行反事实审计，评估其在儿科ESI分诊预测中对人口学、社会经济等非临床变量的敏感性，发现反事实偏见不随模型规模或医学预训练而一致降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 急诊分诊是高风险的优先级任务，人口学、社会经济和系统背景信息可能不当影响分诊级别判定。开源LLM被越来越多用于隐私保护的本地临床决策支持，但其反事实偏见在不同模型家族、规模、医学领域模型间的差异尚不清楚。

Method: 基于真实和手册式临床情景，构建仅改变一个非临床变量（人口学、社会经济、医疗可及性、行为、社会或系统背景）而保持临床表现不变的配对反事实样本，对10个开源LLM（Qwen2.5-7B/14B、QLoRA微调版、MedGemma、MedLLaMA2-7B、GPT-OSS-20B/120B等）进行儿科ESI预测比较审计，测量任何反事实偏移、分诊不足、过度分诊、超过一级的偏移、平均偏移和平均绝对偏移。

Result: 反事实敏感性差异显著，且并未随模型规模增大或医学领域预训练而一致降低。微调Qwen2.5-7B敏感度最低（任何偏移率5.27%，平均绝对偏移0.0534），而基座模型为16.02%和0.1706。若干更大或医学领域模型偏移更明显。分层和相关性分析揭示了聚合率掩盖的临床重要方向性和共有失败模式。

Conclusion: 反事实审计是一种轻量、临床可解释的框架，可在临床部署前比较开源LLM的公平性风险。

Abstract: Emergency department (ED) triage is a high-stakes prioritization task in which demographic, socioeconomic, and system-context information may improperly influence acuity assignment. Although open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for local and privacy-preserving clinical decision support, it remains unclear how counterfactual bias varies across model families, sizes, medical-domain models, and domain-adapted models. We present a comparative counterfactual audit of ten open-source LLMs for pediatric Emergency Severity Index (ESI) prediction. Starting from real and handbook-style clinical vignettes, we construct paired counterfactual variants that change only one injected demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, or system-context variable while holding the clinical presentation fixed. Models include Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, a QLoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, MedGemma variants, MedLLaMA2-7B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B. We measure any counterfactual shift, undertriage, overtriage, shifts greater than one ESI level, mean shift, and mean absolute shift. Counterfactual sensitivity varied substantially and did not consistently decrease with larger model size or medical-domain pretraining. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B showed the lowest overall sensitivity, with a 5.27% any-shift rate and mean absolute shift of 0.0534, versus 16.02% and 0.1706 for the base model. Several larger or medical-domain models showed more significant shifts. Stratified and correlation analyses further revealed clinically important directionality and shared failure patterns hidden by aggregate rates. These findings support counterfactual auditing as a lightweight, clinically interpretable framework for comparing fairness risks in open-source LLMs before clinical deployment.

</details>


### [252] [Can AI Oversight Be Zero Knowledge?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01995)
*Alessandro Chiesa,Ziyi Guan,Burcu Yildiz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究oracle辅助计算的AI输出验证中的隐私问题，证明一般情形下无法实现零知识交互论证，但在oracle对答案签名时可实现高效的零知识验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统常基于机密数据产生输出（如基于医疗记录的适岗评估、基于秘密结构的药物性质预测），需要在不泄露底层数据的前提下验证输出正确性。已有工作聚焦于比计算快得多的验证器，但这种高效验证对一般oracle辅助计算不可能，故依赖额外假设；本文转向隐私角度，允许验证器运行时间为计算的多项式级别，探讨能否实现零知识。

Method: 采用交互论证（interactive arguments）与辩论（debate）模型，研究oracle辅助计算的零知识性质。负面结果在随机预言机模型下给出不可能性证明；正面结果引入oracle对每个答案附加密码学签名的假设，基于抗碰撞哈希函数构造零知识验证协议。

Result: 负面：在随机预言机模型中，不存在适用于所有oracle辅助计算的零知识证明，即使证明者和验证者可运行远长于计算本身；该不可能性也扩展到辩论模型。正面：若oracle对每个答案附加密码学签名，则每个oracle辅助计算都可在仅假设抗碰撞哈希函数下以零知识方式验证，且证明者与验证者高效。

Conclusion: 一般oracle辅助计算无法零知识验证，但签名oracle可恢复零知识性。除隐私外，该方案还提供了一种可扩展监督的新途径，既不依赖辩论中的诚实对手，也不依赖先前单证明者协议的鲁棒性。

Abstract: AI systems increasingly produce outputs from confidential data, such as a fitness-for-duty assessment from medical records or the predicted properties of a drug candidate from its secret structure. It is important to verify that such outputs are correct without revealing the underlying data. A recent line of work studies verification of AI outputs via interactive proofs and debate for oracle-aided computation, where correctness may depend on an oracle such as human judgment, a physical experiment, or the web. These works focus on verification by a verifier that runs much faster than the computation. However, such efficient verification is impossible for general oracle-aided computation, and these works therefore rely on additional assumptions. We focus instead on privacy: allowing the verifier to run in time polynomial in the computation, we ask whether interactive arguments for oracle-aided computation can be zero knowledge, so that the verifier learns nothing about the confidential data beyond the correctness of the output.
  We prove that, in general, they cannot. In the random oracle model, there are no zero-knowledge proofs for all oracle-aided computations, even if both the prover and the verifier are allowed to run much longer than the computation itself. The impossibility extends to debate, a canonical model for scalable oversight.
  On the positive side, we show that if the oracle attaches a cryptographic signature to each of its answers, then every oracle-aided computation can be verified in zero knowledge with an efficient prover and verifier, assuming only collision-resistant hash functions. Beyond privacy, this also gives an alternative approach to scalable oversight that relies neither on an honest opponent, as in debate, nor on the robustness of the computation, as in prior single-prover protocols.

</details>


### [253] [Mingbird: A Local-First Agent Harness Enabling Small Open Models to Complete Real Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02001)
*Hao Wang,Ting Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 小模型(2-9B)在云端agent框架下任务完成率低，作者提出本地优先的harness Mingbird，用十种机制针对性补偿，在LRAB上0.886大幅超过其他harness。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小开放权重模型(2-9B)能在普通笔记本运行，但在云规模agent harness下很少完成真实任务：工具prefill溢出上下文、自纠偏发散、工具演示循环、任务被静默放弃。作者认为这些失败很大部分源于harness而非模型本身。

Method: 提出Mingbird——面向Windows和Ollama的本地优先agent harness，含十种针对小模型失败形式的补偿机制，如字节级净零prefill预算、接受完成前重读任务的finish gate、签名级循环检测。在LRAB上做受控比较(固定机器、模型、预算、评分；4 harness × 4开放模型(2B-35B) × 18真实任务，确定性artifact评分)；在τ²-bench(278任务)测试；并做前端模型探针和leave-one-mechanism-out消融。

Result: LRAB上Mingbird总体0.886，对比goose 0.631、opencode 0.479、agent-mini 0.405，288个单元全部公开；τ²-bench上0.856对比0.791和0.737；前端模型探针在18任务上跨harness为0.997到0.478，良好脚手架间差距在0.072内。消融仅作方向性参考：同夜复现均值波动达0.069，批次匹配比较给出可执行完成守卫配对+0.10。

Conclusion: 大量失败可归因于harness而非模型，Mingbird机制有效提升小模型任务完成率。证据存在局限：自建基准、单机、单次试验评分。

Abstract: Small open-weight models (2-9B) run on ordinary laptops, but under cloud-scale agent harnesses they rarely complete real tasks: tool prefill overflows the context, self-correction diverges, tool demonstrations loop, and tasks are silently abandoned. We present evidence, from a controlled single-machine comparison and one third-party benchmark, that a substantial share of these failures is attributable to the harness rather than the model. We introduce Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Windows and Ollama whose ten mechanisms compensate point-by-point for small-model failure forms, three of them representative: a byte-level net-zero prefill budget, a finish gate that re-reads the task before accepting completion, and signature-level loop detection. On LRAB, a controlled comparison holding machine, models, budgets, and scoring fixed (4 harnesses $\times$ 4 open models (2B-35B) $\times$ 18 real tasks, deterministic artifact scoring), Mingbird reaches 0.886 overall against 0.631 (goose), 0.479 (opencode), and 0.405 (agent-mini), with all 288 cells published; on $τ^2$-bench (278 tasks, three arms, one protocol) it totals 0.856 against 0.791 and 0.737; and a frontier-model probe on the same 18 tasks spans 0.997 to 0.478 across harnesses, with well-formed scaffolds staying within 0.072 of each other. A leave-one-mechanism-out ablation is reported as directional only: same-night replications of the same arm move its mean by up to 0.069, the size of every nominal single-trial delta, and the one batch-matched comparison (full mechanism stack versus text re-read alone) gives the executable completion guards a paired +0.10 across three replications. The evidence carries stated limits: a self-built benchmark, a single machine, and single-trial scoring.

</details>


### [254] [Counting Moves, Weighing Voices: Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation for Calibrated Multi-LLM Councils under Persistent Adversaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02005)
*Ionel Eduard Stan,Paolo Napoletano*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出贝叶斯辩证论证（BDA），将多LLM议会的辩论轨迹建模为带每智能体可靠性的标注者模型，从而同时实现校准的置信度估计与对持续不可靠智能体的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多LLM议会系统需要置信度代表"答对的概率"（校准），并在部分智能体持续不可靠时保持稳健。现有聚合方法两方面均失败：置信度衡量的是"决断性"而非正确性，且无法识别或折扣持续不可靠的智能体。

Method: BDA将议会中的类型化动作（谁提出、质疑、让步了哪个答案）视为对经典标注者模型的观测，为每个智能体引入可靠性参数。这样把多智能体审议重构为可靠性估计问题，利用审议轨迹推断智能体可靠性；再按推断可靠性加权证据，得到候选答案的后验概率，使持续不可靠的智能体可被"反转"而非仅被投票压制。

Result: 在二分类与多分类基准上，BDA在零成本议会聚合方法中取得最佳校准，且无需额外LLM调用；在持续对抗联盟下鲁棒性提升，在干净场景中仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: 将多智能体审议视为可靠性估计问题，能同时带来校准良好的置信度与对抗持续不可靠者的鲁棒性，且不增加推理成本。

Abstract: A multi-LLM \emph{council} lets several large language models (LLMs) deliberate on a question and return an answer together with a confidence estimate. As these systems become increasingly used for reasoning, that confidence should represent a calibrated \emph{probability of being correct}, and the decision should remain robust when some agents are persistently unreliable. Existing \emph{council aggregation} methods fail on both fronts: their confidence estimates measure decisiveness rather than correctness, and they cannot identify or discount persistently unreliable agents. We introduce Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation (BDA), which treats the council's \emph{typed} moves---who proposed, challenged, or conceded which answer---as observations of a classical annotator model with \emph{per-agent} reliabilities. This formulation recasts multi-agent deliberation as a reliability estimation problem, using the deliberation trace to infer agent reliability under persistent adversarial behavior. By weighting evidence according to inferred agent reliability, BDA yields calibrated posterior probabilities over candidate answers while allowing persistently unreliable agents to be inverted rather than merely outvoted. Across binary and multi-class benchmarks, BDA achieves the best calibration among zero-cost council aggregation methods, requiring no additional LLM calls, and improves robustness under persistent adversarial coalitions while remaining competitive in clean settings.

</details>


### [255] [Atoms to Processes: The Role of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Chemical Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02014)
*Michael Baldea,Linda J. Broadbelt,Marianthi G. Ierapetritou,Akhilesh Jain,Ankur Kumar,Thomas A. Kwan,Fèlix Llovell,Andrew J. Medford,Ilias Mitrai,Joel Paulson,Junyi Qiao,Matthew P. Rivera,Kirti C. Sahu,Lev Sarkisov,Zachary P. Smith,Calvin Tsay,Ching-Mei Wen,Victor M. Zavala,Huacheng Zhang,Dan Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AI/ML正深刻改变化学工程问题的建模与求解方式，趋势是从纯黑箱转向融合第一性原理的混合物理信息框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI/ML与算力、数据、算法的成熟为化学工程各尺度应用带来机遇，但预测精度、数据稀缺、外推能力、可解释性和模型生命周期管理等挑战亟待解决。

Method: 这是一篇观点性文章，综述AI/ML在原子尺度模拟、材料与催化剂发现、传递与热力学、分离、过程系统工程及工业运行中的方法进展与代表性应用，重点分析AI/ML与第一性原理模型的融合方式。

Result: 各领域呈现统一趋势：由纯黑箱方法转向显式遵守守恒定律、热力学一致性和结构约束的混合及物理信息框架，从而提升鲁棒性与可靠性，并支持有效的人机协作。

Conclusion: AI/ML并非取代化学工程核心原理，而是放大其作用；面向自主化、自适应与可持续系统，AI/ML与第一性原理及领域知识的审慎融合是实现其全部潜力的关键。

Abstract: The rapid maturation of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) has catalyzed a profound shift in how chemical engineering problems are formulated, analyzed, and solved. Advances in computing, data availability, and learning algorithms have enabled AI/ML methods to impact applications spanning atomic-scale simulations, materials and catalyst discovery, transport and thermodynamics, separations, process systems engineering, and industrial operations. This article provides a perspective on recent methodological developments and representative applications, emphasizing how AI/ML tools are being integrated with first-principles models to address challenges of predictive accuracy, data scarcity, extrapolation, interpretability, and model lifecycle management. Across domains, a unifying trend is the move away from purely black-box approaches toward hybrid and physics-informed frameworks that explicitly respect conservation laws, thermodynamic consistency, and known structural constraints. These approaches not only improve robustness and reliability, but also enable meaningful human-AI collaboration by providing information at an appropriate level of abstraction for the task and decision context. We conclude that AI and ML are not replacing the core principles of chemical engineering; rather, they are amplifying them. As the field advances toward increasingly autonomous, adaptive, and sustainable systems, the thoughtful integration of AI/ML with first-principles understanding and domain expertise will be essential to realizing their full potential across both research and industrial practice.

</details>


### [256] [SPHERE: Adaptive VR Indoor Scene Generation via LLM-Enhanced Spatial Preference Learning and Human-in-the-Loop RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02023)
*Hyeonmin Lee,Zheng Wei,Kyungmin Kwon,Jumin Seo,Jiwon Park,Hayoung Oh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SPHERE：将孤立3D场景合成转为连续人机共创的自适应VR生成框架，通过多模态交互提取持久空间偏好，实现几何鲁棒、符合用户画像的布局。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM驱动的3D室内场景合成管线无法跨会话保留用户特定偏好，导致沉浸式创作过程重复且令人身体疲劳。

Method: 从自然多模态交互（语音与手柄编辑）中提取持久空间偏好；将原始编辑抽象为层级约束，建模局部功能与全局拓扑上下文以保证几何鲁棒性；采用人在回路（human-in-the-loop）强化学习机制，依据用户最终编辑后的场景动态更新检索策略。

Result: 混合设计用户研究（N=42）与离线消融实验表明，SPHERE显著减少纠正性编辑与身体负荷，避免偏向浅层物体级特征，生成几何鲁棒且与用户画像对齐的布局。

Conclusion: 通过捕捉用户演示的空间逻辑实现可控的空间自适应，为沉浸式创作建立了可靠、可治理的人机协作框架。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) advance 3D indoor scene synthesis, current pipelines fail to retain user-specific preferences across sessions, making immersive authoring a repetitive and physically fatiguing process. We present SPHERE, an adaptive VR generation framework that transforms isolated synthesis into continuous human-AI co-creation. SPHERE extracts persistent spatial preferences from natural multimodal interactions (speech and controller edits). To ensure geometric resilience against spatial distortions, it abstracts these raw edits into hierarchical constraints modeling both local functional and global topological contexts. Furthermore, a human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning mechanism dynamically updates retrieval policies based on the user's final edited scenes. A mixed-design user study ($N=42$) and an offline ablation demonstrate that SPHERE significantly reduces corrective edits and physical demand, preventing bias toward shallow object-level traits to yield geometrically resilient, profile-aligned layouts. Ultimately, SPHERE demonstrates how capturing demonstrated spatial logic enables controlled spatial adaptation, establishing a reliable, governed human-AI collaboration framework for immersive authoring. Project page and source code will be available at: https://github.com/hyeonmin11/SPHERE

</details>


### [257] [Global Coherence: When Every Agent Is Right and the Team Is Still Wrong - A Local-to-Global Semantic Foundation for Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02036)
*Xin Heng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"全局一致性"问题：多个AI agent各自做出局部有效决策，却共同产生无效结果。作者通过"观察混叠不可能性定理"给出可保证有效行动的确切边界，并提出局部到全局的运行时语义框架X=(H,C,G,F;D)，由harness而非模型持有共享状态并管理提交。九项研究在多个基准上验证了缺失全局状态无法靠更强模型或更多推理来弥补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI agent常出现"每个局部决策都合理、但全局结果无效"的现象。作者认为这本质是共享状态缺失问题，而非模型智能不足，因此需要从理论上界定何时能够保证有效行动，并从系统工程上解决共享状态的归属问题。

Method: 1) 提出"观察混叠不可能性定理"：当所有产生相同观察的世界共享一个可允许动作时，政策才能保证有效动作；若k个不可区分世界需要两两不相交的动作，则最优随机最坏成功率为1/k，更多推理、角色、消息或样本都无济于事。2) 提出局部到全局运行时语义X=(H,C,G,F;D)：H记录重叠作用域拓扑，C规范改变状态的动作，G保留可逆变换群胚，F检验局部视图能否粘合成一个世界，D只保留改变合法未来的区分。3) 设计九个研究，覆盖受控修订基准、TeamBench和tau2-bench Telecom，对比模型自身与harness机制的表现。

Result: 受控修订基准中，同一前沿模型在决定事件可见时得40/40，隐藏时仅12–17/40（与1/3随机水平一致），恢复一个权威事实后回到40/40。TeamBench中普通团队5/5次超出共享预算，可见实时计数仍有4/5违规，而提交强制执行使违规降为0/5。tau2-bench Telecom中，静默回滚后当前状态检查仅得0.07，harness得1.00。当传统求解器已拥有完整相关状态时，其表现与harness持平，符合理论预测。

Conclusion: 局部智能无法替代缺失的全局状态。更强的模型只能在其上下文内推理得更好，却无法看到上下文之外；有效保证多agent全局一致性，需要由harness持有共享状态并管理提交，而可靠下限由观察混叠不可能性定理决定。

Abstract: AI agents can each make locally valid decisions yet jointly produce an invalid result. We call this the global coherence problem: a failure of shared state, not merely of model intelligence.
  Our Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem gives the exact boundary. A policy can guarantee a valid action exactly when all worlds producing the same observation share an admissible action. If k indistinguishable worlds require pairwise-disjoint actions, the best randomized worst-case success is 1/k; more reasoning, roles, messages, or samples cannot recover the missing distinction. A stronger model can reason better within its context, but it cannot see beyond it.
  We then give local-to-global runtime semantics X = (H, C, G, F; D): topology H records overlapping scopes; category C governs state-changing actions; groupoid G retains reversible translations; sheaf F tests whether local views glue into one world; and minimal history D keeps only distinctions that alter legal futures. Models propose; the harness owns shared state and governs commit.
  Nine studies test both the failure and its boundary. On a controlled revision benchmark, the same frontier model scores 40/40 when the deciding event is visible; when it is hidden, tested arms score 12--17/40, consistent with chance (1/3); restoring one authoritative fact returns 40/40. On TeamBench, ordinary teams exceed a shared budget in 5/5 runs, a visible live count leaves 4/5 violations, and commit enforcement leaves 0/5. In tau2-bench Telecom, current-state checks score 0.07 after silent reverts, while the harness scores 1.00. Where a conventional solver already owns the complete relevant state, it ties the harness as predicted. The counterintuitive conclusion is that local intelligence cannot substitute for missing global state.

</details>


### [258] [Mimir: Physics-Grounded LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Irrigation Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02038)
*Yimeng Liu,Mi Zhang,Younsuk Dong,Zhichao Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Mimir——一个物理落地的LLM智能体，通过快慢两个修复时间尺度应对长期物理控制（灌溉），在多个站点/作物/年份上取得最低控制成本，比历史调度少用约51%灌溉水。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体证据多来自回合制任务：反馈即时、失败可重置。而长期运行的物理控制处于不同机制：动作改变未来状态、误差在连续决策中累积、且智能体须从经验中改进但不能改写使执行安全的物理规则。论文以灌溉为切入点研究该机制——日常决策与整个生长季的土壤-水分动态相互作用。

Method: Mimir围绕两个修复时间尺度组织：快尺度上，结构化物理接口与确定性模拟器将LLM输出转为提案，经数值检查、修订并施加有界确定性动作选择后才执行；慢尺度上，将反复出现的失败模式固化为持久上下文原则以约束未来提案，而物理模型、评估器与执行约束保持不可变。

Result: 在跨多站点、作物、年份的统一回顾式评估器下，Mimir取得所评估参考中最低的汇总控制成本，且比历史调度回放少用约51%灌溉水。消融实验显示，移除前向模拟、验证性修订或持久上下文均使控制成本升高；模型规模与模型家族研究未显示随LLM增大而单调获益。

Conclusion: 持久性物理智能体可将语义推理与有界、证据驱动的自我改进相结合，同时把物理真理与执行器权限保留给显式数值机制。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly combine reasoning, tool use, and action, but most evidence comes from episodic tasks with relatively immediate feedback and reset failures. Long-running physical control operates in a different regime: actions alter future states, errors compound across decisions, and an agent must improve from experience without being allowed to rewrite the physical rules that make execution safe. We study this regime through irrigation, where daily decisions interact with soil-water dynamics over entire growing seasons. We present Mimir, a physics-grounded LLM agent organized around two repair timescales. At the fast timescale, a structured physical interface and deterministic simulator turn an LLM output into a proposal that we numerically check, revise, and subject to bounded deterministic action selection before execution. At the slow timescale, recurrent failure patterns are consolidated into persistent contextual principles that condition future proposals, while the physical model, evaluator, and execution constraints remain immutable. Under a common retrospective evaluator across multiple sites, crops, and years, Mimir attains the lowest reported aggregate control cost among the evaluated references and uses about 51% less irrigation than the historical schedule replay. The ablation study show higher control cost when forward simulation, verified revision, or persistent context is removed; model-scale and model-family studies show no monotonic gain from increasing LLM size. The resulting lesson show that persistent physical agents can combine semantic reasoning with bounded, evidence-driven self-improvement while reserving physical truth and actuator authority for explicit numerical mechanisms.

</details>


### [259] [HydroJEV: A one-second, training-free screen for cyber-attack and fault attribution in water distribution networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02048)
*Tianwei Mu,Shengyan Jiang,Mingzhe Yuan,Qing Luo,Min Xiao,Wenhong Wang,Jun Li,Manhong Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 测试免训练模型Jev作为SCADA告警原因归因的第一层筛选，能在约1秒内给出类别概率，接近规则树、超越监督分类器和云端LLM，并可减少约三分之一的复核负担。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水务SCADA告警需快速判断是网络攻击、物理故障、正常瞬变还是传感器故障，但监督分类器缺乏标注数据，前沿LLM每次决策耗时数十秒，因此需要快速、免训练的前置筛选方案。

Method: 基于EPANET中C-Town网络构建四类原因归因基准，在四轮密封预注册评估中，将Jev与人工规则树、监督分类器和七个云端LLM在相同证据下比较；仅加入无标签先验校正，并设计规则树确认的级联门控流程，再迁移到另外两个网络测试。

Result: Jev达到宏F1 0.62-0.64，与规则树（0.56-0.61）相当；在标注缺失的事件子类型上比监督分类器高0.36-0.42，每类标注少于约4个事件时均优于分类器；决策速度比前沿LLM快20-40倍；仅接受规则树确认的良性Jev判决可减少35-38%的LLM复核窗口且宏F1不降；迁移到两个新网络后在全部四个数据集上保持非劣于复核者。

Conclusion: 快速、免训练的筛选模型可承担SCADA异常分诊中约三分之一的复核负荷，同时保持刻意复核的准确率。

Abstract: When a SCADA alarm is raised in a water distribution network, operators must decide quickly whether it reflects a cyberattack, a physical fault, a normal transient or a faulty sensor. Supervised classifiers need labelled incidents that utilities rarely have, and frontier large language models (LLMs) take tens of seconds per decision. We tested whether Jev, a training-free model that returns class probabilities in about one second, can serve as the first tier of this triage. On a four-class cause-attribution benchmark built on the C-Town network in EPANET, Jev was compared with a hand-written rule tree, a supervised classifier and seven cloud LLMs on identical evidence in four sealed, pre-registered rounds. With only a label-free prior correction, Jev matched the rule tree (macro-F1 0.62-0.64 against 0.56-0.61 in distribution) and exceeded the supervised classifier by 0.36-0.42 on event subtypes absent from its labels, in all four rounds, and it outperformed the classifier whenever fewer than about four labelled events per class were available. Jev also decided 20-40 times faster than frontier LLMs. Accepting only benign Jev verdicts confirmed by the rule tree spared an LLM reviewer 35-38% of windows on fresh sealed sets without loss of macro-F1. Transferred unchanged to two further networks, this gated cascade stayed within the non-inferiority margin of its reviewer on all four sets. A fast, training-free screen can therefore take over about a third of the review load in SCADA anomaly triage while preserving the accuracy of deliberate review.

</details>


### [260] [External Observers May See More Clearly: Cross-Model Span-Level Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models via Hidden State Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02066)
*Kingshuk Gupta,Davide Buscaldi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于内部隐状态的分段级幻觉检测框架，可定位幻觉起点与延续token，并发现跨模型观察者能匹敌甚至超越生成模型的自我检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为推理引擎时幻觉问题严重，现有内部状态探针多将幻觉检测简化为token级二分类，无法捕捉语义漂移的结构化、序列化边界。

Method: 通过逐层激活模式分析LLM生成过程，实现细粒度span级幻觉检测，定位幻觉起始与延续token；并提出跨模型检测框架，由一个模型观察另一模型生成时激发的内部表示。在极度类别不平衡下进行实验。

Result: 成功分离幻觉起点，PR-AUC较随机基线有显著提升；外部观察者可匹配或超过生成模型对自身幻觉起点的自检测，即使观察者是更小的模型。

Conclusion: 自检测并非幻觉起点定位的上限，跨模型观察框架为更可靠的幻觉检测提供了新方向。

Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as foundational reasoning engines, their tendency to hallucinate remains a critical vulnerability. While recent internal state probes offer a promising alternative to slow external retrieval systems, they largely reduce hallucination detection to a token-wise binary classification task, failing to capture the structured, sequential boundaries of semantic drift. Here, we introduce an internal hidden state framework for fine-grained, span-level hallucination detection. By inspecting layer-wise activation patterns, we attempt to detect the exact hallucination onset and continuation tokens in an LLM generation. Our experiments show that this approach successfully isolates hallucination onsets, achieving substantial improvements in Precision-Recall AUC over random baselines despite extreme class imbalance. Ultimately, we propose a novel cross-model detection framework in which one model observes the internal representations elicited by another model's generation. We find that an external observer can match or exceed a generator's self-detection of its own hallucination onsets, including when the observer is the smaller model, suggesting that self-detection is not the ceiling for onset localisation.

</details>


### [261] [Causal Memory Policy: Making Memory Utility Identifiable by Intervening on Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02070)
*Arman Behnam,Binghui Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出因果记忆策略（CMP），通过针对检索本身进行干预来恢复记忆效用的可识别性，解决仅依赖已检索记忆的估计偏差问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆增强大语言模型通过估计记忆对任务性能的影响来决定保留哪些记忆，但这些估计完全依赖已检索到的记忆。当某条记忆从未被检索时，存储层干预产生相同结果，其效用无法被识别，这是一种"检索层正性违背"，且对仅检查记忆操作的诊断方法不可见。

Method: CMP通过干预检索过程恢复识别：为具有已知倾向性采样的记忆保留固定数量的上下文槽位，并采用平衡分配设计下的自归一化逆倾向加权（IPW）估计记忆效用。理论上证明了记忆效用经检索的因果分解、估计量的无偏性与精确方差，以及不可逆操作下的最优决策规则。

Result: 实验中，识别失败率在LongMemEval上达54%、LoCoMo上达67%，且在已部署的记忆系统中同样存在。CMP将必需记忆与非必需记忆的区分能力从0.54 AUC提升至0.66 AUC。此外发现，单靠已识别的记忆效用不足以支持保留决策：逐查询效用在其估计所针对的查询上达0.78 AUC，但保留策略可用的任何聚合方式都无法预测记忆在未见查询上的价值。

Conclusion: 仅依赖已检索记忆的效用估计存在检索层正性违背，CMP可通过干预检索恢复可识别性并提升记忆判别能力，但记忆效用的识别本身对保留决策仍不充分，需进一步解决跨查询泛化问题。

Abstract: Memory-augmented large language models must decide which memories to retain, and recent systems do so by estimating each memory's effect on task performance. However, these estimates rely entirely on retrieved memories. When a memory is never retrieved, store-level interventions produce identical outcomes, leaving its utility unidentified. This is a retrieval-level positivity violation, invisible to diagnostics that examine only memory operations. We introduce Causal Memory Policy (CMP), a causal framework that restores identification by intervening on retrieval itself, reserving a fixed number of context slots for memories sampled with known propensities. CMP estimates memory utility by self-normalized inverse propensity weighting under a balanced assignment design. We prove the causal factorization of memory utility through retrieval, the unbiasedness and exact variance of the estimator, and the optimal decision rule under irreversible operations. Empirically, identification fails for 54% of required memories on LongMemEval and 67% on LoCoMo, and the failure persists in a deployed memory system. CMP improves discrimination between required and non-required memories from 0.54 to 0.66 AUC. Finally, we show that identified memory utility alone is insufficient for retention decisions: per-query utility reaches 0.78 AUC on the query for which it is estimated, yet no aggregation available to a retention policy predicts a memory's value on unseen queries. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cmp-release-D0C3/.

</details>


### [262] [PyPottery: an AI-powered end-to-end suite for pottery processing and publication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02072)
*Lorenzo Cardarelli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍PyPottery，一个开源的AI驱动工具套件，通过四个集成模块半自动化陶器文档记录流程，在意大利Montale遗址数据上实现中位数40倍的感知提速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 陶器研究是考古学基石，但陶器文档记录的产后工作流程劳动密集，造成严重的出版瓶颈，亟需自动化工具支持。

Method: PyPottery包含四个集成模块：PyPotteryScan（图像提取与手写识别）、PyPotteryInk（铅笔图自动上墨）、PyPotteryTrace（语义感知矢量化）、PyPotteryLayout（自动布局生成）。在Terramara di Montale（意大利）的50张手绘页、240幅陶器图上进行评估。

Result: 可用性研究参与者报告相比传统流程中位数感知提速40倍（范围17.5–120倍），验证了显著的时间节省。

Conclusion: AI辅助工具在考古文档记录中具有巨大潜力，本文主张将认知劳动战略性地重新分配至“增强”而非“替代”。

Abstract: The study of ceramic materials constitutes a cornerstone of archaeological research, yet the post-production workflow for pottery documentation remains labor-intensive and creates significant publication bottlenecks. This paper presents PyPottery, an open-source, AI-powered suite designed to semi-automate the complete ceramic documentation pipeline. The suite comprises four integrated modules: PyPotteryScan for automated image extraction and handwriting recognition; PyPotteryInk for automatic inking of pencil drawings; PyPotteryTrace for semantically-aware vectorization; and PyPotteryLayout for automated layout generation. Evaluated on 50 hand-drawn sheets containing 240 pottery drawings from the Terramara di Montale (Italy), the framework achieved substantial time savings confirmed by usability study participants, who reported a median perceived speedup of 40$\times$ over traditional workflows (range: 17.5$\times$--120$\times$). These results highlight the potential of AI-assisted tools in archaeological documentation, while the paper addresses the strategic redistribution of cognitive labor toward augmentation rather than automation.

</details>


### [263] [Homomorphic Advantage Operator: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning Under Fully Homomorphic Encryption Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02074)
*Abid Mohamed Nadhir,Ahmad Al Hanbali,Beggas Mounir*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO)，通过将零均值中心化投影应用于TD目标，抑制FHE深度RL中的多项式近似发散（Bellman drift），在无需额外非线性开销下稳定训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FHE为云端隐私保护计算提供方案，但用于RL时需用多项式近似替代非线性操作，会因递归误差现象"Bellman drift"导致灾难性发散。

Method: HAO将advantage-based value estimation中的零均值中心化投影直接应用于时序差分(TD)目标，这一线性投影消除驱动Bellman drift的均匀状态价值baseline，同时保持每状态动作排序，且不增加非线性乘法深度、无需昂贵的密文bootstrapping。

Result: 采用三层实验（表格MDP、真实CKKS加密CartPole、20节点物流路由基准）：HAO严格将网络预激活限制在安全多项式近似域内，所有随机种子0%越界；仅正则化(L2+梯度裁剪)在3/5种子越界，未稳定基线83.8%情节越界。HAO在表格域提升最优策略准确率18.0个百分点，且在DP-SGD式高斯噪声下保持稳定。

Conclusion: HAO是一种有效防止FHE-based深度RL多项式近似发散的稳定化框架，能严格约束预激活范围、提升策略准确性并兼容差分隐私噪声，且计算开销低。

Abstract: Privacy-preserving machine learning presents significant deployment challenges on the cloud for intelligent systems with confidential data. Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) offers a compelling solution for secure computation, preserving data confidentiality of cloud computations. However, applying FHE to reinforcement learning (RL) requires replacing non-linear operations with polynomial approximations, which diverge catastrophically due to a unique recursive error phenomenon known as the Bellman drift. This article introduces the Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO), a stabilization framework designed to prevent polynomial approximation divergence in FHE-based deep RL. HAO adapts the zero-mean centering projection from advantage-based value estimation directly to temporal-difference (TD) targets. This linear projection annihilates the uniform state-value baseline that drives the Bellman drift, maintaining per-state action rankings while requiring zero additional non-linear multiplicative depth and avoiding expensive ciphertext bootstrapping. The proposed HAO framework was evaluated using a three-tier experimental methodology, including a tabular Markov Decision Process (MDP), an encrypted CartPole environment using real CKKS cryptographic operations, and a 20-node logistics routing benchmark with dense continuous features. The results demonstrate that the proposed HAO strictly bounds network pre-activations within the safe polynomial approximation domain. The proposed HAO RL agents achieved 0% boundary breaches across all random seeds used, whereas regularization alone (L2 weight decay and gradient clipping) breached the bound on 3 of 5 seeds and the unstabilized baseline did so in 83.8% of episodes. Finally, HAO agents improve optimal policy accuracy by 18.0 percentage points in tabular domains and remain stable when DP-SGD-style Gaussian noise is added to the clipped gradients.

</details>


### [264] [A Comparative Explainability Framework for DeBERTa-v3 in Zero-Shot Medical Abstract Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02116)
*Javier Diaz Esteban-Herreros,David Muñoz-Valero,Raquel Martínez-España,Jose M. Juarez,Juan Moreno-Garcia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释性比较框架，用五种归因方法审计DeBERTa-v3在医学摘要零样本分类中的表现，发现解释稳定性与预测确定性高度一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决可解释AI中的"分歧问题"：不同归因方法对同一输入和预测给出不一致的解释，这一现象在医学文本分类审计中尤为关键。

Method: 基于医学摘要语料库构建自然语言推理引擎，每个诊断类别配五个丰富假设，每类平衡采样1000篇文本。比较五种解释方法：SHAP、LIME（模型无关）、occlusion、Input x Gradient（深度学习专用）、Attention x Gradient（Transformer专用）。通过最高令牌归因标准化解释，用Jaccard指数量化两两一致性。

Result: 在定义明确的临床领域取得高预测准确率，语义高度模糊时性能下降。解释稳定性直接反映预测确定性：单义类别中收敛性强，诊断不确定时显著下降。定性错误审计揭示三种系统性失效机制：词汇过敏、语义重叠、归因连贯性丧失。

Conclusion: 支持在审计Transformer医学文本分类模型时联合使用多种解释方法及定量一致性指标，并建议优先采用具体临床本体而非宽泛诊断标签。

Abstract: A comparative explainability framework is presented to audit DeBERTa-v3 under zero-shot classification of medical abstracts. The work addresses the disagreement problem in Explainable Artificial Intelligence, where different attribution methods produce divergent explanations for the same input and prediction. A natural language inference engine is implemented over the Medical Abstracts corpus with five enriched hypotheses per diagnostic category and a balanced sample of one thousand texts per class. Five explanation methods are compared: SHAP and LIME as model-agnostic approaches, occlusion and Input x Gradient as deep-learning-specific approaches, and Attention x Gradient as a transformer-specific approach. Explanations are standardized through top-token attribution, and pairwise agreement is quantified using the Jaccard index. High predictive accuracy is achieved across well-defined clinical domains, whereas performance degrades under high semantic ambiguity. Explanatory stability directly mirrors predictive certainty, exhibiting strong convergence in univalent categories and a marked drop under diagnostic uncertainty. Furthermore, qualitative error auditing uncovers three systemic failure mechanisms: lexical hypersensitivity, semantic overlap, and loss of attribution coherence. The results support the combined use of several explanation methods and quantitative agreement metrics when auditing transformer-based models in medical text classification, and suggest prioritizing specific clinical ontologies over broad diagnostic labels.

</details>


### [265] [VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02200)
*Qiushi Han,Keya Hu,Linlu Qiu,Cathy Wu,Kaiming He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VISTA是一个视觉harness，为多模态模型提供长程视觉能力，通过无损视觉记忆和主动检索大幅提升复杂视觉任务的推理表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态模型具备强推理能力，但缺乏合适的harness来释放其在多样交互环境中的潜力，尤其是在需要长程视觉感知和记忆的复杂视觉任务中。

Method: 提出VISTA，一种视觉harness，让通用多模态模型通过视觉观察直接感知环境，并维护保存原始观察的无损视觉记忆；模型可在推理时主动检索这些观察并重组视觉输入。设计简洁，可低成本迁移到多种视觉环境。

Result: 在ARC-AGI-3上，将Claude Opus 5.0的相对人类行动效率分从40.68提升至满分100.00，完成全部25个公开游戏，且比首次参与的人类玩家少用57.4%的行动。在另外三个涵盖多种视觉游戏与谜题的基准上，显著优于使用相同底层模型但仅配简易harness的基线。

Conclusion: VISTA有望成为通用视觉harness，推动多模态智能体在复杂视觉环境中的发展。

Abstract: We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments. We introduce VISTA, a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. The model can actively retrieve these observations and reorganize its visual input as it reasons. On ARC-AGI-3, VISTA improves Claude Opus 5.0's Relative Human Action Efficiency score from 40.68 to a perfect 100.00, with the model completing all 25 public games using 57.4% fewer actions than first-time human participants. VISTA's simple design also allows it to extend naturally to diverse visual environments with minimal adaptation. Across three additional benchmarks covering a diverse range of visual games and puzzles, it substantially outperforms baselines using the same underlying model with minimal harnesses. Our results highlight VISTA's potential as a general-purpose visual harness for advancing multimodal agents in complex visual environments.

</details>


### [266] [ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02202)
*Sohyeon Kim,Yoonho Lee,Bo Liu,Dayoon Ko,Rulin Shao,Seungone Kim,Graham Neubig,Pang Wei Koh,Aakanksha Chowdhery,Akari Asai,Omar Khattab,Yejin Choi,Gunhee Kim,Chelsea Finn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出ScholarCatalyst数据集与检索任务，考察AI能否像顶尖科学家一样，识别一个研究问题所需的先前知识，发现当前检索方法仍有明显差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学家擅长从海量文献中辨别新问题所需的前期工作，而AI系统即使能解决开放问题，在这项"选题嗅觉"上仍远落后。作者想量化并研究这一能力。

Method: 构建自动化流程，让207篇近期计算机科学论文的184位主作者标注哪些候选论文（或其可能性）推进了他们的项目，并给出详细理由，形成ScholarCatalyst数据集。据此设计检索任务：给定初始研究问题，仅从项目开始时已存在的文献中检索相关论文。

Result: 智能体搜索（0.42）并不优于嵌入检索（0.48，Recall@20），尽管它调用了同一检索器作为工具；即便基于可能见过成品论文的Claude Fable 5.1的智能体，也仅达0.51 R@20。

Conclusion: 结果表明需要新的训练方法，让模型具备专家般的广域语料检索直觉。ScholarCatalyst是迈向能对半成形想法指出所需先前文献的科学智能体的一步。

Abstract: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having 184 lead authors of 207 recent computer science papers label which candidates did or could have advanced their project, each with a detailed rationale. We introduce a retrieval task with author-provided judgments: given an initial research question, retrieve these papers from only the literature available when the project began. Agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval (0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20) despite calling that same retriever as a tool. Even an agent built on Claude Fable 5.1, which may have seen the completed papers during training, reaches only 0.51 R@20. These results highlight the need for new training recipes that equip models with expert intuition for searching broad corpora. We envision ScholarCatalyst as a step toward scientific agents that can take a half-formed idea and point to the prior research it needs.

</details>


<div id='eess.SY'></div>

# eess.SY [[Back]](#toc)

### [267] [Development of an EMT model of the Balearic power system](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00034)
*Yousef Pipelzadeh,Dharshana Muthumuni,Farid Mosallat,Javier Renedo,Silvia Sanz Verdugo,Antonio Cordón,Edgar Nuño,Macarena Martín*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文描述了巴利阿里群岛电力系统的电磁暂态（EMT）模型的实现，以应对高比例逆变器资源带来的系统强度降低与惯量下降问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 巴利阿里群岛追求100%可再生能源，随逆变器资源（IBR）增加、传统同步发电机减少，系统短路水平（系统强度）变弱、总惯量降低，面临安全可靠运行的新挑战，需借助EMT仿真分析稳定性。

Method: 规划采用技术使能器：新建2x200 MW VSC-HVDC联络线（金属回线双极）、同步调相机（SC）和电池储能系统（BESS）作为全集成网络组件；基于系统中大量电力电子设备，构建巴利阿里电力系统的EMT模型并进行详细电磁暂态仿真研究。

Result: 实现了巴利阿里电力系统的EMT模型（摘要未提供具体数值仿真结果）。

Conclusion: 针对高电力电子化电力系统，需通过EMT仿真来评估稳定性，本文为巴利阿里系统提供了EMT建模基础。

Abstract: The Balearic Islands are striving to achieve 100% renewable energy, which poses new challenges in operating the power system securely and reliably. With a higher integration of inverter-based resources (IBRs) and a reduced presence of conventional synchronous generators, the system strength, particularly short circuit levels, becomes weaker and more susceptible to disturbances; and the total inertia of the system becomes lower. Technology enablers are planned to achieve energy transition in the Balearic power system: a new 2x200 MW VSC-HVDC link (bipole with metallic return), Synchronous Compensators (SC) and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), as fully-integrated network components. Detailed ElectroMagnetic Transient (EMT) simulation studies may be needed to analyse stability of the system, due to the high amounts of power-electronics devices in the system. This paper describes the implementation of an EMT model of the Balearic power system.

</details>


### [268] [New VSC-HVDC interconnection between the Iberian Peninsula and Balearic Archipelago to enable energy transition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00043)
*Javier Renedo,Silvia Sanz Verdugo,Antonio Cordón,Belén Segura,David Castañeda,Rosalía Rivas,Patricia Labra*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文介绍西班牙输电系统运营商为巴利阿里群岛脱碳而规划的PEN-BAL2 VSC-HVDC互联项目，阐述其背景、技术方案与挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 巴利阿里群岛作为孤岛电力系统，其脱碳（整合可再生能源）带来电力系统稳定性与运行挑战，同时需增加伊比利亚半岛与群岛间的输电容量，因此需要新的HVDC互联来支撑能源转型。

Method: 规划PEN-BAL2项目：采用基于电压源换流器（VSC）的HVDC互联，双极结构2×200 MW，直流电压±250 kVdc，每个换流站无功容量+100/-150 Mvar；一端接入未来El Fadrell 400 kV变电站（伊比利亚半岛），另一端接入现有San Martín 220 kV变电站（马略卡岛），海底电缆约363 km。论文描述群岛能源转型挑战、通用技术使能因素及该VSC-HVDC互联方案。

Result: 论文对巴利阿里群岛能源转型挑战进行分析，并给出PENBAL2 VSC-HVDC互联的技术使能方案与工程配置描述。

Conclusion: 通过PEN-BAL2 VSC-HVDC互联，可增强伊比利亚半岛与巴利阿里群岛间的输电能力，支撑群岛可再生能源整合与脱碳，缓解孤岛系统的稳定性与运行问题。

Abstract: One of the challenges of the Spanish Transmission System Operator (TSO) is the decarbonisation of the Balearic Archipelago, by means of the integration of Renewable Energy Sources (RES) in the islands, as well as increasing the transmission capacity between the Iberian Peninsula and the Balearic Islands. Since the Balearic Archipelago is an island power system, the decarbonisation brings challenges related to power system stability and operation. A new High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) interconnection between the Iberian Peninsula power system and the Balearic Islands power system is planned to facilitate the decarbonisation of the Balearic Archipelago (PEN-BAL2 Project). The HVDC link will be based on Voltage Source Converter (VSC) technology and will consist of a bipole of 2x200 MW, a DC voltage of +-250 kVdc and +100/-150 Mvar of reactive power capacity for each converter station. One converter station will be connected to a future El Fadrell 400 kV substation (Castellón, Valencia, Iberian Peninsula), while the other converter station will be connected to the existing San Martín 220 kV substation (Mallorca Island, Balearic Islands). The link will have HVDC submarine cables of 363 km (approx.).This paper will describe the challenges for energy transition in the Balearic Archipelago, technology enablers in general and PENBAL2 VSC-HVDC interconnection.

</details>


### [269] [Identification of the Steering and Speed Systems of a Four-Wheel-Steering Tractor for Optimal Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00059)
*Riikka Soitinaho,Timo Oksanen*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对四轮转向农用拖拉机的转向与速度控制系统，采用数据驱动方法进行系统辨识，为路径跟踪控制提供模型。模型融合运动学模型、一阶执行器模型及估计的时间常数和传输延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于模型的控制设计需要足够精确的系统模型，但拖拉机的转向与速度控制系统包含数字、机电和液压组件，难以用第一性原理建模，因此需要数据驱动方法进行系统辨识。

Method: 研究拖拉机的转向与速度控制系统，采用数据驱动方法估计系统模型；将车辆运动学模型、建模为一阶系统的执行器，以及估计的时间常数和传输延迟相结合。

Result: 得到了一个结合运动学模型、一阶执行器模型和估计的时间常数与传输延迟的系统模型用于路径跟踪控制。

Conclusion: 数据驱动方法可有效辨识难以基于第一性原理建模的复杂农机控制系统，为路径跟踪控制设计提供可用模型。

Abstract: Model-based control design requires sufficiently accurate model of the system-to-be-controlled. This paper addresses the system identification of steering and speed control of a four-wheel-steering agricultural tractor for the purpose of developing path tracking control. To this end, we investigate the steering and speed control systems of the tractor. These are complex systems with digital, mechatronic, and hydraulic components challenging to model based on first principles. We take a data-driven approach to estimating the system models. The resulting model combines the kinematic model of the vehicle, actuators modelled as first-order systems, and estimated values for time constants and transport delays.

</details>


### [270] [The Geometry of Time: Horizon-Independent Feasibility and Repair for STL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00199)
*Avinash Malik*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种几何判定方法，可在与时间跨度无关的情况下检验信号时序逻辑(STL)控制合成的物理可行性，并给出闭式时间延迟来修复不可行约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: STL控制合成常因执行器限制或任务截止时间不合理而不可行。标准优化方法通过离散化时间跨度建模，导致计算量指数增长，且无法提取连续时间上的调整方案。

Method: 将显式时序逻辑约束转化为在零时刻评估的连续空间后向可达集；解析反演Bhat-Bernstein整定时间积分，把时间窗口映射为连续空间边界，将可行性检验简化为局部矩阵-向量包含判定。当规格不可行时，提取Farkas对偶证书以定位冲突约束并找出最大几何空间间隙，再解析反演系统动态扩张，将最大空间间隙映射为精确闭式时间延迟以修复边界赤字。

Result: 在六维无人机运动学上实验表明：执行时间亚毫秒级，相较最先进优化编码有巨大加速，且对深层嵌套逻辑公式具有计算免疫性；形式化证明了方法的严格可靠性、数学上有界完备性及与时间跨度无关的可扩展性。

Conclusion: 该几何判定程序实现了独立于时间跨度的物理可行性评估，并能以闭式时间延迟精确修复不可行约束，兼具理论保证与显著计算效率优势。

Abstract: Signal Temporal Logic control synthesis frequently encounters physical infeasibility due to actuator limits or flawed task deadlines. Standard optimization methods model time by discretizing the horizon, which leads to exponential computational growth and prevents the extraction of continuous temporal adjustments. This paper presents a geometric decision procedure that evaluates physical feasibility completely independently of the temporal horizon length. The method operates by transforming explicit temporal logic constraints into continuous spatial backward reachable sets evaluated at time zero. It analytically inverts the Bhat-Bernstein settling-time integral to map temporal windows into continuous spatial boundaries, reducing the feasibility check to a local matrix and vector inclusion evaluation. When a specification is infeasible, the procedure extracts a Farkas dual certificate to isolate conflicting constraints and identifies the maximum geometric spatial gap. It then analytically inverts the system's dynamic expansion to map this largest geometric gap into an exact, closed-form temporal delay, precisely fixing the boundary deficit to restore physical realizability. We formally prove the strict soundness, mathematically bounded completeness, and horizon-independent scalability of this procedure. Experimental evaluations on six-dimensional drone kinematics demonstrate sub-millisecond execution times, massive speedups over state-of-the-art optimization encodings, and computational immunity to deeply nested logical formulas.

</details>


### [271] [Decentralized Safe Path Following for Multiple Quadrotors on Intersecting Paths with Theoretical Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00208)
*Hamza Tariq,Adeel Akhtar*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究多架四旋翼在交叉路径上的去中心化安全路径跟随，将横反馈线性化重构为带四等式约束的二次规划，仅放松沿路径速度约束以保安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多四旋翼在交叉路径上飞行需同时满足避碰与严格遵循预定路线，已有方法难以兼顾路径遵守与安全性。

Method: 将横向反馈线性化重构为约束二次规划，含四个等式约束：两个保证收敛并严格贴合路径，两个规定期望速度与航向；仅放松沿路径速度约束，路径与航向约束保持硬约束。

Result: 在给定假设与可行初始条件下，保证所有智能体收敛并沿指定路径飞行、避免碰撞、避免姿态奇异；在Drake物理引擎的非平面交叉路径上与两种"标称+安全滤波器"级联方案对比评估。

Conclusion: 提出一种兼具路径严格遵守与碰撞规避的去中心化四旋翼安全路径跟随控制器，并通过物理仿真验证其有效性与相对基线优势（代码与结果已开源）。

Abstract: This paper studies decentralized safe path following for multiple quadrotors on intersecting paths, where safety requires both collision avoidance and strict adherence to pre-assigned routes. The proposed controller reformulates transverse feedback linearization as a constrained quadratic program with four equality constraints: two enforce convergence to and strict adherence to the path, and two prescribe the desired speed and heading. Safety is achieved by relaxing only the along-path speed constraint, while the path and heading constraints remain hard. Under the stated assumptions, and for admissible initial conditions, the controller guarantees that all agents converge to and thereafter follow their assigned paths, avoid collisions, and avoid attitude singularities. We evaluate the controller in the Drake physics engine on non-planar intersecting paths and compare it against two nominal-plus-safety-filter cascades. Code and additional results are available at https://gradslab.github.io/safe_multiquad_pf/.

</details>


### [272] [Cost-Informed Learning for Aggregating Building HVAC Flexibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00219)
*Jingguan Liu,Cong Chen,Xiaomeng Ai,Jiakun Fang,Jinsong Wang,Jinyu Wen*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种成本导向的聚合框架，学习建筑HVAC负荷的聚合灵活性集合，以最小化聚合商调度成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有聚合方法多采用容量导向目标，并将灵活性聚合与下游利用分离，导致聚合集合无法保留对降低调度成本最有价值的灵活性。

Method: 用参数化储能型替代模型表示聚合HVAC灵活性，从下游调度成本反馈中联合学习替代参数与内近似目标；将电价不确定性建模为DR-CVaR下游问题，并重写为凸二阶锥规划；用随机平滑与分数函数估计器估计成本梯度。

Result: 基于NYISO价格数据的案例研究表明，相比容量导向基准，该框架降低了调度成本，且合适的风险与模糊设置可降低样本外CVaR。

Conclusion: 成本导向的聚合框架能更有效保留成本相关灵活性，并在不确定电价下改善调度成本与尾部风险表现。

Abstract: This paper develops a cost-informed aggregation framework that learns an aggregate flexibility set of building heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning (HVAC) loads to minimize the aggregator's dispatch cost. Existing aggregation methods mainly use volume-oriented objectives and treat flexibility aggregation and downstream utilization as separate stages. Consequently, the resulting aggregate set may fail to preserve the flexibility most valuable for reducing downstream dispatch costs. To address this limitation, we represent aggregate HVAC flexibility using a parameterized storage-form surrogate and jointly learn the surrogate parameters and the inner-approximation objective from downstream dispatch-cost feedback. This cost-informed feedback allocates the surrogate's limited representation capacity to cost-relevant regions of the aggregate flexibility set. To account for electricity-price uncertainty, we formulate a distributionally robust conditional value-at-risk (DR-CVaR) downstream problem that captures both distributional ambiguity and tail risk. For efficient learning, we reformulate the DR-CVaR problem as a convex second-order cone program. We estimate cost gradients using randomized smoothing and a score-function estimator, avoiding differentiation through large-scale building-level optimization problems. Case studies using NYISO price data show that the proposed framework reduces dispatch costs relative to a volume-oriented aggregation benchmark and that suitable risk and ambiguity settings can lower the out-of-sample CVaR of dispatch costs.

</details>


### [273] [ThermE: Predictive Management of Shared Thermal Headroom for Sustained LLM Inference on Thermally Constrained Edge SoCs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00267)
*Rui Lu,Yuheng Wang,Bozheng Liu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: ThermE 是一个运行时系统，通过预测并联合管理边缘 SoC 上的共享热余量，在持续 LLM 推理中平衡当前性能与未来服务能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘 SoC 上 CPU、GPU、RAM 共享散热路径，prefill 和 decode 消耗随时间变化的热余量；现有厂商调频器仅在接近硬件限流阈值时反应，不了解请求状态或后续工作，可能导致过快耗尽热余量而损害后续服务。

Method: ThermE 包含三部分：Fast LLM-to-Heat Compiler 将模型、请求、运行时状态与候选动作映射到域热量而无需执行 LLM；PDE 约束的 Headroom Predictor 使用 ThermPINN 进行离线热辨识，并用轻量 RHP 进行在线不确定性校准的热余量预测；Uncertainty-Aware Action Scheduler 选择兼顾服务质量与未来热余量的动作。系统构建于 vLLM 之上。

Result: 在四种 LLM 推理负载上，相比 vLLM，ThermE 将 TTFT 和 TPOT 分别降低 40.55% 和 12.17%；SLO 违规率为 5.70%，最强基线为 12.30%；预测器 MAE 为 1.94 °C，开销 11.50 ms。

Conclusion: ThermE 能有效预测并管理边缘 SoC 的共享热约束，显著提升 LLM 服务性能并降低 SLO 违规率，同时保持低预测开销。

Abstract: Compact edge system-on-chip (SoC) platforms increasingly run sustained LLM inference under thermal constraints, while their CPU, GPU, and RAM share a cooling path. Prefill and decode therefore consume shared, time-varying thermal headroom, yet vendor governors react only near hardware throttling thresholds without knowledge of request state or upcoming work. A control decision that improves current performance can thus consume headroom too quickly and degrade subsequent service. In this paper, we present ThermE, a runtime system that predicts and jointly manages shared thermal headroom for sustained LLM inference on edge SoCs. Its Fast LLM-to-Heat Compiler maps the model, requests, runtime state, and candidate actions to domain heats without executing LLMs. A partial differential equation (PDE)-constrained Headroom Predictor uses ThermPINN for offline thermal identification and a Reduced Headroom Predictor (RHP) for low-overhead online uncertainty-calibrated headroom forecasts. An Uncertainty-Aware Action Scheduler then selects actions that balance serving quality and future headroom. We implement ThermE atop vLLM and evaluate it across four LLM inference workloads. The results show that ThermE reduces TTFT and TPOT by 40.55% and 12.17%, respectively, relative to vLLM. It achieves a 5.70% SLO violation rate, compared with 12.30% for the strongest baseline, while its predictor obtains a 1.94 $^\circ$C MAE with 11.50 ms overhead.

</details>


### [274] [Vulnerability-Weighted Routing of Timing-Critical Nets for Configuration-Upset-Resilient SRAM-Based FPGAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00281)
*Mostafa Darvishi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向SRAM型FPGA的脆弱性加权布线方法，将预测的布线故障严重度纳入布线目标，在有限标称时序损失下提升抗配置翻转能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统FPGA布线仅优化时序、拥塞和可布线性，无法区分标称性能相近但对配置引起的延迟退化敏感度差异很大的路径。

Method: 引入连续脆弱性代价，将潜在（可电连接休眠）布线资源导致的延迟扰动与下游时序裕量关联；辅以配置集中度项抑制脆弱资源过度聚集；仅对最高风险网选择性拆线重布，其余路径保持固定。基于Vivado/RapidWright流程在Zynq UltraScale+ XCZU7EV上实现。

Result: 在四个基准上，与商用时序驱动布线、脆弱性无关重布及二元脆弱资源规避对比，配置引起的时序脆弱性总体降低41.7%，标称时序退化约1.0%；仅重布最高风险5%的合格网即可获得扩展布线预算下85.8%的脆弱性降低效果。硬件级验证通过受控的配置等效扰动完成。

Conclusion: 连续的脆弱性信息可在对标准布线质量影响有限的前提下提升配置翻转（配置扰动）恢复能力。

Abstract: Conventional FPGA routing optimizes timing, congestion, and routability but does not distinguish routes with similar nominal performance and substantially different susceptibility to configuration-induced delay degradation. This paper presents a vulnerability-weighted routing methodology for SRAM-based field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) that incorporates predicted routing-fault severity directly into the routing objective. A continuous vulnerability cost relates delay perturbations caused by electrically attachable dormant routing resources to the available downstream timing slack, while a complementary configuration-concentration term discourages excessive localization of vulnerable resources. To limit implementation disruption, only the highest-risk nets are selectively ripped up and rerouted while unaffected routes remain fixed. The method is implemented on a Zynq UltraScale+ XCZU7EV using a Vivado/RapidWright-based flow and evaluated across four routed benchmarks against commercial timing-driven routing, vulnerability-agnostic rerouting, and binary vulnerable-resource avoidance. Controlled configuration-equivalent perturbations provide hardware-level validation. The proposed method reduces aggregate configuration-induced timing vulnerability by 41.7% with approximately 1.0% nominal timing degradation and captures 85.8% of the vulnerability reduction obtained at the expanded routing budget by rerouting only the highest-risk 5% of eligible nets. The results demonstrate that continuous vulnerability information can improve configuration-upset resilience with limited impact on nominal routing quality.

</details>


### [275] [Identifiability Limits of Forced Oscillation Sources in Power Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00356)
*Kai Sun*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究强制振荡源(单一未知幅相正弦)的唯一定位问题，将候选谐波响应视为测量空间中的投影射线，给出精确可定位的充要条件、加权最近射线定位器与确定性恢复界，并提出四类定位失败机制框架，通过Kundur与IEEE-NASPI算例验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强制振荡源能否唯一被定位，同时取决于可用测量与候选干预字典。由于幅值与相位未知，每个候选谐波响应只能确定到一个非零复标量，这一问题过去缺乏统一的可辨识性刻画与失败机制分类。

Method: 针对单一未知恒幅正弦通过某一物理干预通道作用的情形，利用幅相未知导致候选响应在测量空间中呈投影射线这一性质，推导精确定位的充要条件，构造加权最近射线定位器，并基于投影分离度建立确定性恢复界；提出区分机制失配、特征投影损失、结构不可辨识、条件数差/模型误差四类失败机制的框架。

Result: Kundur两区域系统数值研究展示了分离良好的恢复、机制相关的终端决策、测量引起的模糊性以及近共线签名对模型扰动的敏感性；IEEE-NASPI竞赛模型进一步考察大规模候选字典、终端特征源覆盖及通过增加测量消除模糊性。

Conclusion: 正确识别源母线本身并不足以保证内部强制通道的唯一识别，也不足以保证对测量与模型不确定性的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Whether a forced-oscillation source can be uniquely localized depends jointly on the available measurements and the candidate intervention dictionary. This paper considers a single unknown constant-amplitude sinusoid acting through one of physical intervention channels. Because its amplitude and phase are unknown, each candidate harmonic response is observable only up to a nonzero complex scalar and therefore defines a projective ray in measurement space. A necessary-and-sufficient condition is derived for exact localization, together with a weighted nearest-ray locator and a deterministic recovery bound based on projective separation. The paper proposes a framework distinguishing four mechanisms of source localization failure: mechanism mismatch, feature-projection loss, structural nonidentifiability, and poor conditioning or model error. Numerical studies on the Kundur two-area system illustrate well-separated recovery, mechanism-dependent terminal decisions, measurement-induced ambiguity, and the sensitivity of nearly collinear signatures to model perturbations. Then, IEEE--NASPI Contest models are used to further examine broad candidate dictionaries, terminal-feature source coverage, and ambiguity removal through measurement augmentation. The results show that correctly locating the source bus does not by itself establish unique identification of the internal forcing channel or robustness to measurement and model uncertainty.

</details>


### [276] [Admissibility-Preserving Control for Multi-Input Systems with Joint Capacity Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00533)
*Saurabh Kumar,Lohitvel Gopikannan,Shashi Ranjan Kumar,Abhinav Sinha*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出AJ-APIR框架处理多输入严格反馈非线性系统的联合输入约束，实现约束集前向不变与指数收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有约束处理方法逐通道施加执行器界限，无法处理耦合的联合约束，且会不必要地抑制可容许控制方向。

Method: 构造状态相关增益矩阵，通过谱分解将指令输入分为相对约束边界的法向与切向分量；接近边界时衰减法向分量、保留切向分量，从而重分配控制努力而不损失跟踪能力，并与反步控制器集成。

Result: 保证联合可容许集前向不变；跟踪误差指数收敛到零，所有闭环信号一致有界，并刻画了联合约束下的指令需求行为；二阶两输入功率预算仿真验证有效。

Conclusion: AJ-APIR能有效利用联合约束几何，在严格保持输入约束的同时维持跟踪权限。

Abstract: This paper addresses the control of multi-input strict-feedback nonlinear systems subject to a joint capacity constraint, in which the admissible input set is a coupled subset of the individual actuator limits. Unlike existing constraint-handling methods that enforce actuator bounds channel by channel and may unnecessarily suppress admissible control directions, we develop an Anisotropic Joint-Admissibility-Preserving Input Realization (AJ-APIR) framework that explicitly exploits the geometry of the joint constraint. The proposed realization constructs a state-dependent gain matrix whose spectral decomposition separates the commanded input into normal and tangential directions relative to the constraint boundary. The normal component is attenuated as the boundary is approached, while the tangential component is preserved, which allows the admissible control effort to be redistributed without loss of tracking authority. Integrated with a backstepping controller, the AJ-APIR framework guarantees forward invariance of the joint admissible set for all time. We establish exponential convergence of the tracking error to zero together with uniform boundedness of all closed-loop signals, and characterize the resulting command-demand behavior under the joint constraint. Simulation results for a representative second-order, two-input nonlinear system subject to a power-budget constraint demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed method to enforce the joint input constraint.

</details>


### [277] [Aging-Aware Online Distributed Scheduling for Lifecycle Carbon Reduction in Geo-Distributed Data Centers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00605)
*Junyu Lin,Wenjie Liu,Shunbo Lei,Wentian Lu,Jianhui Wang,Junhong Liu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出分布式数据中心全生命周期碳建模框架，结合工作负载调度与利用相关的指数老化模型，用TVQS增强Lyapunov与ZSP-ADMM实现在线且隐私保护的分布式优化，碳排降13%、运营成本降12.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有碳感知优化多只关注服务器运行的运营碳排，忽视了工作负载引起的热应力会加速硬件非线性老化，导致更频繁更换服务器，从而增加隐含碳排，未反映真实全生命周期碳成本。

Method: 构建地理分布式数据中心全生命周期碳建模框架：除运营碳排外，将工作负载调度与依赖利用率的指数老化模型结合以评估长期碳成本。求解上，先用带时变队列平移(TVQS)的增强Lyapunov框架处理系统不确定性，再提出零和扰动ADMM(ZSP-ADMM)实现跨数据中心分布式协调并保护本地交换的工作负载信息。

Result: 仿真显示相较基准方法，所提方法最多降低13.0%碳排与12.6%运营成本。

Conclusion: 将硬件老化与隐含碳纳入优化可显著提升分布式数据中心的可持续性与经济性，同时兼顾在线、隐私保护与分布式实现。

Abstract: The rapid proliferation of data centers (DCs), driven by cloud computing and artificial intelligence (AI), has led to massive energy demand and carbon emissions, posing significant sustainability challenges. Carbon-aware optimization in geographically distributed data centers has been widely studied. Most existing approaches mainly focus on operational carbon emissions from server usage. However, existing literature often ignores workload-induced thermal stress, which accelerates nonlinear hardware degradation. This leads to more frequent server replacements and ultimately increases embodied carbon emissions. To address these limitations, we propose a comprehensive carbon life-cycle modeling framework for distributed data centers. Apart from operational carbon emissions, this work combines workload scheduling with a utilization-dependent exponential aging model to evaluate long-term carbon costs from server degradation. In order to solve the proposed optimization model in an online and privacy-preserving manner, an enhanced Lyapunov framework with time-varying queue shifting (TVQS) is first introduced to handle system uncertainties. Then, a zero-sum perturbation-based alternating direction method of multipliers (ZSP-ADMM) framework is developed to enable distributed coordination across geographically separated data centers while protecting locally exchanged workload information. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves up to 13.0% lower carbon emissions and 12.6% lower operational costs compared with benchmarks.

</details>


### [278] [Event-Triggered Practical Fixed-Time Integral Reinforcement Learning for Unknown Nonlinear Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00800)
*Tien Dat Vu,My Nguyen Bach,Minh Doan*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种事件触发固定时间积分强化学习框架，用于未知非线性系统的最优控制，无需持续激励条件并可排除Zeno行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未知非线性系统最优控制中，持续激励条件在实际操作中难以满足，且频繁的通信与控制更新带来负担，因此需要一种既能学习最优控制又能减少更新次数的方案。

Method: 采用积分型数据驱动辨识器重构未知动态；通过逆最优构造固定时间运行代价；推导满足实际固定时间性质的学习律；将历史数据或有限激励区间数据存入经验回放缓冲并融入权重更新律以规避持续激励；引入事件触发机制减少更新。

Result: 在事件触发实现下，闭环系统仍可实现实际固定时间稳定，所提触发规则保证排除Zeno行为；并通过非线性仿真实例验证理论结果。

Conclusion: 该框架显著降低了实际运行对持续激励的依赖与通信负担，同时保证稳定性与Zeno排除，为未知非线性系统最优控制提供了有效方案。

Abstract: This paper develops an event-triggered fixed-time integral reinforcement learning framework for optimal control of unknown nonlinear systems. An integral data-driven identifier is first used to reconstruct the unknown dynamics, after which an inverse-optimal formulation is employed to construct a fixed-time running cost. A learning law satisfying the practical fixed-time property is then derived. Previously collected data, or data obtained during a finite excitation interval, are stored in an experience-replay buffer and incorporated into the weight-update law. This avoids the persistent-excitation condition, which is often difficult to satisfy in practical operation. To reduce communication and control updates, an event-triggered mechanism is introduced. The paper shows that, under the event-triggered implementation, the closed-loop system still achieves practical fixed-time stability, while the proposed triggering rule guarantees the exclusion of Zeno behavior. Finally, a nonlinear example is presented to verify the theoretical results developed in the paper.

</details>


### [279] [Distributed Adaptive Neural Interval Observers for Unknown Nonlinear Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00802)
*Tien Dat Vu,My Nguyen Bach,Phuoc Vinh Nguyen,Minh Doan*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文为局部测量不完整下的未知非线性系统提出一种分布式自适应神经区间观测器，通过有限经验回放积分并发学习与非Metzler误差动力学的Sylvester坐标变换，实现有界估计与分量式区间性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对未知非线性系统在传感器节点仅具备局部、不完整测量的场景，需设计分布式观测器以同时提供状态区间估计并处理未知动态。

Method: 每个传感器节点利用局部输出与邻居观测信息构造上下界状态估计；未知非线性动态由自适应神经网络逼近；采用分布式自适应机制与协同实现保证有界估计误差及分量式区间性质；引入有限经验回放积分并发学习机制增强神经权重收敛，无需持续激励；对非Metzler误差动力学采用基于Sylvester的坐标变换恢复Hurwitz–Metzler分布式实现。

Result: 分布式自适应机制保证估计与权重误差有界，协同实现保持分量式区间性质；并发学习机制提升神经权重收敛性；Sylvester变换成功恢复Hurwitz–Metzler结构，并通过非线性分布式估计仿真验证。

Conclusion: 所提分布式自适应神经区间观测器在局部不完整测量下有效，兼顾区间估计、未知动态逼近与权重收敛，并克服了非Metzler误差动力学的实现难题。

Abstract: This paper develops a distributed adaptive neural interval observer for unknown nonlinear systems with locally incomplete measurements. Each sensor node constructs lower and upper state estimates using its local output and neighboring observer information, while unknown nonlinear dynamics are approximated by adaptive neural models. A distributed adaptation mechanism guarantees bounded estimation and weight errors, whereas a cooperative realization preserves the componentwise interval property. To enhance neural-weight convergence without requiring persistent excitation, a finite experience-replay integral concurrent-learning mechanism is incorporated into the adaptation law. For non-Metzler error dynamics, a Sylvester-based coordinate transformation is introduced to recover a Hurwitz--Metzler distributed realization. The theoretical developments are validated through a nonlinear distributed estimation example.

</details>


### [280] [Communication-aware Synthesis of Safe Controllers for Discrete-Time Linear Multi-Agent Systems with Distributed k-Hop Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00925)
*Yihan Liu,Teng Yan,Meiqi Tian,Bingzhuo Zhong*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究通信受限下离散线性多智能体系统的通信感知安全控制，提出分布式k跳观测器与RSI集联合设计方法，保证安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 远程状态估计（观测器）与安全控制器设计相互耦合：估计误差通过控制器增益影响状态演化，而控制器设计必须考虑观测器引起的状态扰动才能保证安全，这一耦合是核心难点。

Method: 提出分布式k跳观测器重构不可得的远程状态，推导一致观测误差界；在局部εi-鲁棒安全不变（RSI）集构造与成对相对状态安全约束中同时计入观测器导致的状态扰动；用基于LMI的优化方法联合综合分布式观测器、局部控制器与RSI集。

Result: 所得安全条件保证所有智能体始终位于各自局部RSI集内，且所有成对相对状态安全约束均满足；案例研究验证了方法有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作通过联合设计观测器、控制器与安全集，解决了有限信息交换下估计与安全控制的耦合问题，为通信感知安全控制提供了可计算的LMI求解框架。

Abstract: This paper studies communication-aware safe control for discrete-time linear multi-agent systems under limited information exchange. The main challenge lies in the coupling between remote-state estimation and safe controller design, since estimation errors affect the state evolution through the controller gains, while the controller design must account for the resulting observer-induced state perturbations to guarantee safety. To address this challenge, a distributed k-hop observer is developed to reconstruct unavailable remote states, and a uniform observer-error bound is derived. The effect of the observer-induced state perturbation on closed-loop safety is accounted for in both the construction of local εi-robust safe invariant (RSI) sets and the enforcement of pairwise relative-state safety constraints. The resulting safety conditions ensure that all agents remain within their local RSI sets while all pairwise relative-state safety constraints are satisfied.
