A linear matrix inequality (LMI)-based optimization method is developed to jointly synthesize the distributed observers, local controllers, and RSI sets. A case study illustrates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

</details>


### [281] [Closed-Loop Refinement and Execution for Learned Driving Planners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00992)
*Huaijin Hu,Shanting Wang,Zhongyu Mo,Andreas A. Malikopoulos*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: CLRE提出一种分层滚动时域控制框架，在不改动上游规划器、不新增学习模型的前提下，通过闭环精炼与执行缓解占位、冲突与急刹等失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于学习的驾驶规划器通常在开环下用日志轨迹训练和评估。在闭环中，即使位移误差很小的轨迹也可能导致车辆停滞、与周围智能体产生冲突或出现急刹等失效。

Method: CLRE为分层滚动时域控制框架。上层将名义轨迹作为参考，求解权衡路线进度与预测智能体交互的有限时域最优控制问题，从多个初值求解得到候选集，并用预测条件下的有向包围盒（OBB）可行性检测保留最小OBB间隙满足阈值的候选。下层执行最低代价的幸存候选，若无则使用路线中心线备份，通过规划器自带的跟踪控制器执行，并加入基于距离的速度约束和饱和比例制动律。

Result: 在126条Bench2Drive路线的闭环仿真中，以VAD为上游规划器，CLRE将驾驶得分从43.41提升至56.42，路线完成率从57.27%提升至72.23%，碰撞事件从70降至53。

Conclusion: CLRE有效缓解闭环执行中的失效模式，在上游规划器冻结且不引入新学习模型的情况下显著提升闭环驾驶性能与安全性。

Abstract: Learning-based driving planners are usually trained and evaluated in open loop against logged trajectories. In closed loop, a trajectory with small displacement error can still stall the vehicle, steer it into a conflict with surrounding agents, or be executed with abrupt braking. We introduce Closed-Loop Refinement and Execution (CLRE), a hierarchical receding-horizon control framework designed to mitigate these failure modes while leaving the upstream planner frozen and adding no new learned model. The upper layer treats the nominal trajectory as a reference and solves a finite-horizon optimal control problem that trades route progress against interaction with predicted agents. Solving it from several initializations gives a candidate set, and a prediction-conditioned oriented-bounding-box (OBB) feasibility test retains only candidates whose minimum predicted OBB clearance over the horizon meets a threshold. The lower layer executes the lowest-cost survivor, or a route-centerline backup when none remains, through the tracking controller supplied with the planner, augmented by a range-based speed bound and a saturated proportional braking law. In closed-loop simulation on 126 Bench2Drive routes with VAD as the upstream planner, CLRE raises the driving score from 43.41 to 56.42 and route completion from 57.27 to 72.23, and reduces collision events from 70 to 53.

</details>


### [282] [Learning-Based Predictive Control Method for Vehicle Lateral Control with a Multi-Step Gaussian Process Regression Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01220)
*Hasan Zakeri,Baisravan HomChaudhuri*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种基于多步高斯过程回归的模型预测控制方法，用于处理状态与控制相关的不确定性，并应用于车辆横向控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实系统与控制模型之间存在依赖状态与控制变量的不确定性，随时间累积传播会导致长时域显著偏差，威胁安全关键系统；现有随机控制需在整个控制时域精确预测状态分布，当不确定性随状态与控制变化时难以实现。

Method: 构建集成多步不确定性预测的MPC框架，采用多步高斯过程回归捕捉并预测依赖状态与控制的不确定性；针对该MPC优化问题提出迭代求解算法，并讨论其收敛性。

Result: 在车辆横向控制（尤其换道工况）中深入分析系统模型的误差传播，并通过综合仿真验证方法有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法能在不确定性依赖状态与控制变量时实现安全MPC控制，仿真结果验证了其有效性。

Abstract: We introduce a novel approach to model predictive control that incorporates multi-step uncertainty prediction for safely controlling systems characterized by uncertainties dependent on both state and control variables. The discrepancy between real-world systems and their control-oriented representations arises from inherent uncertainties, which frequently correlate with state and control variables, a common occurrence in modeling errors. As these uncertainties accumulate and propagate over time, they can produce substantial deviations over extended horizons, potentially compromising the integrity of safety-critical applications. Although existing stochastic control frameworks can maintain system operation within safety boundaries at specified confidence levels, they necessitate accurate prediction of state distributions throughout the control horizon. This prediction represents a significant challenge for systems where uncertainties vary with state and control inputs. Our contribution addresses this challenge through a Model Predictive Controller leveraging multi-step Gaussian Process Regression to capture and anticipate uncertainties that are state- and control-dependent. We further propose an iterative solution to the optimization problem in our MPC framework and discuss the convergence of the algorithm. To demonstrate the method in a practical application, we conduct an in-depth analysis of vehicle lateral control, particularly during lane-changing maneuvers, examining how errors propagate through the system model. The effectiveness of our proposed methodology is validated through comprehensive simulations.

</details>


### [283] [Fixed-Time Voltage Regulation in Distribution Networks with Impedance Awareness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01449)
*Nilanjan Roy Chowdhury,Venkatesh Sarangan*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种基于优化的固定时间控制算法，无需精确网络阻抗即可在固定时间窗内将配电网电压调节至安全限值内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 辐射状平衡配电网电压调节问题中，传统方法通常依赖精确的网络阻抗（电阻与电抗）先验知识，实际中难以获取，因此需要一种不依赖精确阻抗且能保证固定时间收敛的鲁棒控制方法。

Method: 结合固定时间稳定性（FxTs）与控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）进行稳定性与鲁棒性分析，并利用二次规划（QP）方法进行控制综合。首先解析给出控制增益与设计参数的充分条件以保证固定时间电压调节；随后将电压调节问题转化为等价的基于QP的优化框架，并转化上述条件以求解电压稳定的可行解。

Result: 在IEEE-33节点配电网上的实证验证表明所提算法有效，并与其他现有鲁棒控制方法进行了性能对比。

Conclusion: 该算法无需精确网络阻抗知识，即可在固定时间窗内保证电压收敛至预设安全限值，兼具鲁棒性与可行性。

Abstract: This letter introduces an optimization-based fixed time control algorithm for solving the voltage regulation problem of a radial and balanced power distribution network. The proposed algorithm requires no prior knowledge of the exact network impedance (resistance and reactance), yet guarantees voltage convergence to the predefined safe limit within a fixed time-window. We embrace results from Fixed-time stability (FxTs) and Control Lyapunov function (CLF) to analyze the stability and robustness of the underlying algorithm and then synthesize it leveraging the Quadratic Programming (QP) approach. We first analytically provide sufficient conditions on the control gains and the design parameters, that can ensure voltage regulation in fixed-time. Thereafter we transform the existing voltage regulation problem into an equivalent QP-based optimization framework and translate the aforesaid conditions to find feasible solutions for voltage stability. We empirically verify the efficacy of our proposed algorithm on the IEEE-33 bus distribution network and compare its performance against other existing robust control methods.

</details>


### [284] [Building Seasonal Highways for Residential Energy Hubs: Sizing, planning and operating thermal energy storage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01489)
*Dario Slaifstein,Mohammad Khosravi,Gautham Ram Chandra Mouli,Laura Ramirez-Elizondo,Pavol Bauer*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动的"seasonal highway"方法，用于协调住宅多能枢纽（电、热、出行）的短期日调度与长期季节优化，并实现热储能的最优容量配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多能载体住宅枢纽中，热储能时间常数大、往返效率低、自放电率高，其价值随优化时域缩短（1-48小时）而下降，导致短期运行中热储能过早耗尽。需在不对整年进行仿真的前提下，将短期日控制导向长期最优。

Method: 通过动态终端集（dynamic terminal sets）和价值函数链接季节性优化与日优化，构建季节感知的非线性经济模型预测控制器（NMPC），并提出热储能最优容量配置方法，同时分析其与日运行非线性的关系。

Result: 季节感知非线性经济MPC性能最均衡：所有MPC中平均电网成本第二低（-€209）；电池退化控制优于线性对照组（26-34%）；在非线性基准中热舒适性最佳。但数据驱动的季节性highway限制了对电池退化的控制能力，并略微增加了计算时间。

Conclusion: 所提框架可在避免整年仿真的同时实现热储能最优配置，并将长期最优性注入短期日控制；代价是电池退化控制能力受限且计算时间略有上升。

Abstract: The operation of residential energy hubs with multiple energy carriers (electricity, heat, mobility) poses a significant challenge due to the energy storage differences in time-constants, round-trip efficiencies and self-discharge rates. Usually, thermal storage exhibits flexibility in yearly planning optimizations or long-term scenarios. However, as optimization horizons shrink (1-48hs) so does their supplied value due to the lower round-trip efficiencies. To avoid this early depletion during operation this paper proposes a data-driven highway to steer the short-term daily control towards long-term optimality. The proposed methodology also presents how to optimally size the thermal storage and avoid yearly simulations and how all of this is related to nonlinearities in the daily operation. The presented framework links seasonal and daily optimizations through dynamic terminal sets and value functions. The seasonally-aware nonlinear economic model predictive controller achieves the most balanced performance, with the second best mean grid cost of all MPCs at -\texteuro 209. It also achieves better battery degradation control than its linear counterparts (between 26-34%) and the best thermal comfort of the nonlinear benchmarks. Nevertheless, the data-driven seasonal highway restrains the ability to control battery degradation and slightly increases computational time.

</details>


### [285] [Token Economy Design for Fair and Efficient Highway Congestion Management with Express Lanes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01680)
*Leonardo Pedroso,Juan Pablo Bertucci,W. P. M. H. Heemels,Mauro Salazar*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究高速公路车道分配的通证经济设计，在效率不牺牲的前提下提升公平性，通过动态拥堵博弈与平均场近似推导通证价格。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受圣马特奥101快速车道项目启发，探索非货币通证机制作为货币拥堵定价的替代方案，以实现稀缺道路资源的更公平管理。

Method: 将交互建模为有限人口动态拥堵博弈，含异质时间偏好与有限信息的演化策略调整；基于平均场近似推导出能实现系统最优车道分配的通证价格，并通过轮流机制实现时间上的公平。

Result: 在真实需求数据的微观交通仿真中，所提价格方案的平均通行时间与不设快速车道的基线场景几乎相同，同时显著降低紧迫度加权的感知通行时间。

Conclusion: 通证经济是货币拥堵定价的有前景替代方案，可更公平地管理稀缺道路容量。

Abstract: We study the design of a token economy for highway lane allocation that aims to improve fairness without sacrificing traffic efficiency. Motivated by the San Mateo 101 Express Lanes Project, we consider a setting in which high-occupancy vehicles have unrestricted access to an express lane, while the remaining users can alternate between regular and express lanes by earning and spending nonmonetary tokens. We model the resulting interaction as a finite-population dynamic congestion game with heterogeneous time preferences and limited-information evolutionary policy revisions. Building on a mean-field approximation, we derive token prices that enforce the system-optimal lane split while inducing fairness over time through turn-taking. The scheme is evaluated in a microscopic traffic simulation with real-world demand data. The results show that the proposed prices yield nearly the same average travel time as a baseline scenario in which no lane is reserved as an express lane, while substantially reducing urgency-weighted perceived travel time. These findings highlight token economies as a promising alternative to monetary congestion pricing for fairer management of scarce road capacity.

</details>


### [286] [Finite-Data Safety Informativity Under Dynamic Asymmetric Actuation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01820)
*Abhinav Sinha,Praveen Kumar Ranjan,Yongcan Cao*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对模型不确定与输入受限下的安全问题，提出一种有限数据安全证书，判断给定指令能否强制执行指定的安全不等式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统模型不完全已知时，测量误差与激励不足会使多个模型与同一有限数据一致；对某模型安全的指令可能对另一模型失效，且控制权限受限可能阻碍保持安全的纠正动作。

Method: 针对回归量精确已知、残差有界的线性参数化安全通道，推导所有数据一致模型最坏安全贡献的支撑公式，识别可获有限界的回归方向，使秩亏数据也能参与安全认证；用执行器跟踪误差的逐分量认证界得到仿射不等式，给出点态指令可行性的充要检验，并将其化为最近认证指令的标量求根问题与最大认证指令段比例的闭式门控；在反馈局部Lipschitz且不确定界有效时保证运行域内输出安全，并通过域保持与全状态延拓将保证扩展至所有时间。

Result: 该证书在模型与执行器不确定的安全关键场景中，仅凭有限测量即可认证输出安全；某车辆案例研究验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提有限数据证书可在模型不确定与不对称输入限制下提供可计算的安全保证，并借助域保持与全状态延拓实现全时域安全性。

Abstract: When the system model is not fully known, measurement error and limited excitation can leave several models consistent with the same finite data. A command judged safe for one model may fail for another, while limited control authority can prevent the corrective action needed to preserve safety. To ensure safety under model uncertainty and asymmetric input limits, we develop a finite-data certificate that determines whether a command can enforce a prescribed safety inequality. For a linearly parameterized safety channel with exactly known regressors and bounded aggregate residual error, we derive a support formula for the worst-case safety contribution of all data-consistent models. The formula identifies the regressor directions that admit a finite bound, allowing rank-deficient records to contribute to safety certification. Using certified componentwise bounds on actuator tracking error yields an affine inequality with a necessary and sufficient test for pointwise command feasibility. The affine inequality reduces computation of the closest certified command to a scalar root-finding problem. It also yields a closed-form gate that selects the largest certified fraction of a prescribed command segment. The proposed certificate guarantees output safety within its operating domain, provided the feedback is locally Lipschitz and the uncertainty bounds remain valid. Domain retention and full-state continuation extend this guarantee to all time. A vehicle study demonstrates that output safety can be certified from finite measurements in a safety-critical setting with model and actuator uncertainty.

</details>


### [287] [Differentiable Hybrid-Action Neural Feedback Control for District Heating Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01822)
*Nicolas Kirsch,Corrado Sgadari,Alessio La Bella,Giancarlo Ferrari-Trecate*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出混合动作神经控制器HANC，结合连续分支、类别分支与可微装配层，用直通Gumbel估计器训练离散动作，在区域供热网络控制中降低30%运行成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理信息系统中常需同时给出连续设定点和离散操作决策（设备切换、模式选择、调度），但离散动作不可微，阻碍梯度训练；传统混合整数方法又难以在线求解。

Method: HANC包含连续分支、类别分支和可微装配层，按构造满足执行器约束；类别决策采用直通Gumbel估计器，使策略可经完整闭环rollout通过时间反向传播训练。

Result: 在意大利RSE SpA真实区域供热网络仿真上，动态电价下学习到的控制器相比规则工业基线降低30%运行成本；相比确定性直通松弛，训练注入噪声在成本相近前提下将硬切换减少一个数量级，并归因于更宽的决策边际。

Conclusion: HANC能有效联合学习切换决策与连续设定点，实现可微闭环训练并显著降低运行成本，同时噪声注入可提升开关行为的平滑性。

Abstract: Many cyber-physical systems require control policies that combine continuous setpoints with discrete operational de- cisions, such as equipment switching, mode selection, or resource scheduling. Discrete actions are not differentiable, which ob- structs gradient-based policy training, while conventional mixed- integer formulations remain costly to solve online. This paper proposes a hybrid-action neural controller (HANC) in which a continuous branch, a categorical branch and a differentiable assembly layer jointly generate commands that satisfy complex actuator constraints by construction. Categorical decisions are handled using a straight-through Gumbel estimator, enabling the policy to be trained by backpropagation through time over full closed-loop rollouts. The proposed framework is deployed on a district heating network (DHN) featuring multiple heat generation units and stratified thermal energy storage. Its performance is evaluated on a simulation of a real DHN located at RSE SpA in Italy. The resulting policy jointly learns switching decisions and continu- ous operating setpoints. Under dynamic electricity pricing, the learned controller reduces operating cost by 30% compared to a rule-based industrial baseline. We also show that, compared with a deterministic straight-through relaxation, injecting noise during training achieves similar cost while reducing hard switching by an order of magnitude, and attribute this difference to the wider decision margins of the resulting policy.

</details>


### [288] [A local recursive least squares approach for discrete-time adaptive fuzzy control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01859)
*Víctor Costa da Silva Campos,Mariella Maia Quadros*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种局部递归最小二乘(RLS)估计策略，用于qLPV/TS形式的离散自适应模糊控制，每规则独立协方差以降低内存，并由LMI合成保证闭环一致最终有界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准RLS自适应模糊控制在TS模型下需要对所有规则维护统一/庞大的协方差矩阵，内存开销大且每次更新计算全部规则，效率低。作者希望降低内存占用并简化自适应计算，同时保持可证明的稳定性。

Method: 用常后件TS模糊模型逼近未知非线性项，后件参数由带遗忘因子的隶属度加权RLS律更新；为每条规则维护独立协方差矩阵，且仅在该规则激活时更新。基于此证明局部自适应误差有界，并针对匹配、扇区有界和范数有界三类未知非线性给出LMI综合条件。

Result: 自适应律保证局部自适应误差有界；LMI条件确保闭环自适应控制系统一致最终有界。三个数值算例验证：未知重力方向的平面机械臂、未知耦合的双水箱系统、以及作为效率车辆推力的无刷直流电机。

Conclusion: 该局部RLS策略显著降低内存并简化自适应计算，在多种未知非线性情形下均可通过LMI设计并保证闭环稳定性，具有实际工程适用性。

Abstract: This paper proposes a local recursive least squares (RLS) estimation strategy for discrete-time adaptive fuzzy control of nonlinear systems represented in quasi-Linear Parameter Varying (qLPV)/Takagi--Sugeno (TS) form. Unknown nonlinear terms are approximated by a constant-consequent TS fuzzy model, and the consequent parameters are updated by a membership-function-weighted RLS law with a forgetting factor. The proposed estimator keeps a different covariance for each rule, considerably reducing the memory footprint of the least-squares updates. The adaptation is also simplified since each rule is only adapted when it is active. From these properties, we are capable of showing that the adaptation law ensures bounded local adaptation errors. Building upon this adaptation law, Linear Matrix Inequality (LMI) synthesis conditions are presented for matched, sector-bounded and norm-bounded unknown nonlinearities, guaranteeing ultimate uniform boundedness of the adaptive control system in closed loop. Three numerical examples are presented to illustrate the adaptive control conditions in the three cases: a planar manipulator with unknown gravity direction, a two-tank system with unknown coupling, and a Brushless DC (BLDC) motor acting as thrust for an efficiency vehicle.

</details>


### [289] [A two-stage approach to satellite constellation optimization: classical and QUBO formulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01885)
*Carlo Novara*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出两阶段优化策略，将卫星星座设计中的空间覆盖与时间分辨率解耦，以降低非凸组合问题的复杂度，并给出连续变量与QUBO离散化两种变体，后者兼容量子退火硬件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO/VLEO地球观测星座设计需在空间覆盖、重访时间、成本与运行复杂度间权衡。在给定卫星数量下最大化对预定地面目标的空间与时间分辨率，本质上是非凸且可能组合爆炸的问题，对大规模星座与目标集求解计算量巨大。

Method: 提出两阶段优化策略，将空间覆盖设计与时间分辨率优化分离以降低整体复杂度。开发两种变体：其一在空间优化阶段采用连续决策变量；其二将这些变量离散化，并重构为二次无约束二值优化（QUBO）问题，从而可利用高效经典QUBO求解器并直接适配量子退火硬件。

Result: 初步仿真结果验证了该策略的有效性（摘要未给出具体定量指标），表明其可作为异构LEO/VLEO地球观测星座设计的可扩展方法。

Conclusion: 该框架为异构LEO与VLEO地球观测星座设计提供可扩展途径，并为在卫星任务设计中应用新兴量子优化技术开辟了道路。

Abstract: The design of satellite constellations for Earth observation requires balancing spatial coverage, revisit time, cost, and operational complexity. This paper considers the problem of designing the orbits of a given number of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) or Very Low Earth Orbit (VLEO) satellites to maximize the spatial and temporal resolution achieved over a prescribed set of ground targets. This kind of problem is inherently nonconvex and possibly combinatorial, making its solution computationally demanding for large constellations and target sets. To address this challenge, we propose a two-stage optimization strategy that separates spatial-coverage design from temporal-resolution optimization, thereby reducing the complexity of the overall problem. Two variants of the method are developed. The first employs continuous decision variables during the spatial-optimization stage, whereas the second discretizes these variables and reformulates the problem as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problem. The latter formulation enables the use of efficient classical QUBO solvers and is directly compatible with quantum-annealing hardware. The proposed framework provides a scalable approach to the design of heterogeneous LEO and VLEO Earth-observation constellations and establishes a pathway for exploiting emerging quantum-optimization technologies in satellite mission design. Preliminary simulation results are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the strategy.

</details>


### [290] [Interactive Power Flow in the Browser](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01922)
*Samuel Talkington,Frederik Geth,Qian Zhang,Le Xie,Skyler Liu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: tellegen 是一个开源、浏览器内运行的交互式潮流(PF)与最优潮流(OPF)分析框架，通过 WebAssembly 将电力系统分析工具普及化，且数据全程保留在本地、零 CEII 传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降低电力系统分析工具的安装与托管门槛，实现民主化访问；同时保护敏感数据（避免 CEII 外传），让工程师可通过 URL 分发可执行的数值研究。

Method: 框架包含 PF/OPF 核心数值引擎、可复用浏览器组件、可保存研究及结构化 WebMCP 工具（支持智能体交互），编译为 WebAssembly。用户可拖放算例文件、拖动改变节点负荷或线路容量、通过灵敏度分析预览影响，并在释放时精确重解。

Result: 输电 OPF 求解器与 PGLib 基线目标值对比；配电 PF 求解器与 OpenDSS 对比电压电流；WebAssembly 执行时间与 PowerModels.jl 对比。在真实感合成电网上，WebAssembly OPF 求解仅比原生二进制慢 25-43%。

Conclusion: 该实现表明工程师可将可执行数值研究以 URL 形式分发，在减少安装与托管需求的同时保持算例数据本地化，做到零 CEII 传输。

Abstract: This paper introduces tellegen, an open source framework for interactive power flow (PF) and optimal power flow (OPF) studies that run in the browser. This provides intuitive and democratized access to power system analysis tools compiled to WebAssembly. A user can drag and drop a case file, click and drag to change a nodal demand or line rating, preview the impacts via sensitivity analysis, and obtain an exact re-solve on release. User case files and results stay entirely on the device: tellegen transmits zero Critical Energy/Electric Infrastructure Information (CEII). The framework comprises a core numerical engine for PF and OPF, reusable browser components, saved studies, and structured WebMCP tools for agentic interaction. We evaluate the transmission OPF solver by comparing objectives with PGLib baselines; the distribution PF solver by comparing voltages and currents with OpenDSS; and the WebAssembly execution times by comparing with PowerModels.jl. On realistic synthetic grids, WebAssembly OPF solves take only 25-43% longer than native binary solves. The implementation shows how an engineer can distribute an executable numerical study as a URL, reducing installation and hosting requirements while keeping case data local.

</details>


### [291] [A Dynamic Generalized Kalman Consensus Filter for Switching Sensor Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02055)
*Tirthankar Chakraborty,Arnab Maity*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种动态广义卡尔曼一致性滤波器，用局部信息计算一致性权重，无需全局网络参数，在切换拓扑下保持跟踪精度并优于现有分布式滤波器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分布式滤波器依赖依赖通信图全局属性（如最大度）的一致性参数，对网络拓扑变化敏感，尤其不适合通信链路时变的移动传感器网络。

Method: 提出动态广义卡尔曼一致性滤波器（Dynamic Generalized Kalman Consensus Filter），基于信息形式一致性权重，仅使用局部可得量计算，从而去除对全局网络参数的依赖。

Result: 数值仿真表明，该算法在切换网络拓扑下仍能保持估计精度，并在给定跟踪问题中优于现有分布式滤波器。

Conclusion: 该滤波器无需全局参数即可适应动态拓扑，适用于移动传感器网络中的目标跟踪，具备更强的鲁棒性与实用性。

Abstract: Distributed state estimation is critical for applications such as surveillance, autonomous navigation, and wide-area monitoring, where sensor agents must cooperatively track targets using only local measurements and neighbor-to-neighbor communication. Existing distributed filters have been shown to achieve accurate estimation even under sparse inter-agent communication and limited sensing ranges. However, many of these methods rely on consensus parameters that depend on global properties of the communication graph, such as the maximum degree of the graph, and are therefore sensitive to changes in network topology. This limitation is particularly significant in sensor networks with mobile agents, where communication links change over time. This paper presents a Dynamic Generalized Kalman Consensus Filter for target tracking in sensor networks with switching communication topologies. The proposed algorithm computes information-based consensus weights using only locally available quantities, eliminating the need for global network parameters. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed algorithm maintains estimation accuracy under switching network topologies and outperforms existing distributed filters in the given tracking problem.

</details>


### [292] [Local Consistency Does Not Guarantee Global Conservation: Auditing Zero-Shot Composition of Airway Flow Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02056)
*Nichula Sathmith Wasalathilaka,Navodya Heshan Samarasinghe Dhanujaya Suraweera,Kevin Dawson,Chinthaka Jacob Mervyn Parakrama Bandara Ekanayake,Roshan Godaliyadda*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究用冻结的局部DeepONets组装二维气道树的稳态流场,发现局部正则化虽改善局部诊断,却无法保证全局准确性与守恒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子能在单几何族内近似PDE解,但独立学习的局部算子未必构成一致的全局模拟器。作者想探究冻结、单次前向的局部算子组合能否组装出可靠的整树流场。

Method: 分别训练管段、分叉、三分叉DeepONet,基于4872个基本CFD算例,采用场监督及散度、端口通量、分量平衡、端口压力等辅助惩罚。部署前冻结模型,不看整树CFD场即组装;并设事后敏感性协议(冻结于新训练与评估前),以固定Tube、跨三个随机种子重复Data/Div/Full模型。

Result: 部署保留主要流型与可控病理响应,CPU推理0.204–0.215秒,但外部残差达22.68%(以指定入口归一化)。相对Data,Full将原始组合分数降低26.7%(Y2)与26.4%(Y3),组装分量残差与界面失配RMS分别降低7.2%和16.6%;但平均整树速度误差增加7.5%,外部残差由17.49±4.38%升至26.77±3.65%。

Conclusion: 局部正则化能改善原始与组装后的局部诊断指标,却无法保证准确的全局场或守恒。局部算子的一致性组装仍是开放挑战。

Abstract: Neural operators approximate PDE solutions within a geometry family, but independently learned local operators need not form a consistent global simulator. We study frozen, single-pass composition for steady incompressible flow in idealized two-dimensional airway trees. Separate Tube, bifurcation, and trifurcation DeepONets are trained on 4,872 primitive CFD cases using field supervision and auxiliary divergence, port-flux, component-balance, and port-pressure penalties. The validation-selected deployment is frozen before whole-tree CFD fields are inspected and assembled without tree training, iterative coupling, flux correction, or CFD-informed adjustment. It retains major flow patterns and controlled pathology responses with 0.204-0.215 s CPU inference, but has a 22.68% prescribed-inlet-normalized external residual. A post-hoc sensitivity protocol, frozen before new training and evaluation, repeats Data, Div, and Full models across three seeds with Tube fixed. Relative to Data, Full reduces primitive composite scores by 26.7% for Y2 and 26.4% for Y3 and reduces assembled component-residual and interface-mismatch RMS by 7.2% and 16.6%, respectively. Nevertheless, mean tree velocity error increases by 7.5%, while external residual increases from 17.49 +/- 4.38% to 26.77 +/- 3.65%. Local regularization can therefore improve primitive and assembled local diagnostics without ensuring accurate global fields or conservation.

</details>


### [293] [Decentralized Power-Optimal Coordination for Spacecraft Swarms Using Time-Varying Magnetorquer Actuation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02118)
*Yuta Takahashi,Shin-ichiro Sakai*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出磁驱动航天器集群的分散式功率最优协调框架，联合设计交互图、频率分组与控制器增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型空间结构需突破运载火箭孔径限制，并仅靠太阳能维持构型；磁驱动无推进剂消耗，但全对交互且效果依赖功率与载波频率，需协调优化。

Method: 设计分散式功率最优框架，联合推导交互图、频率分组与控制器增益；控制器保持角动量这一非完整约束；面向载波间成员重叠的连通组；并用带误差界的快速近似积分。

Result: 相对位置误差、绝对姿态误差与反作用轮动量不平衡在分散式功率最优分配下收敛到期望状态；千星全交流交互闭环仿真验证框架；近似积分支持长时域高精度轨道重构。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了太阳供能磁驱动集群的省功率、无推进剂协调控制，适用于大规模高精度空间结构构型维持。

Abstract: This paper presents a decentralized power-optimal coordination framework for magnetically actuated spacecraft swarms. Swarms that form large space structures overcome the aperture limit set by the launch vehicle and hold their shape on solar-generated power alone. Magnetic actuation is propellant-free and generated by a magnetorquer, which is commonly used for attitude control. However, every spacecraft interacts with every other within range, and its effect depends on the actuation power and a carrier frequency. We therefore design a decentralized power-optimal framework to jointly derive the interaction graph, frequency grouping, and controller gains. Our decentralized controller preserves angular momentum, which is a nonholonomic constraint. Then, this framework for connected groups whose memberships overlap across carriers guarantees that the relative position errors, the absolute attitude errors, and the imbalance of the reaction-wheel momenta converge to the desired states under the decentralized power-optimal allocation. A closed-loop simulation of a thousand spacecraft with the complete alternating-current interaction confirms the framework. A fast approximate integration with a proven error bound extends the framework to a long-horizon orbital reconfiguration held with high precision.

</details>


### [294] [Feasibility of Simultaneous Input-Output Constraints for Tracking in a Class of LTI Systems: Part I](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02151)
*Junhyeok Yoon,Heather Hussain,Anuradha M. Annaswamy*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文针对多输入LTI系统，利用基于控制障碍函数（CBF）的调节器，在状态反馈与积分作用下同时满足输入和输出约束，给出了可行性及闭环有界前向不变的充要条件，并提出自由参数的系统设计方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决LTI多输入系统在状态反馈和积分作用下的输入与输出约束同时满足问题，需要明确CBF调节器可行解存在的条件及闭环稳定性保障。

Method: 采用基于控制障碍函数（CBF）的调节器（governor），结合状态反馈与积分作用，推导CBF调节器存在可行解的充要条件，并给出选择高阶CBF、可行指令信号边界及控制输入幅值等自由参数的系统设计流程。

Result: 推导出CBF调节器具有可行解以及闭环解有界且前向不变的充要条件；提供了一套系统化的自由参数设计方法，参数与高阶CBF、可行指令信号边界和控制输入幅值相关。

Conclusion: 该工作为多输入LTI系统约束控制提供了基于CBF调节器的理论条件和设计框架，配套论文通过数值算例验证了条件满足与否时的可行性（或不可行性）。

Abstract: This paper addresses the problem of simultaneous satisfaction of input and output constraints for LTI systems with multiple inputs with state feedback and integral action using a Control Barrier Function based governor. Necessary and sufficient conditions for the CBF-based governor to have a feasible solution and for the closed-loop solutions to be bounded and forward-invariant are derived. A systematic design procedure for choosing the free parameters of the CBF-governor is also provided. These free parameters are associated with high-order CBFs, bounds on feasible command signals, and control input magnitude. A companion paper provides several numerical examples to illustrate the results of this paper, especially the feasibility (or infeasibility) of the CBF governor when the conditions are satisfied (or not satisfied).

</details>


### [295] [Minimal Experiments for Robust Stabilization: Information, Spectral Geometry, and Duration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02187)
*Alexey Peregudin,Ngoc Tuan Dinh*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究数据驱动镇定中"最短实验序列"的性能，证明在合理谱条件下，最短序列的误差容忍度与最优实验仅差固定常数倍，并刻画慢驱动情形下的性能损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动控制需要有限长度的输入序列来识别/镇定系统，但最短可行序列（$mn+1$ 或 $m(n+1)$ 步）的鲁棒性是否接近任意时长、乃至已知模型的最优实验，此前缺乏定量比较。

Method: 针对 $n$ 状态、$m$ 输入的线性系统，构造最短序列（精确状态 $mn+1$ 步、含噪状态 $m(n+1)$ 步），并在谱半径有界、单位圆附近谱分离良好的条件下，将其误差容忍度与最优实验（已知模型、任意有限时长）进行比较；同时分析慢驱动 $A=I+hG$、可控深度 $\nu\ge2$ 的相变情形。

Result: 在良好分离条件下，最短序列可达到最优实验误差水平的固定比例；该常数因子优势在慢驱动系统中失效——对 $A=I+hG$（$\nu\ge2$），短实验损失量级为 $h^{\nu-1}$，而时长量级 $1/h$ 是恢复固定比例最优容忍度的充要条件。

Conclusion: 最短实验序列在广泛系统类中近乎最优，但慢驱动/高可控深度系统需更长实验；所得常数因子比较及 $1/h$ 时长阈值刻画了数据需求的内在下界。

Abstract: On broad classes of linear systems, the shortest experiments are almost as good as the best possible ones. For $n$ states and $m$ inputs, the shortest input sequences that support robust data-driven stabilization of every controllable plant have $mn+1$ steps with exact states and $m(n+1)$ with noisy states. We show that, when the spectral radius is bounded and the spectrum is well separated near the unit circle, these sequences tolerate a fixed fraction of the error level achievable by any experiment, even one designed with full plant knowledge and allowed to use any finite duration. This constant-factor comparison can fail for slowly actuated systems. For $A=I+hG$ with controllability depth $ν\ge2$, short experiments lose a factor of order $h^{ν-1}$, and duration of order $1/h$ is both necessary and sufficient to recover a fixed fraction of the optimal tolerance.

</details>

### [296] [Multi-Jurisdictional Legal Identity Assurance for Capability Gating: A Design-Science Proposal for Tiered, Reusable Identity Assurance of Natural, Juridical, and Machine Entities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00287)
*Walter Kurz*

Main category: q-fin.GN

TL;DR: 本文提出一种跨司法辖区的分层、可复用身份保证模型（设计科学提案），将"保证状态"与"能力门禁"分离，使身份需求随行为的后果严重性而非仅存在性变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有身份保证采用"一刀切式最大验证"，对所有人过度采集、排斥无需高门槛的参与者、为最罕见高风险情形向所有交互征税，且将身份强度与其解锁的活动绑定；既有框架还在单一法律空间内固定凭证等级、把验证绑定于执行机构，未解决跨境复用及数据删除与证据留存之间的矛盾。

Method: 以设计科学为方法，并借系统论视角（系统仅在实体行动时改变）建模。模型包含：类型化实体分类法；由"披露断言范围"与"信息来源"构成的二维坐标；作为实体带时间索引属性的司法辖区；以双时间性、责任分配、时点快照方式记录的依赖。需求从反洗钱法、电子身份法和数据保护法推导得出。

Result: 该提案与三种做法进行比较评估：一刀切式最大验证、基于每凭证保证等级的设计、以及机构化可复用KYC依赖。

Conclusion: 提出的分层可复用身份保证模型可支持自然、法人与机器实体跨司法辖区的身份管理，使身份需求随行为及其后果权重而调整，参与方可最小披露并在行为需要时补充信息，从而缓解过度采集、排除与跨境复用等问题。

Abstract: Identity assurance is the cost a digital system pays for dishonesty and uncertainty: it exists to make acts attributable when not everyone can be trusted at their word. A common way to pay that cost is flat maximum verification, asking each participant to meet a single high level of identification at entry, before any capability is exercised. Paid on everyone, it over-collects, excludes participants who cannot meet a bar they never needed to clear, taxes every interaction with the cost of the rarest high-risk case, and binds the strength of identification to the activity it unlocks. Existing frameworks compound this by fixing a small number of per-credential levels inside a single legal space and binding each verification to the institution that performed it, leaving cross-border reuse and the tension between data erasure and evidentiary retention unaddressed. This paper develops, as a design-science proposal, a tiered and reusable model of identity assurance for natural, juridical, and machine entities across jurisdictions. Reading the problem through systems theory, where a system changes only when an entity acts, the model holds the assurance state apart from the capability gate that consumes it, so that identity demand follows the act and the weight of its consequences rather than mere presence: a participant may take part with minimal disclosure and supply more only as an act requires. It comprises a typed entity taxonomy, a two-axis coordinate of disclosed assertion scope and source of information, jurisdiction as a time-indexed attribute of the entity, and reliance recorded as bitemporal, liability-allocated, point-in-time snapshots. Requirements are derived from anti-money-laundering, electronic-identity, and data-protection law, and the proposal is evaluated against flat maximum verification, per-credential level-of-assurance designs, and institutional reusable-KYC reliance.

</details>


<div id='math.OC'></div>

# math.OC [[Back]](#toc)

### [297] [Inverse Optimal Control with Convex Features and Box Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00033)
*Jiguang Yu,Louis Shuo Wang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究凸特征下层目标非负权重的逆最优控制问题，建立乐观双层最优控制模型，证明解映射全局单值Lipschitz、值函数凹性与渐近精确松弛，并给出局部可辨识性、噪声稳定性及KKT-MPCC的C-稳定性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从逆最优控制角度识别下层目标中的非负权重，且需在无活动集可微性假设下处理解映射与稳定性，具有理论与应用价值。

Method: 将问题建模为乐观双层最优控制；下层为强凸、线性约束、L2箱约束控制问题；利用下层对参数的仿射依赖分析简化响应映射；采用值函数松弛、无梯度二阶增长论证，以及KKT重构为函数空间MPCC并用Scholtes松弛。

Result: 证明简化响应映射全局单值和显式Lipschitz估计；值函数凹且Lipschitz，并得到渐近精确最优值松弛；建立局部可辨识性与O(δ)噪声稳定性；KKT重构得到函数空间MPCC，在一致乘子有界下Scholtes松弛给出C-稳定性；解耦标量例子给出严格互补证书。

Conclusion: 该工作为凸特征凸下层逆最优控制提供了无需活动集可微性的稳定性与可辨识性框架，并给出MPCC稳定性及显式示例验证。

Abstract: We study an inverse optimal-control problem for identifying nonnegative weights in a convex-feature lower-level objective. The resulting model is an optimistic bilevel optimal-control problem whose lower level is a strongly convex, linearly constrained control problem with box constraints in \(L^2\). For the reduced response map \(x\mapsto (y_x,u_x)\), we prove global single-valuedness and an explicit Lipschitz estimate, without assuming differentiability of active sets. Exploiting the affine dependence of the lower-level functional on \(x\), we show that the value function is concave and Lipschitz and derive an asymptotically exact optimal-value relaxation. We further establish local identifiability and \(O(δ)\) noise stability by a gradient-free argument based on second-order growth. Finally, a KKT reformulation yields a function-space MPCC; Scholtes relaxation gives C-stationarity under uniform multiplier boundedness. A decoupled scalar example provides an explicit strict-complementarity certificate via finiteness of threshold contacts.

</details>


### [298] [Improved upper bounds for five IHTC-2024 benchmark instances via exact reoptimization of the nurse-to-room layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00044)
*Alfonso Gippini Requeijo*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 针对IHTC-2024基准，固定入院、房间和手术室排程，仅对护士-房间-班次层精确重优化，改进了5个算例的已知上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IHTC-2024实例集仍开放提交且维护公开最优上界表，现有已发表最优解在护士分配层可能仍未最优，存在改进空间。

Method: 从基准页面已发布解出发，固定入院日、房间分配和手术室分配，仅对护士到房间与班次的分配层重新优化至证明最优，并用官方IHTP验证器校验。

Result: 获得5个改进上界：i02 1263（原1264）、i05 12744（原12760）、m01 3380（原3384）、m03 6692（原6697）、m04 3315（原3318），均无硬约束违反，改进幅度0.075%–0.125%。

Conclusion: 护士层可在数秒内精确求解（除一个算例外），表明已发表的部分最优解在护士分配层并非最优，该层是可低成本改进的薄弱环节。

Abstract: The Integrated Healthcare Timetabling Competition 2024 (IHTC-2024) defined a benchmark that integrates surgical case planning, patient admission scheduling and nurse-to-room assignment. Its instance set remains live: the organizers keep a public table of best-known upper bounds that is open to new submissions. We report five improved upper bounds on that table, for instances i02 (1263, previously 1264), i05 (12744, previously 12760), m01 (3380, previously 3384), m03 (6692, previously 6697) and m04 (3315, previously 3318). All five solutions were checked with the official IHTP validator and carry no hard-constraint violations. The solutions are not built from scratch: each is derived from the corresponding solution published on the benchmark page, holding its admission days, room assignments and operating-theater assignments fixed, and reoptimizing only the nurse-to-room-and-shift layer to proven optimality. The improvements are small in magnitude, between 0.075% and 0.125%, but they carry a structural observation: on the instances where the nurse layer can be closed exactly, it closes within seconds on all but one of them, and several of the published state-of-the-art solutions fall short of optimality in that layer.

</details>


### [299] [Predictor-Based Exponential Tracking of Turbulent Solutions for the Kuramoto--Sivashinsky Equation with Input Delay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00048)
*Amadou Cissé*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究带输入时滞的非线性Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程对非平稳参考轨迹的一致指数跟踪问题。参考轨迹属于全局吸引子中的完整轨迹族，无需平稳、周期或由有限维外系统生成。作者用一阶输运方程表示时滞输入，通过预测器-反步变换将增广闭环系统映射到标称无时滞误差动态，建立了全局适定性与一致指数稳定性，数值结果表明预测补偿可恢复跟踪误差的持续衰减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程的跟踪控制通常假设参考轨迹平稳、周期或由有限维外系统生成，且常忽略输入时滞。实际中指令生成与执行之间存在时间不匹配，未经补偿的时滞反馈会放大跟踪误差。因此需要针对更一般的非平稳参考轨迹（属于全局吸引子），在输入时滞下实现一致指数跟踪。

Method: 将时滞输入表示为一阶输运方程，与四阶跟踪误差动态耦合。采用预测器-反步变换补偿指令生成与执行之间的时间不匹配，把增广闭环系统映射为标称无时滞误差动态，后者由齐次输运子系统的输出迹驱动，该子系统在一个时滞区间后消失。利用一致吸引子界使反馈参数和稳定性常数可独立于初始时间与参考轨迹选取。

Result: 在增广状态空间中建立了全局适定性与一致指数稳定性。数值结果表明，在所考虑配置下，未补偿的时滞反馈会放大跟踪误差，而预测器补偿能恢复持续衰减。预测器一致性、有限时间消失和离散细化诊断支持了数值实现。

Conclusion: 预测器-反步变换可有效补偿非线性Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程中非平稳参考轨迹跟踪的输入时滞，实现一致指数跟踪，且参数选取不依赖初始时间和参考轨迹。

Abstract: Uniform exponential tracking is addressed for nonstationary trajectories of the nonlinear Kuramoto--Sivashinsky equation subject to a constant input delay. The reference belongs to a family of complete trajectories contained in the global attractor and need not be stationary, periodic, slowly varying, or generated by a finite-dimensional exosystem. The delayed input is represented by a first-order transport equation coupled with the fourth-order tracking-error dynamics. A predictor--backstepping transformation compensates for the temporal mismatch between command generation and actuation by mapping the augmented closed-loop system into the nominal delay-free error dynamics driven by the outgoing trace of a homogeneous transport subsystem. This subsystem vanishes after one delay interval. Uniform attractor bounds permit the feedback parameters and stability constants to be selected independently of the initial time and the reference trajectory. Global well-posedness and uniform exponential stability are established in the augmented state space. Numerical results show that, for the considered configuration, uncompensated delayed feedback amplifies the tracking error, whereas predictor compensation restores sustained decay. Predictor-consistency, finite-time-extinction, and discretization-refinement diagnostics support the numerical implementation.

</details>


### [300] [New Pareto Z-eigenvalue localization theorems for tensors with applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00113)
*Licai Shao,Xingong Shao,Yisheng Song*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文为张量特征值互补问题的Pareto Z-特征值建立了新的定位集，分析了它们与已有定位集的关系，并给出了TCP与TGEiCP解存在性的充分条件，还用于检验一般标量势的真空稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Pareto Z-特征值的定位对于理解张量特征值互补问题的性质至关重要，但已有定位集可能不够精确或完整，且需要将其应用于判断互补问题解的存在性及物理中的真空稳定性。

Method: 建立新的Pareto Z-特征值定位集，讨论新定位集与现有定位集之间的关系；基于这些定位集推导TCP和TGEiCP解存在性的充分条件，并将其用于检验一般标量势的真空稳定性。

Result: 得到了若干新的定位集，厘清了它们与已有定位集的关系；给出了TCP和TGEiCP解存在性的充分条件；该条件可成功用于检验一般标量势的真空稳定性。

Conclusion: 新的定位集丰富了对Pareto Z-特征值分布的认识，所得充分条件为张量互补问题解的存在性提供了实用判据，并在物理真空稳定性分析中具有应用价值。

Abstract: In this paper, we establish some new localization sets for Pareto Z-eigenvalues of tensor eigenvalue complementarity problems and discuss the relationships among existing ones. As applications, a sufficient condition for the solution existence of the tensor complementarity problem (TCP) and the tensor generalized eigenvalue complementarity problem (TGEiCP) are presented. In addition, this condition is also used to test the vacuum stability of a general scalar potential

</details>


### [301] [Control of 1D first-order linear hyperbolic systems: a brief survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00139)
*Long Hu,Guillaume Olive*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，回顾一维一阶线性双曲系统控制理论的文献，以致敬Jean-Michel Coron 70岁生日及其在该领域的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为庆祝Jean-Michel Coron 70岁生日，梳理并总结他做出重要贡献的一维一阶线性双曲系统控制这一领域的文献。

Method: 文献综述方法，系统回顾该领域已有研究成果。

Result: （摘要未提供具体研究结果，属综述性文章。）

Conclusion: 该综述总结了Coron在一维一阶线性双曲系统控制方面的贡献及相关文献。

Abstract: At the occasion of the 70th birthday anniversary of Jean-Michel Coron, we review the literature on the control of 1D first-order linear hyperbolic systems, a topic where he has made significant contributions.

</details>


### [302] [Minimal control time of some 1D first-order linear hyperbolic systems with row rank deficient boundary coupling matrix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00140)
*Long Hu,Guillaume Olive,Zengzhi Xin*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文刻画了一类边界耦合矩阵行秩亏的一维一阶线性双曲系统的最小控制时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边界耦合矩阵满行秩情形下的最小控制时间已被充分理解，但行秩亏情形尚缺乏刻画，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 针对边界耦合矩阵行秩亏的一类一维一阶线性双曲系统，进行最小控制时间的理论分析与刻画。

Result: 给出了该类行秩亏系统最小控制时间的特征刻画。

Conclusion: 将最小控制时间结果从满行秩情形推广到行秩亏情形。

Abstract: The minimal control time of one-dimensional first-order linear hyperbolic systems is by now well-known when the boundary coupling matrix is full row rank. The goal of this article is to characterize the minimal control time for a class of systems with row rank deficient boundary coupling matrices.

</details>


### [303] [Sharpness and Rigidity of the Two-Factor Recht-Re Lower Bound](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00155)
*Jinze Zhao*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 论文构造了n个n维秩一正半定矩阵的显式族，达到Lai-Lim猜想的下界。该下界来源于不同数据点随机优化步的乘积平均可能出现负特征值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机优化中连续步骤使用不同数据点，导致正半定矩阵乘积的平均可能具有负特征值。Lai和Lim证明了下界并猜测其尖锐性，但未证明。本文旨在证明该下界对所有n≥2是尖锐的。

Method: 构造显式的一族n个n维秩一矩阵，通过将一个正交基方向压缩因子1/√2实现。同时给出已知不等式简短自包含证明，并分类所有等号情形：每个极值矩阵包含与构造等价的公共不变n维块。

Result: 新构造证明下界对所有n≥2是尖锐的。等号要求矩阵维度恰为n；正定矩阵可逼近下端点但无法达到。强凸二次目标可将极值负特征值实现为两步期望梯度下降更新。

Conclusion: 验证了Lai-Lim的尖锐性猜想，刻画了等号情形，揭示维度与正定性对达到下界的关键限制，并建立了与梯度下降的实际联系。

Abstract: Products of positive semidefinite matrices arise when successive steps of a randomized optimization method use different data points. Their average can have a negative eigenvalue even though every individual matrix is positive semidefinite. Lai and Lim proved at ICML 2020 that $\sum_{i\ne j}A_iA_j\succeq-\frac{1}{4}n(n-1)I$ whenever $A_i\succeq0$ and $\sum_i A_i\preceq nI$, and conjectured that the constant is sharp for every $n\ge2$. We give an explicit family of $n$ rank-one matrices in dimension $n$ that attains this bound for every $n$, proving that sharpness statement. The construction compresses one direction of an orthonormal basis by a factor $1/\sqrt{2}$. We also give a short, self-contained proof of the known inequality and classify all equality cases: every extremizer contains a common invariant $n$-dimensional block equivalent to the construction. Consequently, dimension $n$ is necessary for equality, and positive definite matrices approach but never attain the lower endpoint. Finally, strongly convex quadratic objectives realize the extremal negative eigenvalue as a two-step expected gradient-descent update.

</details>


### [304] [A Two-Dimensional Extremizer for Relatively Inexact Gradient Descent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00156)
*Jinze Zhao*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文给出了梯度下降一步的显式极值函数，证明了Vernimmen和Glineur于2025年6月提出的猜想2.6。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究梯度误差相对于真实梯度有界情形下，梯度下降一步的最坏情况常数，验证并解决此前文献中提出的公开猜想。

Method: 构造一个在一个坐标为二次函数、另一坐标为Huber函数的显式极值函数；通过变量替换将参数描述归结为一个具有严格指定根的标量三次方程；证明所有参数不等式，导出上界的非负平方证书，并直接验证匹配构造。

Result: 该函数在每个可行的相对误差水平和中间区域的每个步长下，同时达到最终梯度平方除以初始目标间隙、以及最终梯度平方除以目标下降量这两个最坏情况常数；并刻画了一维最坏情况值，证明开放中间区域需要二维。

Conclusion: 完整证明了猜想2.6，确立了梯度下降一步在相对梯度误差下的显式最坏情况刻画，并说明中间区域二维构造的必要性。

Abstract: We give an explicit extremal function for one step of gradient descent when the gradient error is bounded relative to the true gradient. The function is the sum of a quadratic in one coordinate and a Huber function in the other. It attains, for every admissible relative error level and every stepsize in the intermediate regime, the proposed worst-case constants for both the final squared gradient divided by the initial objective gap and the final squared gradient divided by the objective decrease. This proves Conjecture 2.6 of Vernimmen and Glineur, first stated in June 2025. A change of variable reduces the parameter description to a scalar cubic with a rigorously specified root. We prove all parameter inequalities, derive a nonnegative-square certificate for the upper bound, and verify the matching construction directly. We also characterize the exact one-dimensional worst-case value and prove that two dimensions are necessary in the open intermediate regime.

</details>


### [305] [Global Output Lifting and Surjectivity in Invertible Nonlinear MIMO Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00160)
*Zhaobo Liu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 在全局正则修正反演、固定行选择与全输入秩有限终止下，任何固定齐次线性输出赋值都产生满射输出导数映射并具有光滑全局截面，该条件弱于弱一致零状态可检测性，并可构造光滑动态控制器实现任意光滑输出的精确跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性多变量系统全局反演中，需回答是否每个选定输出导数的目标值都能由某个状态实现，即输出导数映射的满射性。作者希望证明这一满射性可由特定反演假设加可检测性推出，从而简化全局反演镇定方法中对满射性的单独要求。

Method: 在全局正则修正反演、固定行选择、有限终止于全输入秩的假设下，证明每个固定齐次线性输出赋值给出满射输出导数映射及光滑全局截面。核心条件为：在每个有限区间上，状态可由初始状态与有限多个输出导数界定，且对所有输入一致。该条件严格弱于弱一致零状态可检测性。截面通过对相容光滑参考的完全提升构造，可为每个导数目标光滑地选取实现状态。

Result: 证明输出导数映射满射且具有光滑全局截面，条件严格弱于弱一致零状态可检测性；截面在存在内动态时仍能光滑选态。对已知对象，同一提升方法给出光滑动态控制器，使用全状态反馈与当前参考导数，并从对象状态初始化；从任意初始状态出发，可在任意给定正时间后实现任意光滑期望输出的精确跟踪。

Conclusion: 在该反演假设下，全局反演镇定中所需的满射性可由（更弱的）可检测性条件推出，无需额外假设；完全提升方法同时提供全局光滑截面与光滑动态控制器，实现任意预设时间后的精确跟踪。

Abstract: Global inversion of nonlinear multivariable systems raises the question of whether every target value of the selected output derivatives can be realized by a plant state. We prove that, under globally regular modified inversion with fixed row selection and finite termination at full input rank, every fixed homogeneous linear output assignment yields a surjective output-derivative map with a smooth global section. The result requires a state bound on each finite interval in terms of the initial state and finitely many output derivatives, uniformly over inputs. This condition is strictly weaker than weak uniform zero-state detectability, making the separate surjectivity requirement in a global inversion approach to stabilization a consequence of detectability under the stated inversion hypotheses. The section selects a realizing state smoothly for every derivative target, including in the presence of internal dynamics, and is constructed through complete lifting of compatible smooth references. For known plants, the same lifting method yields a smooth dynamic controller using full state feedback and current reference derivatives, with initialization from the plant state. From any initial state, it achieves exact tracking of any smooth desired output after any prescribed positive time.

</details>


### [306] [Reachability and exact controllability of linear Stieltjes differential systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00161)
*Francisco J. Fernández*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究由非减左连续Stieltjes微分算子驱动系统（测度含连续、奇异连续、原子部分，平区间表示不活跃）的可达性与精确可控性，构造演化族与跳后常数变易公式，刻画可达子空间为输入方向的本质张成，并给出Kalman条件、纯原子情形下的Krylov空间与可控性指标及Gramian退化/能量爆发现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典可控性理论主要针对常微分或标准微分方程，而由带一般Stieltjes测度（可含连续、奇异连续与原子部分，且平区间表示不活跃）的微分算子驱动系统的可达性与精确可控性尚缺乏系统刻画，因此需要建立相应的演化族、常数变易公式与可控性判据。

Method: 构造演化族与跳后变易常数公式；将可达子空间刻画为输入方向的本质张成；对常系数情形分析Kalman条件在任意微分算子下的必要性及在回归性、连续非恒定子区间下的充分性；对纯原子测度（N个正原子）证明可达子空间为B,AB,…,A^{N-1}B生成的截断Krylov空间，并联系可控性指标；分析阈值原子数下质量消失/收敛导致的Gramian退化与最坏能量爆炸，以及阈值以上紧正质量范围的均匀强制性。

Result: 可达子空间等于输入方向的本质张成；常系数下Kalman条件对任意微分算子必要，在回归且测度在子区间连续非恒定时充分；纯原子含N个正原子时可达子空间为截断Krylov空间，且对Kalman可控对，纯原子微分算子的最小原子数等于可控性指标；阈值处一个质量消失、其余趋于正有限极限会造成Gramian退化与最坏能量爆炸，达到或超过阈值时紧正质量范围给出均匀强制性；混合双积分器例子验证结论。

Conclusion: 该工作将可控性理论推广到由一般Stieltjes测度驱动的系统，统一处理连续、奇异连续与原子部分，并揭示原子数与可控性指标、Gramian退化及能量爆炸之间的定量关系；混合双积分器示例说明结果的有效性。

Abstract: We study reachability and exact controllability for systems driven by a nondecreasing left-continuous Stieltjes derivator whose measure may have continuous, singular-continuous and atomic parts, while flat intervals represent inactivity. We construct an evolution family and post-jump variation-of-constants formula, and characterize the reachable subspace as the essential span of input directions. For constant coefficients, the Kalman condition is necessary for every derivator and, under regressivity, sufficient when the derivator is continuous and nonconstant on a subinterval. If the measure is purely atomic with exactly $N$ positive atoms, the reachable subspace is the truncated Krylov space generated by $B,AB,\ldots,A^{N-1}B$; for a Kalman-controllable pair, the minimum atom count among purely atomic derivators equals the controllability index. At the threshold count, one vanishing mass with the others converging to positive finite limits causes Gramian degeneration and worst-case energy blow-up; at or above threshold, compact positive mass ranges yield uniform coercivity. A mixed double-integrator example illustrates the results.

</details>


### [307] [Certificate-Coupled DCA for the Trust-Region Subproblem: Early Structural Escape and Progressive Global Certification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00172)
*Binh T. Nguyen*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种证书耦合的DC算法求解非凸信赖域子问题，通过持久化随机Krylov子空间与谱信息，在精确一阶稳定前实现负曲率校正，并给出全局收敛与定量目标间隙证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非凸信赖域子问题难以在精确一阶稳定前有效利用谱信息进行校正，尤其是近正交困难情形下的负曲率检测与收敛保证尚不充分。

Method: 采用证书耦合的差分凸（DC）算法，维护持久化随机Krylov子空间与DCA迭代；近稳定时用足够负的位移Rayleigh商构造可行校正，否则通过预设Lanczos深度给出近似半正定证书；同一子空间为后续精度阶段选择DC曲率参数提供最大特征值上界。

Result: 证明了整个信赖域上一致的负曲率校正结果（涵盖近正交困难情形），给出固定容差下的有限终止与工作量界及定量目标间隙证书；渐进精度下目标值收敛到全局最优、迭代点收敛到全局解集；实验中保留Krylov子空间使谱矩阵-向量乘积中位数减少约2.6倍。

Conclusion: 持久化Krylov子空间与证书耦合机制可在精确稳定前实现有效负曲率校正并保证全局收敛，且显著降低谱计算开销，数值实验验证了理论现象。

Abstract: We study the nonconvex trust-region subproblem by a certificate-coupled difference-of-convex algorithm that incorporates spectral information before exact first-order stationarity is attained. The method maintains a persistent randomized Krylov subspace together with the DCA iterates. Near stationarity, a sufficiently negative shifted Rayleigh quotient yields an explicit feasible correction with a quantitative decrease in the objective value; otherwise, completion of a prescribed Lanczos depth provides, with high probability, an approximate positive-semidefiniteness certificate. The same Krylov subspace also provides a certified upper bound on the largest eigenvalue for selecting the DC curvature parameter at subsequent accuracy stages. We prove a uniform negative-curvature correction result over the trust region, covering the near-orthogonal hard-case regime, together with finite-termination and work bounds at fixed tolerances and a quantitative objective-gap certificate. Under a progressive accuracy schedule, the certified objective values converge to the global optimum and the iterates converge in distance to the global solution set, while the Krylov subspace is retained across corrections and accuracy stages. Numerical experiments illustrate the phenomena established by the analysis: negative-curvature corrections can occur before the corresponding post-convergence spectral corrections, the quantitative decrease bound is satisfied in all tested near-orthogonal instances, and retaining the Krylov subspace reduces the median number of spectral matrix-vector products by approximately a factor of $2.6$ relative to restarting the spectral process in the controlled comparison.

</details>


### [308] [Data-to-Certificates (D2C): Koopman Supereigenfunctions for Stability, Safety, and Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00178)
*Umesh Vaidya*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出数据到证书(D2C)范式，用Koopman算子的"超特征函数"直接从数据学习不等式型证书，用于稳定性、安全性和控制合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统动力系统模型（含Koopman表示）基于等式，而许多分析与控制工具依赖不等式，这种不匹配促使需要与认证任务内在对齐的表示。

Method: 引入Koopman算子的超特征函数，作为特征函数的不等式推广，定义指数增长包络；建立理论基础，并通过两种构造实现：基于乘性遍历定理(MET)的几何方法，以及可直接从轨迹数据计算的resolvent/Gramian公式。

Result: 证明相关速率可恢复Lyapunov指数等内在动力学量；所得证书可用于稳定性与收缩分析，并通过凸二次规划实现镇定和安全关键控制合成；数值实验验证了方法有效性。

Conclusion: D2C范式绕过显式建模，直接从数据学习证书，为数据驱动的稳定性、收缩和安全控制设计提供了统一且有效的框架。

Abstract: Traditional dynamical system models, including Koopman operator representations, are fundamentally equality-based, whereas many analysis and control tools rely on inequalities. This mismatch motivates representations that are intrinsically aligned with certification tasks involved in the analysis and control synthesis problems. In this paper, we propose a \emph{data-to-certificates (D2C)} paradigm that bypasses explicit model construction and directly learns certificates from data. We introduce \emph{supereigenfunctions} of the Koopman operator as an inequality-based generalization of eigenfunctions that define exponential growth envelopes encoding stability, safety, and uncertainty propagation, thereby serving as certificates for a range of control objectives. We establish their theoretical foundations and show that the associated rates recover intrinsic dynamical quantities such as Lyapunov exponents. Two complementary constructions are developed: a geometric approach based on the multiplicative ergodic theorem (MET), and a resolvent/Gramian formulation that enables computation directly from trajectory data. The resulting framework yields certificates that can be used for stability and contraction analysis, as well as stabilizing and safety-critical control synthesis via convex quadratic programming-based optimization program. Numerical examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed data-driven certification approach for stabilization, contraction, and safe control design.

</details>


### [309] [Gradient-Only Online Convex Optimization with a Single Quadratic Leader](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00190)
*Kamiar Asgari*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出尺度不变的在线凸优化算法，将投影自适应梯度下降与锥约束二次leader通过正财富过程耦合，无需预知horizon、梯度界或强凸参数，达到无对数因子的O(D√Σ‖ĝ‖²)遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习者每轮仅收到一个次梯度，且不知道时域、梯度上界和损失的强凸性参数；已有方法常依赖学习率网格、重启或对数因子，缺乏统一的尺度不变方案。

Method: 采用单leader构造：将投影自适应梯度下降与一个锥约束二次leader通过正财富过程耦合；使用裁剪兼容的替代损失，以及包含二次最小值、对数财富和两个标量曲率统计的势函数；保持O(d)状态，不用学习率网格或重启。

Result: 对直径≤D的域，遗憾≤√2·D(Σ_t‖ĝ_t‖²)^{1/2}+2D·max_t‖ĝ_t‖，无对数因子；给出同时的二次距离界，改进未知强凸情形，包括由观测梯度尺度跳跃控制的细化；变曲率下界依赖相对事后参考水平的总缺口，并明确给出强凸界的精确参数依赖（非经典对数率）。

Conclusion: 贡献在于单个leader的构造及其分析，属于通用与尺度无关在线学习文献的一环，提供无需调参、状态高效的尺度不变保证。

Abstract: We study online convex optimization on a bounded Euclidean domain when the learner receives only one subgradient at its prediction and knows neither the horizon, a gradient bound, nor the losses' strong-convexity parameters. We present a scale-invariant algorithm that couples projected adaptive gradient descent to one cone-constrained quadratic leader through a positive wealth process. The algorithm maintains $O(d)$ state, without a learning-rate grid or restarts. For a domain of diameter at most $D$, it guarantees regret at most $\sqrt{2}D(\sum_t\|\widehat g_t\|^2)^{1/2}+2D\max_t\|\widehat g_t\|$, with no logarithmic factor. A simultaneous quadratic-distance bound yields explicit improvements for unknown strong convexity, including a refinement governed by jumps in the observed gradient scale. For varying per-round curvature, the bound depends on the total shortfall below a reference level selected in hindsight. The proof uses a clipping-compatible surrogate and a potential involving the quadratic minimum, log wealth, and two scalar curvature statistics. The resulting strongly convex bound is not uniform at the classical logarithmic rate over all curvature-to-gradient ratios; the exact parameter dependence is stated. The contribution is a single-leader construction and its analysis, within an established literature on universal and scale-free online learning.

</details>


### [310] [Sharp Fresh-Gradient Complexity of Nonconvex-Strongly-Concave Minimax Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00229)
*Wendao Wu,Haihan Zhang,Chenheng Zhang,Yanyi Li,Chunyuan Zheng,Cong Fang,Haoxuan Li,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 该论文刻画了光滑非凸-强凹极小极大优化的"新鲜梯度"预言机复杂度，给出匹配的上界与下界（至对数因子）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解随机极小极大优化在新鲜梯度模型下的最优复杂度，明确条件数与统计精度对成本的贡献，并厘清对偶初始化控制的重要性。

Method: 采用近端方法，将对数代价的粗略原始推进与最终精化步骤分离；上界由该算法实现，下界适用于任意自适应随机算法。

Result: 固定预算下找到‖∇Φ(x̂)‖≤ε（概率≥2/3）的复杂度为 Θ̃(√κLΔ/ε² + κLΔσ²/ε⁴ + κ²σ²/ε² + √κ log₊(G/(ε√κ)))，在κ与LΔ/ε²超过常数、维度有限且对数项独立于G时成立。

Conclusion: 该结果确立了全局随机成本中线性条件数依赖的必要性，识别出独立的统计精化成本；对偶初始化只贡献加性对数成本，但去除其控制会使所有有限维度无关复杂度界失效，即使使用精确梯度。

Abstract: We characterize the fresh-gradient oracle complexity of smooth nonconvex-strongly-concave minimax optimization, with matching upper and lower bounds up to logarithmic factors. Let $Φ(x)=\max_y f(x,y)$, where $f$ is jointly $L$-smooth and $μ$-strongly concave in $y$ on unconstrained Euclidean domains, and set $κ=L/μ$. Each query returns a fresh unbiased joint gradient with conditional variance at most $σ^2$. Given initial primal gap at most $Δ$ and dual residual $\|\nabla_y f(x_0,y_0)\|\le G$, the fixed-budget complexity of finding $\|\nablaΦ(\widehat x)\|\leε$ with probability at least $2/3$ is $\widetildeΘ(\sqrtκLΔ/ε^2+κLΔσ^2/ε^4+κ^2σ^2/ε^2+\sqrtκ\log_+(G/(ε\sqrtκ)))$, where $\log_+u=\log\max\{1,u\}$. This characterization holds when $κ$ and $LΔ/ε^2$ exceed universal constants, uniformly over finite dimensions, and the suppressed logarithms are independent of $G$. It establishes the necessity of linear condition-number dependence in the global stochastic cost and identifies a separate statistical refinement cost. A proximal method separates coarse primal progress from one final refinement, while the lower bounds apply to arbitrary adaptive randomized algorithms. Dual initialization contributes only an additive logarithmic cost, yet removing its control eliminates every finite dimension-free complexity bound, even with exact gradients.

</details>


### [311] [Matching Lower Bounds for Randomized First-Order Methods in Hessian-Lipschitz Nonconvex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00245)
*Haihan Zhang,Wendao Wu,Chenheng Zhang,Yanyi Li,Chunyuan Zheng,Cong Fang,Haoxuan Li,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文证明了带L1-Lipschitz梯度和L2-Lipschitz Hessian的非凸函数求ε-稳定点的随机一阶算法下界为Ω(ΔL1^{1/2}L2^{1/4}ε^{-7/4})，表明随机化无法改善高维最坏情况查询复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有确定性下界（Zhou 2026）和确定性重启加速梯度上界（Li & Lin 2023）匹配，但随机算法是否能在高维最坏情况下改善查询率尚不清楚。本文旨在将此下界扩展到不受限的随机算法。

Method: 构造性下界证明：保持二次曲率可见，同时按序逐次揭示"强制方向"；利用大特征空间限制预处理能力，并通过调度-披露耦合使每个新方向都单独产生代价。针对每实例成功概率≥2/3的自适应随机算法建立极小极大下界。

Result: 在ε≲L1²/L2且ΔL2^{1/2}ε^{-3/2}≳1的区间内，证明Q_{rand,FO}^∞(ε;Δ,L1,L2) ≥ c·ΔL1^{1/2}L2^{1/4}ε^{-7/4}，与确定性重启加速梯度上界匹配，将Zhou(2026)的确定性下界推广至随机算法。

Conclusion: 随机化不能改善高维最坏情况下的查询率；随机一阶复杂度与确定性最优上界同阶，说明在此问题设定下随机性无优势。

Abstract: We establish a randomized first-order lower bound for finding an $ε$-stationary point, $\|\nabla f(x)\|\le ε$, of a nonconvex function with initial gap at most $Δ$, $L_1$-Lipschitz gradient, and $L_2$-Lipschitz Hessian. Each oracle call returns the exact function value and gradient. Let $Q_{\mathrm{rand},\mathrm{FO}}^{\infty}(ε;Δ,L_1,L_2)$ denote the minimax number of calls, maximized over finite dimensions, for arbitrary adaptive randomized algorithms with per-instance success probability at least $2/3$. In the regime $ε\lesssim L_1^2/L_2$ and $ΔL_2^{1/2}ε^{-3/2}\gtrsim 1$, we prove $
Q_{\mathrm{rand},\mathrm{FO}}^{\infty}(ε;Δ,L_1,L_2) \ge c\,ΔL_1^{1/2}L_2^{1/4}ε^{-7/4}, $
where $c>0$ is an absolute constant. This matches the deterministic restarted accelerated-gradient upper bound of Li and Lin (2023) and extends the sharp deterministic lower bound of Zhou (2026) to unrestricted randomized algorithms. Thus, randomization does not improve the high-dimensional worst-case query rate. The construction keeps quadratic curvature visible while revealing the forcing directions sequentially. Large eigenspaces limit preprocessing, and a scheduled-disclosure coupling makes each fresh direction incur a separate cost.

</details>


### [312] [Sharp High-Probability Statistical Rates for Heavy-Tailed Nonsmooth Convex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00260)
*Haihan Zhang,Wendao Wu,Chenheng Zhang,Yanyi Li,Chunyuan Zheng,Cong Fang,Haoxuan Li,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文为强噪声（重尾）下的非光滑随机凸优化建立了紧致高概率统计速率，填补了一般凸与强凸设置的置信依赖缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重尾噪声下随机凸优化的高概率速率存在置信依赖缺口，以往上界依赖 s^{1/p}L^{1-1/p} 而非更优的 s。

Method: 针对复合目标（Lipschitz凸损失+已知邻近正则项），用新鲜无偏随机次梯度；核心是一个在线不等式，将方向性波动与拒绝采样产生的总二阶矩分离，并在强凸下通过局部化保持该分离。

Result: 一般凸非饱和统计区最小最大误差 Θ(D(A+sℓ^q)/T^q)；强凸二次区 Θ((A^2+s^2ℓ^{2q})/(μT^{2q}))；上界任意有限维成立，匹配下界需 d≥⌈L^2/s^2⌉。

Conclusion: 新上界达到已知统计下界阶，将置信系数从 s^{1/p}L^{1-1/p} 改进为 s（强凸下平方为 s^2），刻画了无内部计算限制下的 oracle 复杂度。

Abstract: We establish sharp high-probability statistical rates for nonsmooth stochastic convex optimization under heavy-tailed noise, closing the confidence-dependence gap in both general convex and strongly convex settings. We consider composite objectives with a Lipschitz convex loss and a known proximal regularizer, accessed through fresh unbiased stochastic subgradients. The centered noise has conditional norm and directional $p$th moments bounded by $L^p$ and $s^p$, respectively, where $1<p\le2$ and $0<s\le L$. For $T$ oracle calls and failure probability $0<δ<1/10$, set $q=1-1/p$, $\ell=\log(3/δ)$, and $A=s(L^2/s^2)^q$. With initial distance bound $D$, the minimax objective error is $Θ(D(A+s\ell^q)/T^q)$ in the nonsaturated statistical regime. For a $μ$-strongly convex regularizer, the corresponding quadratic-regime rate is $Θ((A^2+s^2\ell^{2q})/(μT^{2q}))$. These rates require domination of the deterministic and finite-variance terms; matching lower bounds require $d\ge\lceil L^2/s^2\rceil$, while the upper bounds hold in every finite dimension. The new upper bounds attain known statistical lower-bound orders, replacing the previous confidence coefficient $s^{1/p}L^{1-1/p}$ by $s$, and its square by $s^2$ under strong convexity. The key is an online inequality that separates directional fluctuations from the total second moment created by rejection sampling. Localization preserves this separation under strong convexity without additional horizon logarithms. The results characterize oracle complexity with unrestricted internal computation.

</details>


### [313] [Joint Lower Bounds for Zeroth-Order Nonconvex Optimization on Euclidean Balls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00275)
*Haihan Zhang,Wendao Wu,Chenheng Zhang,Yanyi Li,Chunyuan Zheng,Cong Fang,Haoxuan Li,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文证明随机零阶优化中 Goldstein 稳定性的联合下界：在保证含稳定点的欧氏查询球上，成功概率 1/2 需 Ω(dL₀²Δ/(δε³)) 次标量查询，揭示维度与精度的联合障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机零阶优化中，已有下界多针对全局或非保证含稳定点的情形。本文旨在探究：当查询球被保证包含稳定点时，是否仍存在维度与精度联合构成的下界障碍，即"可解有界域"上是否仍有强下界。

Method: 构造光滑硬函数族：通过一系列局部化区域迫使算法反复估计方向；采用自适应高斯后验论证控制样本复用，从而对可保留并重复查询样本的随机自适应算法给出下界证明。

Result: 对任意成功概率 1/2 的随机自适应算法，需 Ω(dL₀²Δ/(δε³)) 次标量求值。该结果在 ε≤cL₀、Δ≥Cδε、d≥C[1+log(2+ΔL₀²/(δε³))] 条件下成立，构造球半径 Θ(Δ/ε)。

Conclusion: 该下界在含稳定点的有界域实例上建立了维度与精度的联合障碍，且该障碍局部于查询球；同一半径下的匹配极小极大刻画及无限制全局间隙下界仍为开放问题。

Abstract: We prove a joint stochastic zeroth-order lower bound for Goldstein stationarity on a Euclidean query ball, even when the ball is guaranteed to contain a stationary point. In dimension $d$, let $f=\mathbb{E}[F(\cdot;ξ)]$, assume $\mathbb{E}[\operatorname{Lip}(F(\cdot;ξ))^2]\le L_0^2$, and bound the initial objective gap over the ball by $Δ$. For neighborhood radius $δ>0$ and residual tolerance $\varepsilon>0$, our smooth hard family requires $Ω(dL_0^2Δ/(δ\varepsilon^3))$ scalar evaluations for success probability $1/2$, against randomized adaptive algorithms that may retain and repeatedly query each sampled function. The result holds for $\varepsilon\le cL_0$, $Δ\ge Cδ\varepsilon$, and $d\ge C[1+\log(2+ΔL_0^2/(δ\varepsilon^3))]$, on a constructed ball of radius $Θ(Δ/\varepsilon)$. A sequence of localized regions forces repeated direction estimation, and an adaptive Gaussian posterior argument controls sample reuse. The result establishes a joint dimension and accuracy obstruction on solvable bounded-domain instances. The gap is local to the query ball; a matching minimax characterization at a common radius and the corresponding unrestricted global-gap lower bound remain open here.

</details>


### [314] [Sharp Minimax Rates for Highly Smooth Strongly Convex Zeroth-Order Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00276)
*Haihan Zhang,Wendao Wu,Chenheng Zhang,Yanyi Li,Chunyuan Zheng,Cong Fang,Haoxuan Li,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文确定了噪声零阶优化在全局强凸、具备高阶（多线性算子范数）光滑性函数下的极小极大维度依赖，误差为 Θ(min{1,(d²/T)^{(β-1)/β}})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究噪声零阶优化中维度依赖的最优性，特别是高阶光滑性下最小化目标误差随维度和查询预算的精确规模。

Method: 建立匹配的下界（通过带径向截断的归一化超立方体局部化，论证单次查询只能强调单个隐藏坐标而聚合信息有限）与上界（自包含的多尺度球面估计器，抵消低阶偏差项）。

Result: 极小极大期望误差为 Θ_β(min{1,(d²/T)^{(β-1)/β}})；达到目标精度 ε 所需噪声查询数为 Θ_β(d²ε^{-β/(β-1)})，无对数损失；下界对任意随机自适应算法（无查询点限制）成立，并与 Akhavan 等 (2024) 上界的维度和预算依赖匹配。

Conclusion: 给出了高阶光滑噪声零阶优化的精确极小极大维度依赖，上下界匹配且常数仅依赖光滑阶数，解决了该问题的维度最优性。

Abstract: We determine the minimax dimension dependence of noisy zeroth-order optimization for globally strongly convex functions with higher-order smoothness in multilinear operator norm. Each query returns one function value with fresh independent Gaussian noise. For dimension $d$, query budget $T$, and any fixed finite smoothness order $β>2$, the minimax expected objective error satisfies $\mathcal{E}_β(T,d)=Θ_β\left(\min\left\{1,(d^2/T)^{(β-1)/β}\right\}\right)$, with dimension-independent strong-convexity, gradient-smoothness, higher-order-smoothness, noise, and minimizer-radius bounds. Thus, for sufficiently small target error $\varepsilon$, the necessary and sufficient number of noisy values is $Θ_β(d^2\varepsilon^{-β/(β-1)})$, with no logarithmic loss. The new lower bound matches the dimension and budget dependence of the upper bound of Akhavan et al. (2024), and holds for arbitrary randomized adaptive algorithms with unrestricted query points. Its key step localizes a normalized hypercube with one radial cutoff: a query can emphasize one hidden coordinate, but the aggregate information about all coordinates remains small. A self-contained multiscale spherical estimator attains the matching upper bound by cancelling lower-order bias terms. Constants in the rates depend only on the fixed smoothness order under the stated normalization.

</details>


### [315] [Adaptivity, Anchoring, and the Exact Oracle Complexity of Stochastic Fixed-Point Iterations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00295)
*Yekini Shehu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究希尔伯特空间上带单点无偏有界方差oracle的随机不动点迭代（锚定式 x_{n+1}=θ_n x_0+(1-θ_n)T̂(x_n)）的收敛速率，给出确定性锚定调度的精确权衡、拉库纳锚集中下同时最优的调度，以及随机设定下的minimax速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 锚定式随机不动点迭代（如Krasnosel'skii-Mann、Halpern类方法）广泛用于优化与算子学习，但其锚权重调度θ_n如何影响在不同算子类型（收缩、旋转/非扩张）上的收敛速率、是否存在同时最优的调度、以及随机oracle下的minimax下界此前缺乏精确刻画。

Method: 对确定性设定，分析密度为c_n的锚调度θ_n=c_n/(n+2)，在旋转与收缩算子上的渐近行为，并研究拉库纳（lacunary）锚集中构造显式γ-oblivious调度。对随机设定，采用几何批处理、下界论证与到单调包含的归约，在希尔伯特空间和2-一致光滑Banach空间中推导速率。

Result: 确定性：非振荡调度要么在收缩上多项式次优、要么在旋转上超多项式慢；常数密度θ_n=c/(n+2)给出精确权衡，旋转时‖x_n‖≍Γ(c+1)(nφ)^{-c}，经典调度为2|sin(nφ/2)|/(nφ)+O(1/n)；拉库纳锚集中下显式γ-oblivious调度同时对收缩最优、旋转多项式指数1/α_0（α_0=log_2(3/2)），且对几乎处处角度达到匹配下界。随机收缩：一般minimax速率Θ(σ²ε^{-2}(1-γ)^{-2})，锚定类已知模数时Θ(σ²ε^{-2}(1-γ)^{-2}+(1-γ)^{-1}ln(D/ε))。非扩张：2-一致光滑Banach空间O(Kσ²D²ε^{-4})，希尔伯特空间Õ(σ²ε^{-2}+Dε^{-1})。

Conclusion: 锚定调度的收敛速率存在精确的权衡结构，拉库纳锚集中可突破确定性二分法实现同时最优；随机设定下的minimax速率被清晰刻画，且无认证模数界时不存在可靠的距证；数值实验与所有标度预测一致。

Abstract: We study stochastic fixed-point iterations $x_{n+1}=θ_nx_0+(1-θ_n)\widehat T(x_n)$ for nonexpansive and contractive operators on Hilbert spaces, with a single-point unbiased oracle of bounded variance. Deterministically, every anchor schedule $θ_n=c_n/(n+2)$ whose density $c_n\in(0,1]$ does not oscillate between scales is either polynomially suboptimal on contractions or super-polynomially slow on rotations; for constant densities $θ_n=c/(n+2)$ the tradeoff is exact, with $\norm{x_n}\asympΓ(c+1)(n\varphi)^{-c}$ on rotations by angle $\varphi$ ($\varphi\to0$, $n\varphi\to\infty$) and, for the classical schedule, $\norm{x_n}=\frac{2|\sin(n\varphi/2)|}{n\varphi}+O(\frac1n)$. The dichotomy fails exactly under lacunary anchor concentration: an explicit $γ$-oblivious schedule, one per target accuracy, is simultaneously contraction-optimal and rotation-polynomial with exponent $1/α_0$, $α_0=\log_2(3/2)$, and, for each fixed target accuracy, the matching lower bound holds for Lebesgue-a.e.\ angle. For stochastic contractions, the minimax rate is $Θ(σ^2\eps^{-2}(1-γ)^{-2})$ on affine maps, and within the anchored class $Θ(σ^2\eps^{-2}(1-γ)^{-2}+(1-γ)^{-1}\ln(D/\eps))$ for known modulus via geometric batching; without a certified modulus bound no sound distance certificate exists, and a certified ceiling is the exact boundary. For nonexpansive maps we prove $O(Kσ^2D^2\eps^{-4})$ in every $2$-uniformly smooth Banach space and the Hilbert rate $\tildeΘ(σ^2\eps^{-2}+D\eps^{-1})$ by reduction to monotone inclusions. Numerical experiments are consistent with every scaling prediction.

</details>


### [316] [Finite-time boundary collision in planar linear quadratic regulator gradient flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00297)
*Kang Liu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究线性二次调节器（LQR）中策略梯度的欧氏梯度流能否在有限时间内到达稳定性边界。针对单输入可控平面系统，给出碰撞发生的充要条件（化为标量求根），并刻画阈值与收敛证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 策略梯度在LQR中用时域无限的成本优化反馈增益，但当成本只在单个固定初始状态评估时，它未必在稳定性边界各处发散。因此需要研究梯度流是否会在有限优化时间内碰撞稳定性边界，这对策略梯度方法的收敛与安全性理解很关键。

Method: 考虑单输入、正定二次权重的可控平面系统。通过成本的精确表示，推导有限时间碰撞稳定性边界的充要条件；该条件归结为标量根计算，并涵盖临界情形（二重方向根吸引开集稳定增益）。对三角族给出显式代数参数区域；用紧凑成本下水平集的锐阈值作为收敛证书，并分析碰撞轨迹上稳定裕度与累积状态Gramian最小特征值的线性消失行为。

Result: 得到碰撞存在的充要条件及标量求根判据；临界情形下二重方向根吸引一个开集的稳定增益。对三角族给出显式代数参数区域，且每条轨迹要么收敛到Riccati增益，要么与稳定性边界碰撞。给出紧凑成本下水平集的锐阈值收敛证书；碰撞轨迹上稳定裕度与累积状态Gramian最小特征值线性趋于零，但碰撞前Gramian仍正定。数值实验考察初始化依赖、临界方向附近慢通过，以及第二状态方向激励的影响。

Conclusion: 论文完整刻画了平面LQR中策略梯度流的有限时间边界碰撞现象，给出可计算的判据与收敛证书，并揭示碰撞前稳定裕度与Gramian的线性退化规律，为理解策略梯度在稳定性边界附近的行为提供理论与数值依据。

Abstract: Policy gradient methods for the linear quadratic regulator optimize feedback gains using a cost over an infinite horizon. When this cost is evaluated at one fixed initial state, it need not diverge near every part of the stability boundary. We study whether the Euclidean gradient flow can reach this boundary in finite optimization time. For controllable planar systems with one input and positive definite quadratic weights, an exact representation of the cost yields a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of such a collision. The condition reduces to a scalar root calculation and includes the critical case, where a double direction root attracts an open set of stabilizing gains. For a triangular family, the criterion gives an explicit algebraic parameter region, and every trajectory either converges to the Riccati gain or collides with the stability boundary. A sharp threshold for compact cost sublevels provides a convergence certificate. Along every colliding trajectory, the stability margin and the smallest eigenvalue of the accumulated state Gramian vanish linearly, although the Gramian remains positive definite before collision. Numerical experiments examine the dependence on initialization, slow passage near a critical direction, and the effect of adding excitation in a second state direction.

</details>


### [317] [Lower Bounds For Gradient-Free Convex Optimization And Convex-Concave Saddle-Point Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00345)
*Yuriy Dorn,Darina Dvinskikh,Timofei Loginov,Osman Osmanov,Aleksandr Shestakov,Nazarii Tupitsa,Alexander Gasnikov*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究精确标量值信息下优化的查询复杂度，给出了光滑凸函数优化的无对数因子下界，并推广到鞍点问题与混合信息访问模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 刻画在仅能查询精确标量值（甚至允许无限制查询与自适应随机算法）时的优化查询复杂度下限，并与已知上界匹配，理解强凸性、鞍点耦合、混合梯度信息等对复杂度的影响。

Method: 通过比较任意仿射切片上矩阵均值与其逆的均值，并界定自适应测量后的后验矩，证明下界；对鞍点问题使用独立块维度扩展信息界，并构造双线性博弈与强凸-强凹实例；通过归约处理混合值与部分梯度访问。

Result: 对全局L-光滑凸函数得到 Ω(d min{d,√(LR²/ε)}) 下界，适用于二次函数且匹配两个初等上界的最小值；强凸性额外引入 √(L/μ) 上限；紧凑双线性博弈耦合单独给出 Ω(r min{r,√(CR_xR_y/ε)})，r=min{d_x,d_y}；强凸-强凹构造在已知各向同性对角Hessian下仍有条件相关下界；并建立混合值与部分梯度访问的标量查询下界，扩展到独立范数与已知罚项的光滑/非光滑情形。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了精确标量值优化查询复杂度的紧致下界框架，涵盖凸优化、鞍点问题及混合信息访问，并为独立范数与罚项设置提供推广。

Abstract: We study the query complexity of optimization with exact scalar-value information. For globally $L$-smooth convex functions on $\mathbb R^d$ with a minimizer in a Euclidean ball of radius $R$, we prove the lower bound $Ω(d\min\{d,\sqrt{LR^2/\varepsilon}\})$ for adaptive randomized algorithms in the stated accuracy range. Queries are unrestricted, and the bound contains no logarithmic factor. It holds for quadratics and matches the minimum of two elementary upper bounds on that class. Prescribed strong convexity introduces the additional cap $\sqrt{L/μ}$. The proof compares the mean of a matrix with the mean of its inverse on arbitrary affine slices and bounds posterior moments after adaptive measurements. We extend these information bounds to saddle-point problems with independent block dimensions. For compact bilinear games, the coupling alone yields $Ω(r\min\{r,\sqrt{CR_xR_y/\varepsilon}\})$ queries, where $r=\min\lbrace d_x,d_y\rbrace$. A strongly convex--strongly concave construction yields a condition-dependent lower bound even with known isotropic diagonal Hessians. Separate reductions establish scalar query lower bounds under mixed value and partial-gradient access, including for outer objective accuracy. A Euclidean-image radius yields smooth and nonsmooth extensions to independently specified norms and known penalties.

</details>


### [318] [The Five-Point Case of Mordell's Discriminant Inequality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00358)
*Jie Wang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 证明五点在单位圆上的判别式最优不等式 ∏|z_i-z_j|^2 ≤ 5^5，等号仅取正五边形，解决 Mordell 1960 年五点的判别式问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者关注 Mordell 于 1960 年提出的判别式问题中尚未解决的五点情形。该问题要求确定给定模长约束下，点集两两距离平方乘积的最优上界及取等条件，作为一个经典极值问题，其五点情形此前一直未被完全解决。

Method: 核心证明路径分为三步：首先将最大化配置识别为平面点涡模型中五个相同点涡的归一化相对平衡点；随后独立地对相应平稳方程进行精确分类，主要代数步骤利用合成构造与在有理数域上的精确 Gröbner 基消元，证明每个无碰撞物理解都具有反射对称性；最后对反射对称方程解出五个物理形状，并通过精确判别式比较选出正五边形。所有符号消元、Sturm 计数和区间不等式均由配套验证脚本以有理算术复现。

Result: 作者证明了精确不等式 ∏_{1≤i<j≤5} |z_i-z_j|^2 ≤ 5^5，等号成立当且仅当点集（在旋转与置换意义下）构成单位圆上的正五边形。该不等式是尖锐的，且其等号情形完全刻画了正五边形这一唯一构型。

Conclusion: 该工作彻底解决了 Mordell 判别式问题中遗留的五点情形，给出了尖锐上界与等号刻画。作为推论，同一构型还给出高斯加权 Fekete 集以及五点复数 Ginibre 密度在自然缩放后的全局众数。

Abstract: Let $z_1,\ldots,z_5\in\mathbb C$ satisfy $\sum_{j=1}^5|z_j|^2=5$. We prove the sharp inequality \[
  \prod_{1\le i<j\le5}|z_i-z_j|^2\le 5^5, \] with equality precisely for a regular pentagon on the unit circle, up to rotation and permutation. This settles the remaining five-point case of the discriminant problem considered by Mordell in 1960. The proof first identifies a maximizer with a normalized relative equilibrium of five identical planar point vortices. We then give an independent exact classification of the corresponding stationary equations. The main algebraic step proves that every collision-free physical solution of the normalized stationary equations is reflection symmetric; it is obtained from a resultant construction and exact Gröbner-basis elimination over $\mathbb Q$. The reflection-symmetric equations have exactly five physical shapes, and an exact discriminant comparison selects the regular pentagon. All symbolic eliminations, Sturm counts, and interval inequalities are reproduced by an accompanying verification script using rational arithmetic. As consequences, the same configuration gives the Gaussian weighted Fekete set and the global mode of the five-particle complex Ginibre density after the natural rescaling.

</details>


### [319] [Computational complexity of static output feedback stabilization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00390)
*Zhaobo Liu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究连续时间线性系统静态输出反馈(SOF)稳定化的计算复杂度，证明其对于有理/整数被控对象是存在实数理论完全的，且对极小单输入情形仍为NP难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SOF稳定化在控制中基础且常见，但其精确计算复杂度此前未被完整刻画，作者希望确定该问题的难度下界与可解边界。

Method: 利用多项式时间归约，将SOF稳定化与实数存在理论(ETR)的可行性判定相互等价；引入“有效增益维数”刻画决定特征多项式的最小线性组合数，并分析固定该维数时的算法；构造极小单输入整数被控对象族证明NP难。

Result: 对有理被控对象，SOF稳定化是ETR完全的，即使对两输入的可控可观测整数对象也成立；有效增益维数固定时，可行性检验与有理稳定增益构造均可在多项式时间完成；对一族极小单输入整数对象，问题NP难，但每个可行对象都存在取值为{-1,1}的稳定增益，且这些增益在各项同时受小于一致正常数扰动时保持稳定。

Conclusion: SOF稳定化总体达到ETR完全的高复杂度，但在有效增益维数固定时可多项式求解；同时存在NP难的特例族，其稳定增益具有{-1,1}结构与一致的鲁棒性。

Abstract: We study the computational complexity of static output feedback (SOF) stabilization for continuous-time linear systems. For rational plant data, we prove that this problem is complete for the existential theory of the reals: it is equivalent, under polynomial-time transformations, to deciding whether a system of polynomial equations and inequalities with integer coefficients has a real solution. This result holds even for controllable and observable integer plants with two inputs. We characterize the effective gain dimension as the minimum number of linear combinations of gain entries that determine the characteristic polynomial for every gain. When this dimension is fixed, both feasibility testing and the construction of a rational stabilizing gain, whenever one exists, can be performed in polynomial time. SOF stabilization also remains NP-hard for a family of minimal single-input integer plants. Every feasible plant in this family admits a stabilizing gain with entries in $\{-1,1\}$. For these gains, stability is preserved under simultaneous perturbations of all entries, provided that each perturbation has magnitude at most a uniform positive constant independent of the plant dimensions.

</details>


### [320] [Fixed-Time ISS for Interconnected Discrete-Time Systems, Part I: Extinction-Based Lyapunov Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00657)
*Sumadhu Rubaiyat,Jorge I. Poveda*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究离散时间系统的固定时间输入到状态稳定性(FxT-ISS)，基于具有固定时间消失性质的耗散函数建立Lyapunov充分条件，并证明互联系统的小增益定理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有固定时间稳定性研究多针对无外部扰动的系统，缺乏对受外源输入影响的离散时间系统的FxT-ISS分析，且常用双幂耗散构造过于局限，需更一般的衰减机制。

Method: 引入一类具有固定时间消失性质的耗散函数，建立FxT-ISS的Lyapunov充分条件；该框架涵盖常用双幂构造并允许更一般的衰减机制；在此基础上证明受扰动互联FxT-ISS系统的小增益定理。

Result: 给出了FxT-ISS的Lyapunov判据；证明了互联FxT-ISS系统的小增益定理；通过扰动优化算法和离散时间反馈优化架构等示例进行了验证。

Conclusion: 所提框架推广了固定时间ISS的分析工具，为受扰离散时间系统及互联系统提供了统一的稳定性判据。

Abstract: We study fixed-time input-to-state stability (FxT-ISS) for discrete-time systems subject to exogenous inputs.
