### [355] [A Multi-Venue Solana/DeFi Microstructure Data Corpus: The RED-2400 Family v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00005)
*Arati Uday Kamat*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 该论文发布并记录了RED-2400家族v2：五个公共区块链基准数据集，由同一观察者在57天窗口内用统一方法采集，配有可复现脚本、SHA-256清单和CC-BY-4.0许可，旨在补充以太坊主导的研究范式，降低Solana与跨链微观结构研究的数据门槛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化与Solana原生市场微观结构研究的主要瓶颈是数据而非方法：现有强结果多依赖少量以太坊中心化数据集，Solana交易场所、跨链流量与链上预言机行为的公开记录级数据稀缺。

Method: 由单一公共区块链观察者在2026-05-08至2026-07-05的57天并发窗口内，仅使用免费层级和公开数据源（无付费数据、无私密账户、无交易）组装五个公共基准数据集，并提供固定随机种子的复现脚本、SHA-256清单与CC-BY-4.0许可。

Result: 五个数据集分别刻画：Pyth预言机相对中心化交易所价格的陈旧性（164,002条观测）、Aave利用率与以太坊清算面板（18,750笔清算加四链利用率序列）、现货-永续基差与资金费率耦合（244,719条观测）、Solana CEX对DEX价差带及已实现冲击（328,186条观测）、Wormhole跨链源流量带（360,714条消息）。全文报告三项描述性发现、一个诚实零结果和一项领域完整性刻画。

Conclusion: 贡献是一个连贯、可复现的基准家族，补充以太坊经典数据体系，降低Solana与跨链微观结构研究的数据壁垒；所有发现均为描述性，不作为因果估计。

Abstract: Empirical research on decentralized and Solana-native market microstructure is constrained less by method than by data: the strongest results in the field rest on a small number of Ethereum-centric datasets, and public, record-level tapes of Solana venues, cross-chain flows, and on-chain oracle behavior remain scarce. We release and document the RED-2400 family v2, a corpus of five public benchmark datasets assembled by a single public-blockchain observer over a concurrent 57-day 2026 window (2026-05-08 to 2026-07-05) under one methodology (free-tier and public feeds only, no paid data, no private accounts, no trading), each with fixed-seed reproducibility scripts, SHA-256 manifests, and a CC-BY-4.0 licence. The five datasets characterize, respectively, Pyth oracle staleness against centralized-exchange prices (164,002 observations), an Aave utilization and Ethereum liquidation panel (18,750 liquidations plus a four-chain utilization series), spot-perpetual basis and funding coupling (244,719 observations), a Solana CEX-versus-DEX spread tape with realized impact (328,186 observations), and a Wormhole cross-chain source-flow tape (360,714 messages). Across the corpus we report three descriptive findings, one honest null, and one field-completeness characterization; none is presented as a causal estimate. The contribution is a coherent, reproducible benchmark family that complements the Ethereum canon and lowers the data barrier for Solana and cross-chain microstructure research.

</details>


### [356] [Outcome Determination and Settlement Finality on Kalshi: Public State Paths, Prospective Measurement, and Empirical Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00165)
*Maksym Nechepurenko*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 本文以Kalshi为对象，用七天注册+七天随访的观察设计，区分市场对象成员、生命周期消息、终点状态和观察缺口，重构事件合约结算状态路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件合约结算是一条状态路径而非单一时间戳，需要区分对象成员、生命周期消息、终点状态与观察缺口，并检验公共终局确定的完整性。

Method: 在注册的半开区间内提取7,611,594个MVE tickers，重构普通股票队列；用REST结算时间与WebSocket交叉验证精确公共终点，并比较determination到endpoint的时距。

Result: 7,357,576个MVE对象有精确终点（REST 7,237,993、双源一致119,212、仅WebSocket 371），254,018缺终点；普通队列71,657有精确WS终点、81,037无。精确配对时长均值MVE 9.676秒、普通322.50秒。

Conclusion: 公共终点完成度广泛，尤其REST；路径完整性更窄且依赖产品族。传输缺口保留两个终点时钟但无法证明中间路径或修正缺失，结算计时器无法绑定历史规则版本。

Abstract: Event-contract settlement is a state path rather than a universal timestamp. Using a registered seven-day enrollment and seven-day administrative follow-up on Kalshi, this paper distinguishes market-object membership, lifecycle messages, endpoint states, and observation gaps. The MVE layer contains 7,611,594 tickers created inside the registered half-open interval; the reconstructed ordinary stock contains 152,694 markets at risk at the enrollment boundary, 3,477,227 already terminal records, and 11,410 boundary-uncertain records. The follow-up identifies exact public endpoints for 7,357,576 MVE market objects: 7,237,993 through REST settlement time alone, 119,212 agreeing across WebSocket and REST, and 371 WebSocket-only; 254,018 lack an admissible exact endpoint. In the ordinary boundary cohort, 71,657 markets have an exact WebSocket endpoint and 81,037 do not. These are venue-level public-finality outcomes, not member-cash observations. Exact determination-to-endpoint pairs are available for 126,806 MVE and 70,979 ordinary tickers, with respective mean durations of 9.676 and 322.50 seconds and observed maxima of 15 and 7,133 seconds. The contrast is descriptive, not causal. Transport gaps preserve two exact endpoint clocks but prevent the same rows from proving complete intermediate paths or absence of revisions; current settlement timers cannot be bound to historical rule versions. Public endpoint completion is therefore extensive, especially on REST, while path completeness remains narrower and family-specific. The exact-key historical crosswalk records earlier interim observations without changing the final cohort or endpoint facts.

</details>


### [357] [Price Discovery at the Boundary of Contractual Decidability: Terminal-Value Gaps, Trading Availability, and Venue Finality on Kalshi](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00173)
*Maksym Nechepurenko*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 本文围绕"合约可判定性"而非任意场所标签研究价格发现。历史场所数据无法提供可判定性时钟，未产生历史上可接受的队列；现转为前瞻性设计：主队列来自前瞻登记并经盲审裁定的可判定性框架，另设反应队列与陈旧终值队列，并规定20市场试点协议。价格估计尚待独立重建的首/稳定可判定性时钟与来源释放集群，禁止全网交易爬取或事后时钟替换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究常以"场所标签"界定价格发现，缺乏合约层面的时点依据。作者主张应以"合约可判定性"（decidability）作为事件时钟与分组的核心，因为历史场所端点字段无法提供可允许的可判定性时钟，从而无法构造历史队列。

Method: 分阶段设计：(1) 历史可行性分母含152,694个普通市场，其中71,657个有精确公开端点、70,979个有精确"裁定—端点"配对，但仅作背景，不构成可判定性时钟；(2) 对历史恢复结果判定为无历史上可接受的队列；(3) 前瞻基础设施调试已通过、证据登记进行中，但生产性价格提取尚未启动；(4) 主二元队列取自前瞻登记且盲审裁定的可判定性框架，需满足首可判定性时钟（精确或区间）、精确终值收益、交易可得性分类、可接受的有界非封锁交易或真实K线覆盖；(5) 按可判定性前后分为反应队列（可交易）与陈旧终值队列（已关闭），并将关闭视为收敛的竞争事件而非普通缺失；(6) 20市场价格试点仅在盲包锁定后、且仅从已接受的前瞻时钟候选中选取，用于验证数据获取、大宗交易处理、合成K线剔除、陈旧性与时钟对齐，不生成价格估计。

Result: 历史路径未能产生可接受的合约可判定性队列；当前仅完成基础设施与登记准备，尚无生产性价格数据。试点协议本身不产出价格估计。

Conclusion: 本文提出前瞻性主队列与定向试点规范，作为后续价格估计的前置条件。价格估计有待独立重建的首/稳定可判定性时钟与来源释放集群完成后进行，不允许全交易所范围的交易爬取或事后时钟替换。

Abstract: This paper studies price discovery around contractual decidability rather than an arbitrary venue label. Its upstream lifecycle and decidability clocks are specified in Papers 7.1 and 7.3. Historical venue endpoints remain useful background: 152,694 ordinary markets form the retrospective feasibility denominator, 71,657 have an exact public endpoint, and 70,979 have an exact determination-to-endpoint pair. Those fields do not supply a contractual-decidability clock. The completed historical recovery produced no historically admissible contractual-decidability cohort. The prospective infrastructure shakedown has passed and evidence enrollment is active, but production price extraction has not started. The primary binary cohort will be drawn from the prospectively enrolled and blind-adjudicated contractual-decidability frame, with an accepted exact or interval first-decidability clock, exact terminal payoff, trading-availability classification, and admissible bounded non-block trade or real-candle coverage. Markets tradable after decidability enter a reaction cohort; markets closed before decidability enter a stale-terminal cohort. Closure is a competing event for convergence, not ordinary missingness. A 20-market price pilot may validate acquisition, block-trade treatment, synthetic-candle rejection, staleness, and clock alignment only after blind packet lock and only from accepted prospective clock candidates. It does not create price estimates. The paper specifies a prospective primary cohort and a targeted pilot protocol. Price estimation awaits independently reconstructed first/stable-decidability clocks and source-release clusters. No broad exchange-wide trade crawl or post hoc clock substitution is permitted.

</details>


### [358] [Two Models of Event Finality: Functional Alignment, Contestability, and Empirical Comparability on Polymarket and Kalshi](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00183)
*Maksym Nechepurenko*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 本文提出机制感知的比较证书，用功能角色而非共同标签来界定事件合约的"最终化"端点，并论证跨平台（Polymarket vs Kalshi）的单一持续时间标量仅在多重语义条件对齐时才可容许。文中给出两平台的精确链接证据规模，并强调当前跨venue数值比较仍被阻断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "Resolved/settled/finalized"等标签在不同平台含义不同，直接比较会误将不可比的端点视为同一事件终点，因此需要机制感知的框架来避免虚假等价与不当的跨venue时长比较。

Method: 定义机制感知比较证书，以功能角色替代共同标签；将可比性拆分为收益语义、端点函数、日历支持、删失、观测等级、依赖单元六个对齐条件；区分三种估计量（精确配对、区间限定配对、标准化非配对）。

Result: Polymarket含108,638个精确链接条件、99,283条协议支付记录、92,158笔任意金额赎回、91,817笔正收益赎回；Kalshi含152,694个普通市场（enrollment边界风险集）与7,611,594个MVE对象，精确公开端点覆盖71,657普通市场与7,357,576 MVE，精确判定-端点配对为70,979（普通）与126,806（MVE），均为Kalshi自身最终化结果。

Conclusion: REST端点完整度高但精确生命周期路径可能稀疏，传输缺口可保留两个精确时钟却阻碍中间修订的推断。跨venue数值比较仍被阻断，需Paper 7.3提供盲测首/稳定可判定时钟及语义-日历注册表后才能建立真正可比的事件与端点。

Abstract: Event contracts reach economic finality through different institutional paths. Polymarket distinguishes oracle adjudication, adapter consumption, Conditional Tokens payout recording, technical redeemability, and optional holder redemption. Kalshi distinguishes venue determination, public finalization, lifecycle messages, and exact REST settlement fields. Resolved, settled, and finalized do not themselves define comparable endpoints. We define a mechanism-aware comparison certificate using functional roles rather than common labels. A scalar cross-venue duration is admissible only when payoff semantics, endpoint functions, calendar support, censoring, observation grades, and dependence units are jointly aligned. We separate exact paired, interval-qualified paired, and standardized unpaired estimands. Polymarket evidence contains 108,638 exact-linked conditions, 99,283 protocol payout records, 92,158 observed redemptions of any amount, and 91,817 observed positive-payout redemptions. Kalshi evidence contains 152,694 ordinary markets reconstructed as at risk at the enrollment boundary and 7,611,594 exact MVE market objects. Exact public endpoints cover 71,657 ordinary markets and 7,357,576 MVE objects. Exact determination-to-endpoint pairs total 70,979 for ordinary markets and 126,806 for MVE. These are Kalshi-native finality results, not Polymarket-Kalshi estimates. REST endpoint completeness can be high when exact lifecycle paths are sparse, and transport gaps can preserve two exact clocks while preventing claims about intermediate revisions. Current MVE timer fields do not identify historical version-consistent timer rules, and public finalization does not identify member cash. Cross-venue numerical comparison remains blocked until Paper 7.3 supplies blind first/stable decidability clocks and a semantic/calendar registry establishes genuinely comparable events and endpoints.

</details>


### [359] [Beyond Supra-Competitive Outcomes: Collusive Behaviour in Deep Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Execution Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00619)
*Christos Spyridon Koulouris,Carlo Campajola*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 本文用双人有限期Almgren-Chriss清算博弈的强化学习实验，发现学习到的超竞争（串谋）结果背后存在一种惩罚性机制：对手会加速清算以惩罚偏离者，惩罚损失超过偏离收益，且惩罚者自身平均收益基本不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前研究已在最优执行博弈中观察到超竞争（高于纳什）的结果，但缺乏对其是否为串谋的行为学与经济学证据。本文旨在识别并验证支撑这类结果的学习型惩罚机制，判断其是否构成真正的串谋。

Method: 构建双人有限期Almgren-Chriss清算博弈；使用独立PPO智能体，可获得回合内的价格与行动历史。先让智能体学习出低于纳什基准成本的策略，再针对学习到的平均清算计划训练出有利可图的偏离策略，并把该偏离的首次交易强制施加到其中一个原始智能体上，观察对手反应。形式化两项检验：惩罚是否超过偏离收益；交易行为变化是否足以解释所施加的损失。

Result: 在每一轮实验和双方角色中，对手通过加速清算进行惩罚，其造成的损失均超过偏离者的收益；惩罚者自身平均收益相对不惩罚情形基本不变。惩罚者以更大损失惩罚偏离者，同时保留自身收益，即便存在更有利可图、惩罚更轻的清算方案。训练中偏离匹配与后续额外抛售先升后降，最终策略仍保留有效惩罚反应。两项形式化检验均通过（针对所测偏离）。

Conclusion: 结果为学习中出现的超竞争结果提供了行为学与经济学证据，支持将其解释为一种由学习型惩罚机制维持的串谋行为。

Abstract: In this paper, we extend earlier findings of supra-competitive outcomes in optimal-execution games by identifying a learned punitive mechanism that deters deviations and provides behavioural evidence of collusion. We investigate this mechanism in a two-player, finite-horizon Almgren-Chriss liquidation game. Independent proximal policy optimisation agents with access to within-episode price and action histories achieve costs below the Nash benchmark. We identify a profitable deviation by training against the mean learned liquidation schedule, then impose its first trade on one of the original agents. The opponent responds by accelerating liquidation. This response more than offsets the deviator's gain in every run and both player roles, while leaving the punisher's average payoff materially unchanged relative to not punishing under the same deviation. The punisher imposes greater losses on the deviator while preserving its own average payoff, despite the availability of more profitable, less punitive liquidation plans. Matching deviations and subsequent additional selling rise and later decline during training, while final policies retain an effective punitive response. We formalise two checks: whether punishment outweighs the gain from deviating, and whether the change in trading behaviour is large enough to account for the loss imposed. Both checks hold for the tested deviation. Together, these findings provide behavioural and economic evidence supporting a collusive interpretation of the learned supra-competitive outcomes.

</details>


### [360] [Social welfare and price discovery in double auction markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01562)
*Teemu Pennanen*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 本文为双拍卖机制推动价格趋向竞争均衡的实验现象提供理论解释：使用"出价等于当前持有与偏好下的无差异价格"的动态双拍卖模型，证明Walras均衡恰为双拍卖的不动点，且重复双拍卖生成的配置与价格序列有界，其聚点为带转移的Walras均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双拍卖机制趋向竞争均衡在实验中被反复观测，但缺乏理论解释，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 在纯交换经济中构建动态双拍卖：代理人根据其当前持有与偏好出价等于自己的无差异价格。分析该动态系统的不动点与重复拍卖生成的序列。

Result: Walras均衡与双拍卖的不动点重合；重复双拍卖产生有界的配置与价格序列，其聚点为带转移的Walras均衡。

Conclusion: 该结果从理论上解释了双拍卖机制趋向竞争均衡的现象，将实验观察与一般均衡理论联系起来。

Abstract: The tendency of the double auction mechanism to drive prices to competitive equilibrium has been well documented in laboratory experiments, but the phenomenon has lacked a theoretical explanation. This paper studies dynamic double auctions in a pure exchange economy where agents bid their indifference prices implied by their current holdings and preferences. We show that Walras equilibria coincide with the fixed points of the double auction and that repeated double auctions generate bounded sequences of allocations and prices whose cluster points are Walras equilibria with transfers.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [361] [Weighted Data Selection: Sharp Upper-Half and Five-Dimensional Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00101)
*Zhongxuan Liu,Hongzhi Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究最小范数加权最小二乘学习中，小规模重加权训练子集的风险精确刻画，证明了风险定律 Γ_d(n)=3-n/d 在 ⌈3d/2⌉≤n≤2d-1 上成立，并给出紧的上下界与构造。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重加权/子集训练能在多大程度上保留风险是核心问题，特别是在小预算（样本数 n 与特征维 d 接近）情形下，需要精确的风险定律而非宽松近似。

Method: 针对有限加权最小二乘与最小范数学习器，利用保持全特征张成的选择、平衡单纯形锚点降维、正权提升与独立线压缩技术推导上界；用平移坐标对构造匹配下界；并用 Lean 4 形式化验证数据级上界与紧性构造。小预算 (d,n)=(5,6) 时结合电路覆盖、比较二阶矩、电路-平面概率与极面几何分析。

Result: 证明了 Γ_d(n)=3-n/d 在整个 ⌈3d/2⌉≤n≤2d-1 区间精确成立，覆盖所有观测特征秩；得到 (d,n)=(5,6) 时 Γ_5(6)=11/5，与单纯形块预测一致； sharp excess 为 6/5。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了中间预算选择问题中风险的精确定律，并建立了一般单纯形块前沿，将各结果统一联系，同时提供了形式化验证支持。

Abstract: How much risk does a small reweighted training support retain? For finite weighted least squares with the minimum-norm learner, we prove the exact law $Γ_d(n)=3-n/d$ throughout $\lceil3d/2\rceil\leq n\leq2d-1$. The guarantee covers every observed feature rank and uses selections that preserve the full feature span. Balanced simplex anchors reduce dimension; positive-weight lifting and independent-line compression close the risk bound. Shifted coordinate pairs attain the matching lower bound. The complete dataset-level upper bound and sharpness construction are verified in Lean 4. At the smaller budget $(d,n)=(5,6)$, we also prove $Γ_5(6)=11/5$, matching the simplex-block prediction from $5=3+2$ over arbitrary interacting configurations. Circuit covers, comparison second moments, and circuit-plane probabilities give the sharp excess $6/5$, while polar-face geometry resolves shared rank-three circuits. The general simplex-block frontier connects these laws within the intermediate-budget selection problem.

</details>


### [362] [Transferable Graph Metanetworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00420)
*Yuxin Ma,Adir Dayan,Yam Eitan,Haggai Maron,Soledad Villar*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出可迁移图元网络（TGM），通过不变性与连续性修改使权重空间网络能跨不同宽度实现尺寸泛化，在μP下可泛化至训练宽度的42倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有权重空间网络多在同分布（固定尺寸）上训练评估，跨尺寸泛化尝试有限且效果欠佳，导致"小网络训练、大网络评估"的效率优势未被实现。

Method: 扩展图元网络范式，基于两条原则设计修改：(1)对不同宽度网络表示同一函数的方式保持不变性；(2)连续性，使表示相似函数的权重获得相似预测。并研究独立随机初始化训练的输入网络是否可尺寸泛化。

Result: 所有任务上尺寸泛化均显著提升；在μP训练输入上表现最佳，可稳健泛化至训练宽度的42倍。

Conclusion: 用无限宽度极限理论解释现象：证明模型在μP输入上的尺寸泛化保证，并说明在其他参数化下可能失败的原因。

Abstract: A weight space network (or metanetwork) takes the weights of another neural network as input and predicts properties of it. Most prior work trains such models on input networks of one or a few fixed sizes and evaluates them in-distribution. The few attempts at out-of-distribution size generalization remain limited in scope and have achieved only modest success. Consequently, the potential efficiency gains of training on small networks and evaluating on much larger ones remain largely unrealized. We propose Transferable Graph Metanetworks, which extend the graph metanetwork paradigm with a set of modifications that make performance transferable across input networks of different widths. The modifications follow two principles: invariance to the ways in which networks of different widths represent the same function, and continuity, such that weights representing similar functions receive similar predictions. We further study whether size generalization is possible for input networks trained independently from random initialization. Empirically, our modifications significantly improve size generalization on every task we consider. Performance is strongest on input networks trained under the maximal-update parameterization ($μ$P), where it remains robust up to $42\times$ the training width. Theoretically, we explain these observations with infinite-width limit theory: we prove size-generalization guarantees for our model on $μ$P-trained inputs, and explain why it can fail under other parameterizations.

</details>


### [363] [Learning to Cover Locally: Graph Neural Combinatorial Optimization under a Hard Information Horizon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00422)
*Johannes F. Loevenich,Thies Moehlenhof,Laurin Holz,Maxime Schwarzer,Tobias Huerten,Roberto Rigolin F. Lopes*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究"信息视界"受限下的组合优化，形式化为局部集合覆盖，并以OLSRv2的MPR选择为实例。理论证明：深度L的GNN恰为L跳选择器，一跳不足会失败或仅达Δ因子；而在O(Δ)深度可复现RFC 7181贪心及其加权版本，继承(1+lnΔ2)近似。实验上3层GATv2达到cost/opt=1.030，远超贪心1.138；限制到一跳即崩至1.344。结论：信息视界而非模型容量才是关键变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经组合优化通常假设集中式求解器能读取整个实例，但现实（如OLSRv2路由协议）中节点只能在硬性信息视界内（k跳邻域）本地决策，且这些局部承诺必须组合成全局可行解。论文希望研究这种"局部信息+全局可行性"的对立设定，并指出该视界由协议强加而非模型选择。

Method: 将问题形式化为局部集合覆盖，实例化为加权多点中继（MPR）选择（OLSRv2的NP难2-hop覆盖问题）。理论分析确定性选择器的视界极限与GNN深度的等价关系（L层GNN等价L跳选择器），并用O(Δ)深度/宽度复现贪心及加权贪心。实验上训练3层GATv2，配合覆盖补全解码器，从CP-SAT最优解行为克隆；并做一跳限制的消融及真实网络迁移测试。

Result: 理论：一跳不足的确定性选择器必覆盖失败或偏离最优Δ因子；GNN容量无法买回半径。O(Δ)深度的GNN可复现RFC 7181贪心及加权类比，保持(1+lnΔ2)近似。实验：3层GATv2达到cost/opt=1.030±0.001（贪心1.138），100%覆盖下弥合79.1%差距；限制为一跳则崩溃至1.344。迁移：OLSRv2未修改代码在200/200单位成本实例上与基数贪心一致；40,308个真实营级机动实例中冻结模型在全覆盖下弥合48%差距。

Conclusion: 信息视界而非模型容量是决定性能的最重要变量。GNN的深度必须与问题所需视界匹配，否则无法弥补；在合适视界下，即使简单架构也能逼近甚至超越经典贪心，并能迁移到真实协议场景。

Abstract: Neural combinatorial optimization typically assumes a centralized solver that reads the whole instance. We study the opposite: combinatorial optimization under a hard information horizon, where every node commits to its share of a global solution seeing only its $k$-hop neighborhood, and those commitments must compose into a globally feasible solution. We formalize this as local set cover and instantiate it on weighted multipoint relay (MPR) selection, the NP-hard 2-hop covering problem of the Optimized Link State Routing Protocol version 2 (OLSRv2) routing protocol (RFC~7181), whose horizon is imposed by the protocol, not chosen by the modeler. We prove two results. Any deterministic selector whose horizon is one hop short must either fail coverage or land a factor $Δ$ from optimal, and an $L$-layer graph neural network (GNN) read out at the deciding node is exactly an $L$-hop selector, so capacity cannot buy back radius. Conversely, at the horizon a \ac{GNN} of depth $O(Δ)$ reproduces the RFC~7181 covering greedy, and at width $O(c_{\max}Δ)$ its metric-aware weighted analogue, inheriting the $(1+\lnΔ_2)$-approximation in both cases. Empirically, a 3-layer \ac{GATv2} with a coverage-completing decoder, behavior-cloned from the CP-SAT optimum, reaches $\text{cost}/\text{opt}=1.030\pm0.001$ against greedy's $1.138$, closing $79.1\%$ of the gap at $100\%$ coverage. Restricting the same learner to one hop, on identical instances with the same decoder and demonstrations, collapses it to $1.344$, far worse than greedy. Two transfer checks target real-world networks. OLSRv2's unmodified selection code matches our cardinality greedy on $200/200$ unit-cost instances, and on $40{,}308$ instances of real battalion mobility the frozen model closes $48\%$ of the gap at full coverage. The information horizon, not the model capacity, is the most significant variable.

</details>


### [364] [Target-Dependent Limits of Causal Repair: A Leading-Log Frontier in a Gaussian Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00424)
*Qinchuan Cheng,Jiaqi Liu,Ruixuan Xie*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文量化了因果预测器"潜在改进"与实际学习到的修复增益之间的差距，在高斯因果实验框架下推导出一个尖锐的评估指数前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知道因果预测器理论上能改进多少，并不意味着能揭示实际学习到的修复带来的增益。论文旨在量化这一差距。

Method: 在已知干预几何的标量高斯因果实验中，辅助数据将效应量识别到有界污染范围内，诊断数据识别方向。目标为实际训练修复相对拟合参考的平方损失增益，在均匀学习MSE η 下联合优化学习器与评估器。分析学习尺度1/k、幅度丰富区域下的评估指数。

Result: 在1/k学习尺度下，任何可行学习器都存在 k^{-2} 的评估下限，即使预言机潜力可以更快速率估计。在幅度丰富区域刻画了尖锐的前导对数前沿：评估指数为 min{ℓ_k, 2kη_k/U}，其中 ℓ_k=log(1/(k²E_k))。一个诊断-弃权规则可在未知滋扰参数下达到该指数。还界定了临界容许窗口，并通过精确高斯模拟将前沿迁移到自适应采样。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了评估目标如何改变该实验中的信息需求，而非一般性的因果可识别性结论；有限网格实验区分了符号尾部抑制与总MSE，并暴露了保守的有限预算行为。

Abstract: Knowing how much a causal predictor could improve need not reveal the gain of the repair actually learned. We quantify this gap in a scalar Gaussian causal experiment with known intervention geometry: auxiliary data identify effect magnitude up to bounded contamination, while diagnostics identify direction. The target is the squared-loss gain of the realized trained repair relative to a fitted reference. Jointly optimizing the learner and assessor under uniform learning MSE $η$ avoids the trivial solution of making no repair. At the usual $1/k$ learning scale, every feasible learner incurs a $k^{-2}$ assessment floor, even when oracle potential is estimable at a faster rate. In the magnitude-rich regime, we characterize a sharp leading-log frontier: the assessment exponent is $\min{\ell_k,2kη_k/U}$ to first relative order, where $\ell_k=\log(1/(k^2E_k))$ and $E_k$ is auxiliary precision. A diagnostic-abstention rule attains this exponent with unknown nuisance parameters. We also bound the critical allowance window and transfer the frontier to adaptive sampling by exact Gaussian simulation. Finite-grid experiments distinguish sign-tail suppression from total MSE and expose conservative finite-budget behavior. The result isolates how the assessment target changes information requirements in this experiment; it is not a general causal identifiability claim.

</details>


### [365] [ChainLoRA: Geometry-Preserving Task Vector Merging for Continual Learning in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00431)
*Hang Yin,Haozhe Wang,Yuhua Luo,Zhangqi Pan,Xiaoxing Wang,Junchi Yan*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: ChainLoRA：基于链式任务向量几何的无回放持续参数高效微调框架，结合链式更新训练与自适应SVD合并，在低开销下取得最优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型持续参数高效微调需兼顾旧知识保留、新任务适应与严格参数预算；现有方法在遗忘度量与参数开销上存在不足。

Method: 提出参数合并视角下的几何遗忘观，区分方向重叠与系数耦合；训练时用最后一个载体做初始化与单侧正交代理，保持历史状态开销恒定；合并时用自适应SVD提取共享载体，并通过Procrustes对齐最新任务；引入有效秩惩罚促进子空间高效利用。

Result: 理论分析表明Procrustes对齐可实现共享与任务特定成分的几何近似分离，单侧代理可约束任务间干扰；实验在Large和SuperNI基准上达到无回放方法中的最优，在Standard CL上具竞争力，三基准平均分接近所评估的回放方法。

Conclusion: ChainLoRA以无回放、低开销的方式有效平衡知识保留与新任务适应，性能领先无回放方法并接近回放方法。

Abstract: Continual parameter-efficient fine-tuning for large language models (LLMs) must balance retention of previously acquired knowledge, adaptation to new tasks, and strict parameter budgets. We present \textbf{ChainLoRA}, a replay-free continual merging framework built on chain-updated task-vector geometry. From a parameter-merging perspective, we formulate a geometric view of forgetting through a measurable interaction between task updates, separating directional overlap from coefficient coupling. Building on this view, ChainLoRA combines chain-updated training with post-stream adaptive SVD merging. During training, initialization and a one-sided orthogonality proxy use only the last carrier, keeping their historical-state footprint and regularization overhead constant as the task stream grows. At merging time, Adaptive SVD extracts a shared carrier and aligns it to the latest task through Procrustes adaptation. Our theoretical analysis shows that Procrustes adaptation facilitates geometric approximate separation of shared and task-specific components. The one-sided proxy further bounds inter-task interference. An effective-rank penalty additionally promotes efficient utilization of the task subspace during continual learning. Experiments show that ChainLoRA achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated replay-free methods on the Large and SuperNI benchmarks, while remaining competitive on Standard CL and attaining almost the closest average scores to the evaluated replay-based method across all three benchmarks.

</details>


### [366] [Fractional Laplace Neural Operators: Exact Architectures, an Expressivity Frontier at Criticality, and Certified Stability for Memory-Driven Network Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00515)
*Mauricio Herrera-Marín*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出分数拉普拉斯神经算子(fLNO)，将Volterra记忆结构嵌入学习映射，兼顾精确记忆结构、物理坐标与稳定性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子学习函数空间映射，但遗传网络动力学由非有理Laplace符号的Volterra预解式描述，现有有理实现难以刻画分数阶记忆。

Method: 对可交换激励-拉普拉斯对，用单个图谱层精确表示完整线性Volterra解算子；建立有限有理实现的表达力边界，给出可训练的参数化以按构造保证稳定性裕度，并给出图极限(graphon)迁移定理。

Result: 有理实现仅在紧频窗几何逼近分数记忆，无法复现分支点产生的非整数临界渐近，半直线上最优有理速率是根指数；基准中有理算子短期精度可比甚至更高，但fLNO以更少参数更准确恢复分支坐标；无约束有理拟合会穿越稳定边界而认证参数化不会；四参数谱律从规模48迁移到192无需重训，相对误差0.51–0.62%。

Conclusion: fLNO是一种算子学习架构，使精确记忆结构、物理坐标与稳定性保证共存，并保持竞争性精度，可应用于余震序列与更新模型等结构化推断。

Abstract: Neural operators learn maps between function spaces, while hereditary network dynamics are described by Volterra resolvents with non-rational Laplace symbols. We introduce a fractional Laplace neural operator (fLNO) that embeds this structure in the learned map. For commuting excitation--Laplacian pairs, one block graph-spectral layer represents the full linear Volterra solution operator exactly. We establish an expressivity frontier for finite rational realizations: they approximate fractional memory geometrically on compact frequency windows, but cannot reproduce the non-integer critical asymptotics generated by a branch point, and on the half-line the best rational rate is root-exponential. The same theory yields trainable parametrizations that enforce a prescribed stability margin by construction, and a graphon-transfer theorem separates genuine operator consistency from parameter sharing. In a common-data benchmark, positive rational operators can match or exceed fLNO accuracy on finite horizons, whereas in controlled near-critical experiments fLNO recovers the branching coordinate more faithfully with far fewer parameters; unconstrained rational fits can cross the stability boundary, while certified parametrizations cannot. A four-parameter spectral law transfers without retraining from graphs of size 48 to 192 with 0.51--0.62% relative error. Applications to Chilean aftershock sequences and to renewal models for Chile and 21 Italian regions illustrate structured inference with explicit uncertainty. The contribution is an operator-learning architecture in which exact memory structure, physical coordinates and stability guarantees coexist with competitive accuracy.

</details>


### [367] [Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Image Regression Models with Application to an Inertial Confinement Fusion Emulator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00535)
*Carrie J. Lei-Cramer,Michael S. Jones,Laura J. Wendelberger*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出ACPNN，一种基于最近邻的输入自适应保形预测框架，用于图像回归的不确定性量化，并在ICF仿真扩散模型上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学机器学习中黑箱、基于图像的模型被广泛用于高风险场景，其输出影响昂贵决策，但多数方法仅给点估计而不提供预测不确定性；加之模型内部难以获取和解释，难以评估输入空间不同区域的可靠性，因此亟需能提供输入相关不确定性估计的方法。

Method: 提出Adaptive Conformal Prediction using Nearest Neighbors (ACPNN)，一种面向图像回归的输入自适应保形框架。利用邻近样本信息生成局部自适应的不确定性估计，保持低计算成本；邻域结构由通过带ARD核的高斯过程学习到的缩放距离度量定义。

Result: 在用于仿真惯性约束聚变(ICF)的扩散模型上验证ACPNN，实现了可靠且自适应的不确定性量化。

Conclusion: ACPNN能为科学机器学习中的图像回归提供可靠、输入自适应且低计算成本的不确定性量化，指导模型开发与下游实验。

Abstract: Uncertainty quantification is critical in scientific machine learning, where black-box, image-based models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings. In many such applications, model outputs inform costly decisions, yet most methods provide only point estimates without quantifying predictive uncertainty. This challenge is compounded by the limited accessibility and interpretability of model internals, making it difficult to assess reliability across different regions of the input space. As a result, there is a growing need for methods that can provide input-dependent uncertainty estimates to guide both model development and downstream experimentation. To address this need, we propose Adaptive Conformal Prediction using Nearest Neighbors (ACPNN), an input-adaptive conformal framework for image regression. ACPNN leverages information from neighboring samples to produce locally adaptive uncertainty estimates while maintaining low computational cost. The neighborhood structure is defined using a scaled distance metric learned via a Gaussian Process with an automatic relevance determination (ARD) kernel. We demonstrate the effectiveness of ACPNN on a diffusion model for emulating inertial confinement fusion (ICF) simulations, showing that it achieves reliable and adaptive uncertainty quantification.

</details>


### [368] [Learning to Price Electricity for Optimal Demand Response](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00755)
*Jing Shang,Mohammad Mehrabi,Xinyang Zhou,Mahmoud Saleh,Andrey Bernstein,Stefan Wager*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于神经网络的上下文能源定价算法，将定价建模为 Stackelberg 博弈并利用平均场解表示，学习从上下文特征到可行价格信号的受限映射，通过美国多城市电网模拟验证，表明融入上下文信息能显著提升需求响应项目价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法无法高效利用天气、日出日落时间、星期模式等丰富上下文信息，而最优电价需随时间随这些复杂信号变化，以更好匹配可再生能源生产与能源需求。

Method: 采用神经网络算法进行上下文能源定价：将定价建模为 Stackelberg 博弈，并基于 Mehrabi et al. (2024) 的平均场解表示，学习从上下文特征到可行价格信号的受约束映射。

Result: 通过模拟多个美国城市的电网进行验证，结果显示融入上下文信息能大幅提升需求响应项目的价值。

Conclusion: 上下文信息对能源定价与需求响应具有重要价值，所提出的神经网络的上下文定价方法能有效利用复杂上下文信号提升需求响应效果。

Abstract: There is considerable interest in using time-varying electricity prices to shape consumer demand response, and better align energy demand with renewable production. However, optimal prices generally vary over time in response to complex signals such as weather forecasts, sunrise/sunset times, and day-of-week patterns; and existing methods are not able to make efficient use of such rich contextual information. Here, we propose a neural-network-based algorithm for contextual energy pricing, modeling pricing as a Stackelberg game and leveraging a mean-field solution representation from Mehrabi et al.~(2024). The approach learns constrained mappings from contextual features to feasible price signals. We validate our approach by simulating the energy grid in several US cities, and show that incorporating contextual information can considerably increase the value of the demand response programs.

</details>


### [369] [Inference for stochastic differential equations driven by weighted sub-fractional Brownian motion using neural networks and the Euler approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00793)
*J. H. Ramirez-Gonzalez*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究由加权次分数布朗运动驱动、离散观测的随机微分方程中漂移、扩散及噪声协方差的估计问题，提出基于Euler近似的轨迹似然方法，结合神经网络与径向基表示，并通过似然轮廓估计协方差指数与扩散尺度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典SDE参数估计多针对布朗运动驱动，而由分形/次分数型高斯过程驱动的SDE结构更复杂（非马尔可夫、增量相关），现有方法难以同时估计漂移、扩散与噪声协方差结构。

Method: 利用Euler近似从观测转移重构高斯驱动增量，基于其联合密度构建轨迹似然；用神经网络与径向基函数分别建模漂移、扩散和归一化时间权重；通过似然轮廓估计协方差指数β与扩散尺度。

Result: 在二十种系数设定下的相同模拟轨迹上，将该方法与两种神经网络替代方法进行了比较。

Conclusion: 该框架为加权次分数布朗运动驱动的SDE提供了统一的似然估计方案，可同时恢复漂移、扩散及噪声协方差相关参数。

Abstract: We consider the estimation of drift, diffusion, and noise covariance from discrete observations of stochastic differential equations driven by Gaussian processes. For a fixed observation horizon $T>0$ and a known initial state $x_0\in\mathbb R$, we study \begin{equation*}
  dX_t=a(X_t)\,dt+σ(X_t)\,dZ_t^{β,f},
  \qquad X_0=x_0,\quad 0\leq t\leq T. \end{equation*} \smallskip\noindent Here $a:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ is the drift coefficient, $σ:\mathbb R\to(0,\infty)$ is the diffusion coefficient, and $Z^{β,f}$ is a centered Gaussian process from the weighted sub-fractional Brownian family, with covariance \begin{equation*}
  \operatorname{Cov}(Z_s^{β,f},Z_t^{β,f})
  =\int_0^{s\wedge t} f(r)q_β(s-r,t-r)\,dr,
  \qquad 0\leq s,t\leq T. \end{equation*} \smallskip\noindent Here $s\wedge t=\min\{s,t\}$. The temporal weight $f:[0,T]\to[0,\infty)$ is measurable, bounded, and positive almost everywhere, and $β\in(0,2)$ is the covariance exponent. For $u,v\geq0$, the kernel is $q_β(u,v)=[u^β+v^β-(u+v)^β]/(1-β)$ when $β\ne1$. Its continuous extension at $β=1$ is $q_1(u,v)=(u+v)\log(u+v)-u\log u-v\log v$, with $0\log0=0$.
  Using the Euler approximation, we reconstruct the Gaussian driving increments from observed transitions and use their joint density to obtain a trajectory likelihood. Neural and radial-basis representations model the drift, diffusion, and normalized temporal weight, while a likelihood profile estimates the covariance exponent and diffusion scale. We compare the method with two neural alternatives on the same simulated trajectories in twenty coefficient settings.

</details>


### [370] [Block Optimism for Nonstationary Bandits with Latent Linear Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00911)
*Taehyun Hwang,Hyunjun Choi,Heesang Ann,Min-hwan Oh*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究带隐线性动态的内生非平稳随机bandit问题，通过块级乐观与循环近似将regret从Õ(T^{2/3})改进到Õ(√T)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动作同时影响即时奖励和未观测隐状态的未来演化，奖励是动作与隐状态的双线性函数，导致历史依赖奖励和复杂的长期规划问题。现有explore-then-commit方法仅达到Õ(T^{2/3}) regret，存在改进空间。

Method: 关键思路是循环近似：在稳定动态下，将无限记忆的奖励过程截断，把开环基准近似为优化有限记忆的块级代理。基于此提出UCB式块算法，维护截断动态参数的置信集并乐观选择块。

Result: 证明了Õ(√T)的regret界，显著优于同模型下此前Õ(T^{2/3})的保证。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个针对隐线性动态、双线性奖励观测及开环动作序列基准的Õ(√T) regret保证。

Abstract: We study an endogenous nonstationary stochastic bandit problem with latent linear dynamics, where actions affect both immediate rewards and the future evolution of an unobserved latent state. Rewards are bilinear in the current action and latent state, inducing history-dependent rewards and a nontrivial long-horizon planning problem. The existing explore-then-commit approach achieves $\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret by uniformly exploring to estimate the latent dynamics and then committing to an optimized open-loop action sequence. We show that this rate can be improved via adaptive block-level optimism. Our key step is a cyclic approximation: under stable dynamics, the infinite-memory reward process can be truncated, and the open-loop benchmark can be approximated by optimizing a finite-memory block-level proxy. Building on this reduction, we propose a UCB-based block algorithm that maintains confidence sets for the truncated dynamics parameters and selects blocks optimistically. We prove a regret bound of order $\tilde{O}(\sqrt T)$, significantly improving over the previous $\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ guarantee for the same model. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first $\tilde{O}(\sqrt T)$ regret guarantee for latent linear-dynamics bandits with bilinear reward observations and an open-loop action-sequence benchmark.

</details>


### [371] [The Price of Correlated Tests: How Strict Should a Model Release Gate Be?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00993)
*Marco Pollanen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将模型发布门禁设计为优化问题：选择所需的通过测试数，使放行模型满足可靠性目标，同时尽量保留好模型。基于两类潜因子模型，给出理论分析与验证流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统"全部测试通过"的门禁虽安全，却会拒绝大量本可服务用户的好模型，且无法量化通过模型的真实可信度。

Method: 将发布门禁视为设计问题，构建两类潜因子模型，使两类成本显式化，并把每次计算化简为一维积分；证明当两类共享相同潜相关时，更严格门禁必然提升可靠性。

Result: 最优门禁是满足目标的最宽松门禁。通过全部门禁下，任意非完美可靠性目标均可达到，但随测试套件增长，保留的好模型比例趋于零；相关性强弱决定代价：99%目标需8个独立测试，潜相关0.3时74个，0.5时5,182个，此时保留好模型不足十分之一。

Conclusion: 提出基于精确二项界、即使门禁选自固定候选列表也能用标注数据认证门禁的验证流程。

Abstract: Before a machine learning model ships, it often has to pass a suite of automated tests. Requiring every test to pass looks safe, yet it can reject many models that would have served users well, and it does not say how trustworthy a passing model actually is. We treat the release gate as a design problem: choose how many tests a model must pass so that cleared models meet a stated reliability target, while keeping as many good models as possible. A two-class latent-factor model makes both costs explicit and reduces each calculation to a one-dimensional integral. We prove that when both classes share the same latent correlation, a stricter gate always raises reliability, so the gate that keeps the most good models is the most lenient one that still meets the target. Under pass-all gating, any reliability target short of perfection is attainable within the model, but the share of good models kept tends to zero as the suite grows. Correlation between tests sets the price. In one configuration, a 99 percent target needs 8 independent tests, but 74 tests at a latent correlation of 0.3 and 5,182 at 0.5, where the gate keeps fewer than one good model in ten. We also give a validation procedure, built on exact binomial bounds, that certifies a gate from labelled data even when the gate is chosen from a fixed shortlist.

</details>


### [372] [Tolerance-Based Fairness Auditing: Violation Certification and Sensitivity Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01005)
*Jie Tang,Chuanlong Xie,Lixing Zhu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出统一的基于容忍阈值的公平性审计框架，针对"违规认证"（控制误报）与"敏感性筛查"（减少漏报）两个目标，分别开发约束经验似然检验与分裂/调整分裂经验似然检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI部署日益广泛，算法不公平引发关注，透明公平审计需求增强。实际中可容忍的不公平程度取决于具体法律、伦理或应用场景，因此需要一个在给定容忍阈值下、跨不同审计目标判断群体差异是否超限的统一统计框架。

Method: 构建统一的基于容忍度的公平性审计框架，涵盖两种互补目标：(1) 违规认证——控制错误违规声明，采用约束经验似然检验，配合最不利点校准，并可结合误报率控制实现子群体同时审计；(2) 敏感性筛查——减少漏报，采用分裂经验似然与调整分裂经验似然检验，基于自适应边界代理原则，用于早期预警场景。

Result: 数值实验展示了各方法在错误控制与敏感性之间不同的权衡表现；COMPAS案例分析示范了该框架在预测公平性审计中的应用。

Conclusion: 该框架为容忍阈值下的算法公平性审计提供了统一、灵活且统计严谨的工具，能根据违规认证或早期筛查等不同目标选择合适的检验程序，兼顾误报与漏报控制。

Abstract: As artificial intelligence is increasingly deployed, algorithmic unfairness has raised growing concerns and intensified demands for transparent fairness auditing. In practice, the tolerable degree of algorithmic unfairness depends on the specific legal, ethical, or application context. Given a prespecified tolerance threshold, an important statistical question is how to determine whether a group disparity exceeds the allowable tolerance across different auditing objectives. To address this problem, we develop a unified tolerance-based fairness auditing framework for two complementary auditing objectives: violation certification, which prioritizes control of false violation declarations, and sensitivity screening, which prioritizes reducing missed violations. For the first objective, we develop a constrained empirical likelihood test for formal settings that uses least-favorable-point calibration and can be combined with false flagging rate control for simultaneous subgroup auditing. For the second objective, we develop split empirical likelihood and adjusted split empirical likelihood tests using an adaptive boundary-proxy principle for early-warning settings. Numerical experiments show the distinct error-control--sensitivity trade-offs of these procedures. A COMPAS analysis illustrates the framework in predictive fairness auditing.

</details>


### [373] [Posterior sampling by source-space MCMC via prior-based few-step transport maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01034)
*Hoang Phuc Hau Luu,Marcelo Hartmann,Zhongjian Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出源空间广义贝叶斯推断框架，用少步iMF映射表示隐式先验并在其高斯源空间采样，配有Wasserstein误差界与高效采样器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯推断中先验常仅以样本形式隐式给出（历史集合、模拟器输出、预训练生成模型），且测试时引导任务需用显式正权重倾斜隐式先验，现有方法缺少廉价且带理论保证的求解途径。

Method: 用单步或少步改进MeanFlow(iMF)映射表示先验，在其高斯源空间做后验采样；理论上建立精确后验与学习后验间的Wasserstein误差界，分解为训练次优性与模型类逼近误差；源空间采样采用带预条件Crank-Nicolson更新的并行回火，并提出融合分裂HMC的混合变体。

Result: 合成实验表明该框架能准确高效地逼近后验分布；CLIP引导的ImageNet实验显示可将预训练iMF图像先验引导至文本指定偏好。

Conclusion: 源空间广义贝叶斯推断结合少步iMF传输与后验稳定性保证，为隐式先验下的广义贝叶斯问题提供了有效且高效的方案。

Abstract: Bayesian inference increasingly uses informative but implicit priors represented only by samples, such as historical ensembles, simulator outputs, and pretrained generative models. The same computational problem appears in the test-time guidance task (generalized Bayes), where an explicit positive weight, e.g., an exponentiated reward, tilts an implicit prior. We develop a framework for source-space generalized Bayesian inference that combines inexpensive few-step prior transports with posterior stability guarantees. Specifically, we represent the prior using a one- or few-step improved MeanFlow (iMF) map and perform posterior sampling in its Gaussian source space. We establish Wasserstein error bounds between the exact and learned posteriors in terms of the joint population iMF and auxiliary-velocity loss, decomposed into training suboptimality and model-class approximation error. In the iMF source space, we adopt parallel tempering with preconditioned Crank-Nicolson updates and introduce a hybrid variant that incorporates split Hamiltonian Monte Carlo to improve sampling efficiency. Synthetic experiments show that the proposed framework can approximate posterior distributions accurately and efficiently, while CLIP-guided ImageNet experiments demonstrate its ability to steer a pretrained iMF image prior toward text-specified preferences.

</details>


### [374] [Optimal Transport Meets Reinforcement Learning: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01413)
*Yujie Zhu,Charles A. Hepburn,Matthew Thorpe,Giovanni Montana*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该综述探讨最优传输（OT）如何在强化学习（RL）目标与算法中用于比较概率分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL算法常需比较概率分布，但常用散度在分布重叠弱时失效，而这在模仿学习、离线RL和分布偏移部署中很常见。OT通过刻画"搬移"概率质量的代价提供了替代方案。

Method: 综述OT在RL目标与算法中的应用，对每种方法分析：OT所扮演的角色、所比较的分布、所用的OT形式，以及时间结构的处理方式。

Result: 除对现有方法进行分类外，还讨论了不同OT选择背后的动机、代价设计与计算挑战等实际考量。

Conclusion: 指出若干开放问题，包括可扩展的轨迹级传输、质量不匹配的原则化处理，以及OT正则化RL的理论分析。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms frequently compare probability distributions, such as state visitation distributions induced by policies and experts, action distributions from learned policies and offline datasets, or transition distributions from learned models and environments. However, commonly used divergences may become ineffective when these distributions overlap weakly, which is frequently encountered in imitation learning, offline RL, and deployment under distribution shift. Optimal transport (OT) offers an alternative by measuring the cost of \emph{moving} probability mass from one distribution to another under a ground cost that encodes task geometry. This survey covers how OT is used inside RL objectives and algorithms. For each method, we identify: the role OT plays, the distributions compared, the OT formulation used, and the treatment of temporal structure. Beyond categorising existing methods, we discuss the motivations behind different OT choices, practical considerations such as cost design and computational challenges, and highlight open problems including scalable trajectory-level transport, principled handling of mass mismatch, and theoretical analysis for OT-regularised RL.

</details>


### [375] [Zero Flux: Flow-Based Comparison of High-Dimensional Discrete Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01472)
*Leyang Wang,Yakun Wang,Song Liu,Taiji Suzuki*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出零通量（Zero Flux）准则，将流匹配思想扩展到离散分布，用局部概率通量比较两个高维离散分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维离散分布比较因状态空间指数增长与交互变化复杂而困难；已有基于流匹配的连续分布向量场准则不适用于离散分布。

Method: 基于局部概率通量提出 Zero Flux 差异度：在独立耦合下证明中点处所有局部概率通量归零当且仅当两分布相同；将联合分布差异分解为局部贡献，并可从样本高效估计，给出有限样本误差界。

Result: 在合成与真实类别数据上，能够可靠恢复稀疏依赖信号，并在高维下稳定追踪分布漂移。

Conclusion: Zero Flux 为离散分布比较提供了理论上有保证、可估计且适应高维的差异度量。

Abstract: Comparing two high-dimensional discrete distributions has always been a challenging task due to the exponentially growing state space and complex changes in interactions. A recent work suggests comparing distributions through a vector field trained using flow matching between two continuous distributions. The resulting vector field at mid-point vanishes if and only if two distributions identical. However, such a flow-based criterion does not naturally apply to discrete distributions. We extend this principle to the discrete domain and introduce the \emph{Zero Flux} criterion, a discrepancy based on local probability fluxes. Under independent coupling, we show that all local probability fluxes vanish at the midpoint if and only if two distributions are the same. This discrepancy decomposes the joint distributional difference into smaller, local contributions and can be efficiently estimated from samples. We establish finite sample error bounds for our estimator. Experiments on synthetic and real categorical data demonstrate reliable recovery of sparse dependence signals and stable tracking of distribution shifts in high dimensions.

</details>


### [376] [The hidden advantage of mask resampling: a theory of masked autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01578)
*Jorge Medina Moreira,Lorenzo Bardone,Lenka Zdeborová*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文从高维理论模型出发，证明掩码线性重建在样本复杂度上优于无掩码重建（等价PCA），并量化了掩码重采样的统计优势，进而通过实验验证动态掩码优于静态掩码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释为何掩码预测（如MAE）能学到无掩码重建学不到的有用表征，并将掩码预测目标本身的收益与掩码多样性的收益区分开。

Method: 构建共享隐结构与异质噪声下的高维掩码自编码器模型，分析掩码与无掩码线性重建的样本复杂度；引入每样本K个固定掩码刻画掩码多样性对特征恢复和下游性能的影响；并在CNN自编码器、ViT及BERT上进行对照实验，去除随机裁剪与翻转等干扰变换。

Result: 掩码线性重建在PCA失败的区域仍能以线性样本复杂度恢复隐特征；掩码多样性越大，样本复杂度越低；标准图像增强会掩盖掩码重采样优势，去除后动态掩码在CNN和ViT上优于静态掩码；BERT试点也显示更大掩码多样性的下游收益。

Conclusion: 研究分离了掩码预测目标与掩码多样性各自的好处，并说明可解理论能指导实验、揭示被标准训练实践掩盖的优势。

Abstract: Why can masked prediction learn useful representations that unmasked reconstruction misses? We study this question in a high-dimensional model of a masked autoencoder (MAE) trained on data with shared latent structure and heterogeneous noise. We prove that masked linear reconstruction can recover the latent feature at linear sample complexity in regimes where unmasked linear reconstruction, equivalent to PCA, fails. The analysis also quantifies the statistical advantage of mask resampling, an established ingredient of masked pretraining. By introducing a fixed collection of $K$ masks per sample, we characterize its effect on feature recovery and downstream performance, identifying regimes where greater mask diversity lowers sample complexity. Guided by this prediction, we find that random cropping and flipping in standard image-training pipelines can obscure the advantage of mask resampling by renewing the prediction task even when the patch mask is fixed. Removing these transformations reveals a downstream advantage for dynamic over static masking in CNN autoencoders and vision transformers. A complementary BERT pilot finds benefits from greater mask diversity on downstream language tasks. Our results separate the benefit of the masked prediction objective from that of mask diversity, and show how a tractable theory can guide experiments that uncover advantages hidden by standard training practices.

</details>


### [377] [Error-Corrected Inference-Time Scaling for Imperfect Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01933)
*Zuokai Wen,Louis Grenioux,Weinan E,Jiequn Han*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出 EBFKC 框架，利用能量函数在线校正不完美扩散模型的采样误差，通过 Feynman-Kac 动力学与序贯蒙特卡洛实现精确路径追踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时缩放方法依赖蒙特卡洛增加粒子数，但前提是预训练模型精确；实际中数据与训练限制使模型不完美，粒子仅减少蒙特卡洛误差，无法消除端点失配与概率路径追踪误差。

Method: 面向能量基扩散模型提出 EBFKC：先推导在模型不完美时仍能精确追踪指定路径的 Feynman-Kac 动力学（连续时间群体极限）；再用带方差控制引导的序贯蒙特卡洛近似；并以预训练能量为路径上的替代，逐步引入学习终点能量与目标终点能量的差异以消除端点失配。

Result: 在高斯混合、粒子系统、丙氨酸二肽与四肽实验中，方法在退火与奖励倾斜设定下能紧密匹配目标分布与分子自由能曲线，而标准推理时缩放基线仍保留显著采样误差。

Conclusion: EBFKC 为不完美能量基扩散模型提供在线纠错机制，超越单纯增加粒子的推理时缩放，显著提升复杂采样任务精度。

Abstract: Inference-time scaling adapts pretrained diffusion models to new sampling tasks without additional training. Existing methods rely primarily on Monte Carlo sampling with more particles, yet are premised on the pretrained model being exact. In practice, data and training limitations make the model imperfect, and these methods inherit its error. More particles reduce Monte Carlo error but cannot remove the mismatch between the endpoint and the desired target or the error in tracking the prescribed probability path. We introduce the Energy-based Feynman-Kac Corrector (EBFKC), a framework for energy-based diffusion models that corrects these errors on the fly given a reference energy. We first derive Feynman-Kac dynamics that track a prescribed path exactly in the continuous-time population limit even when the model is imperfect, and approximate these dynamics using sequential Monte Carlo with variance-controlling guidance. To remove the endpoint mismatch, we use the pretrained energy as a surrogate along the diffusion path and progressively incorporate the discrepancy between the learned and target terminal energies. Experiments on Gaussian mixture models, particle systems, alanine dipeptide, and alanine tetrapeptide show that our method closely matches target distributions and molecular free-energy profiles under annealing and reward tilting, whereas standard inference-time scaling baselines retain substantial sampling errors.

</details>


### [378] [Wasserstein Gradient Flows and Forward-Only Diffusion Are Not Enough for Multimodal Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02081)
*Daniel McBride,Pratik Khandagale,Cristina Garcia-Cardona,Yen Ting Lin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文反驳"WGF/FODP采样器能高效采样多模态分布"的普遍解读，指出其与过阻尼前向扩散密度演化相同，本质受亚稳性和慢混合限制，多模态下混合时间指数级增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来大量基于Wasserstein梯度流和forward-only扩散过程的采样算法声称具有指数级快速收敛保证，并被解读为能高效采样复杂多模态分布。作者认为这一解读存在根本性误导，需要澄清。

Method: 借助Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto(JKO)格式与Otto微积分，证明典型WGF采样动力学与过阻尼前向扩散共享相同密度演化；运用谱分析与平均首次穿越时间(MFPT)分析，并针对常用的对数线性退火调度进行考察。

Result: 良好分离的多模态会导致指数级长混合时间，表现为小谱隙与稀疏的模态间跃迁；引入中间分布的对数线性退火调度无法消除总传输时间的指数级缩放。

Conclusion: 该限制是结构性的而非实现层面的：纯局部、梯度驱动的传输机制跨越分离模态需指数级时间，是WGF与FODP标准形式的根本局限，呼吁发展非局部机制以实现高效多模态采样。

Abstract: There has been a proliferation of sampling algorithms based on Wasserstein gradient flows (WGF) and forward-only diffusion processes (FODP), often accompanied by theoretical guarantees of exponentially fast convergence to the target distribution. These guarantees are frequently interpreted as evidence that such methods can efficiently sample complex multimodal distributions, often supported by empirical results. In this work, we argue that this interpretation is fundamentally misleading. By invoking the Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) scheme and Otto calculus, we establish that the canonical WGF sampling dynamics and overdamped forward diffusion share the same density evolution and therefore inherit the same metastability and slow-mixing phenomena long understood in nonequilibrium statistical physics. We analyze this family of samplers using two complementary tools -- spectral analysis and mean first-passage time (MFPT) analysis -- and show that well-separated multimodality can induce exponentially long mixing times associated with small spectral gaps and rare inter-mode transitions. For the commonly adopted log-linear annealing schedule studied here, we find that introducing intermediate distributions does not remove the exponential scaling of the total transport time. The limitation is structural rather than implementation-specific: purely local, gradient-driven transport mechanisms can require exponentially long times to transport probability mass across well-separated modes. We argue that this represents a fundamental limitation of WGF- and FODP-based sampling in their standard forms, and motivates future development of fundamentally nonlocal mechanisms for efficient multimodal sampling.

</details>

### [379] [On the Pricing of American Options under Stochastic Local Volatility and Stochastic Correlation via the RBSDE Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01187)
*Long Teng*

Main category: q-fin.CP

TL;DR: 本文将SLV模型扩展为含随机相关性的框架，用反映式FBSDE建模并数值求解美式期权定价与对冲。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在随机局部波动率(SLV)模型基础上，引入由额外随机过程驱动的随机相关性，以获得更灵活的建模能力以刻画市场相关性动态。

Method: 构建扩展SLV模型，推导对应的反映式前向-后向随机微分方程(RBSDEs)，并采用数据驱动的数值方法求解，用于定价与对冲；同时进行数值方法的收敛性分析。

Result: 数值实验展示了扩展模型的性能，以及基于RBSDE方法的精度与效率。

Conclusion: 所提出的含随机相关性的SLV框架与RBSDE数值方法能有效处理美式期权定价与对冲问题。

Abstract: In this work, we study the pricing of American options under stochastic local volatility (SLV) models extended by including stochastic correlation driven by an additional stochastic process. We generalize the class of SLV models by incorporating a flexible stochastic correlation structure. To price options within these extended models, we derive the corresponding reflected forward-backward stochastic differential equations (RBSDEs) and employ data-driven numerical methods to solve them for both pricing and hedging purposes. The RBSDE framework enables the modelling of the future evolution of the option price. Furthermore, we conduct a convergence analysis of the proposed numerical method and present numerical experiments that illustrate the performance of the extended models, as well as the accuracy and efficiency of the RBSDE-based approach.

</details>


<div id='q-fin.RM'></div>

# q-fin.RM [[Back]](#toc)

### [380] [Modelling Robust Lending Decisions under Climate Scenario Ambiguity: A Minimax-Regret Framework with NGFS Short-Term Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00104)
*Marina Palaisti*

Main category: q-fin.RM

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于公开数据的决策框架，用于在气候情景概率不可得时评估银行增量贷款配置，通过极小极大后悔准则与对称加权、极大极小准则进行比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候情景下各部门信贷结果不同，但缺乏可信的情景概率，使传统期望效用方法难以适用；需要为金融机构和监管者提供可操作的稳健决策工具。

Method: 整合2025年SNC行业承诺、2026年Damodaran行业杠杆/利息覆盖率/股票波动率，以及NGFS CLIMACRED 2027年部门违约概率调整；用一年期Merton PD作为独立基线，覆盖16个非金融部门（5.2808万亿美元承诺）。比较极小极大后悔、对称情景加权与极大极小，采用两个评分：期望损失和基于Damodaran合成利差的信贷补偿收益。

Result: DAPS将承诺加权一年期PD从0.0592%提升至0.0897%。在12.5%部门上限下，极小极大后悔相比对称加权使最大期望损失后悔降低29.1%；在信贷补偿评分下降低69.1%。敏感性分析（集中度限制、交叉映射权重、Merton输入、气候PD传导）表明极小极大后悔的价值取决于情景间部门排序是否在约束附近发生分歧。

Conclusion: 贡献在于为金融机构和监管者提供可操作的决策脆弱性框架，而非关于实际银行行为或普遍最优气候贷款的证据。

Abstract: This paper develops a public-data framework for evaluating incremental bank lending when plausible climate scenarios imply different sector credit outcomes but defensible scenario probabilities are unavailable. The calibration combines 2025 Shared National Credit industry commitments, January 2026 U.S. industry leverage, interest coverage and equity volatility from Damodaran, and official 2027 sector-level probability-of-default adjustments from the NGFS CLIMACRED model. One-year Merton probabilities provide independent baseline credit-risk proxies for 16 non-financial sectors representing \$5.2808 trillion of commitments. Minimax regret is compared with symmetric scenario weighting and maximin under two principal decision scores: expected loss and a credit-compensation payoff using Damodaran synthetic spreads. DAPS raises the commitment-weighted one-year PD from 0.0592\% to 0.0897\%. At a 12.5\% sector cap, minimax regret reduces maximum expected-loss regret by 29.1\% relative to symmetric scenario weighting; under the credit-compensation score the reduction is 69.1\%. Sensitivity to concentration limits, crosswalk weights, Merton inputs and the climate-PD transport shows that the value of minimax regret is conditional on scenario-specific sector rankings differing near binding portfolio constraints. The contribution is an operational decision-fragility framework for financial institutions and supervisors, not evidence about realized bank behavior or universally optimal climate lending.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [381] [Reverse Item Response Theory for Sparsity-Robust Ranking in Fragmented Cancer Drug-Response Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00002)
*Jung Min Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"反向IRT"框架，将癌症类型视为具抗性的潜在"被试"、药物视为具规避难度的"题目"，用于药物基因组学药物反应分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物敏感性数据存在大量缺失与评估碎片化，简单平均难以稳健恢复潜在排序，需更稳健的建模方法。

Method: 对GDSC2的242,036条药物敏感性测量应用反向IRT，在共享潜在尺度上估计癌症类型层面的体外抗性与药物层面的广谱活性；在四种缺失机制下验证，并做留出预测、自助置信区间及PRISM跨平台复现。

Result: 60%缺失下（MCAR、癌症偏倚、药物偏倚）Delta-rho达+0.089至+0.095；留出预测Brier分数在五种方法中最优；28种癌症中19种具有稳定抗性/敏感分类；PRISM复现方向一致率82%但秩相关弱（rho=0.25）。

Conclusion: 贡献在于碎片化评估下的方法学稳健性，而非提供普适的临床抗性排行榜。

Abstract: We introduce reverse Item Response Theory (IRT) to pharmacogenomic drug-response analysis by treating cancer types as latent "subjects" with resistance ability and drugs as "items" with evasion difficulty. Applied to 242,036 drug sensitivity measurements from the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC2) database, the model estimates cancer-type-level in-vitro resistance and drug-level broad activity on a shared latent scale. Validation across four missingness regimes demonstrates that reverse IRT better recovers the full-data latent ranking than simple averaging, with advantages of Delta-rho = +0.089 to +0.095 at 60% missingness under MCAR, cancer-biased, and drug-biased sparsity. Held-out prediction confirms IRT achieves the best Brier score among five evaluated methods. Bootstrap confidence intervals show 19 of 28 cancer types have stable resistant/sensitive classifications. Cross-platform PRISM replication shows 82% directional agreement but weak rank-order correlation (rho = 0.25), indicating the contribution is methodological robustness under fragmented evaluation, not a universal clinical resistance leaderboard.

</details>


### [382] [How Far is Adam from Natural Gradient Descent?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00004)
*Vihaan Paka-Hegde*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究将Adam完整更新规则视为对角经验Fisher近似，在四种损失地形上量化其与真实自然梯度下降(ngd)的几何偏差，发现偏差依情境而定且与初始优化速度相关，但不影响最终收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam是深度学习标准优化器，但其与自然梯度下降的几何关系尚存未解问题，尤其动量、对角截断、经验标签替换与时间滞后等近似带来的影响缺乏系统量化。

Method: 将Adam(含量动量)建模为带对角截断、经验标签替换和时间滞后的对角经验Fisher近似；使用尺度不变的γ(Δθ)度量，在良态线性回归、病态线性回归、逻辑回归和非凸小型神经网络四种损失地形上测量Adam相对真实NGD的几何偏差。

Result: Adam几何轨迹依情境而定：良态下偏差低，病态下显著上升，神经网络中错位达约10^3；几何漂移越大初始优化越慢，但不损害最终目标最小化，Adam始终达到低损失。改进经验Fisher(iEF)比标准EF路径更稳定，后者常振荡或发散。

Conclusion: Adam的实际优化能力可能源于结构近似误差与动量平滑之间的平衡，而非对自然梯度路径的紧密跟踪。

Abstract: Adam is the standard optimizer in deep learning, yet its geometric relationship to natural gradient descent (NGD) contains unresolved questions. We study Adam's full update rule, including momentum, as a diagonal empirical Fisher approximation subject to diagonal truncation, empirical label substitution, and temporal lag. Using the scale-invariant $γ(Δθ)$ metric, we measure Adam's geometric deviation from true NGD across four loss landscapes: well-conditioned linear regression, ill-conditioned linear regression, logistic regression, and a non-convex small neural network. Adam's geometric trajectory is context-dependent. Deviation remains low in well-conditioned settings but rises significantly under ill-conditioning, reaching misalignments of $\approx 10^3$ in the neural network. Higher geometric drift correlates with slower initial optimization but does not degrade final objective minimization; Adam consistently reaches low loss. Furthermore, the improved empirical Fisher (iEF) tracks more stable paths than the standard empirical Fisher (EF), which frequently oscillates or diverges. Our results suggest Adam's practical optimization power may stem from a balance of structural approximation errors and momentum smoothing rather than close tracking of the natural gradient path.

</details>


### [383] [FourierQK: Filter Shape, Admissibility and the Leakage-Coverage Law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00009)
*Athanasios Zeris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过受控消融实验，探究频率坍缩注意力中滤波器的何种形状最优。发现DC/Nyquist成分有害，最佳单尺度带宽为sigma≈2 bins、中心在段落尺度(~70 tokens)，可带来+1.15 nats增益；可容许滤波器优于高斯；窄带滤波器抗泄漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 频率坍缩注意力已显著超越标准点积注意力，但其滤波器形状的最优选择及原因尚不明确。作者提出五个关于滤波器属性的假设（DC抑制、Nyquist抑制、带宽、中心频率、多尺度覆盖），旨在系统性地理解滤波器设计对性能的影响。

Method: 在字符级语言建模（TinyShakespeare，6层GPT）上进行受控消融实验，测试五种滤波器属性假设。对比可容许滤波器（零均值、墨西哥帽DOG m=2）与非可容许高斯滤波器，并分析双边界FFT泄漏随频谱覆盖的变化规律。

Result: (1) DC和Nyquist成分主动有害（val≈2.0，相当于相位随机化）；(2) 最优单尺度带宽sigma≈2 bins、中心在段落尺度(~70 tokens)，较BASE-DOT增益Δ=+1.15 nats；(3) 可容许滤波器在同尺度下优于高斯，且部分抵抗双边FFT泄漏；(4) 双边FFT泄漏随频谱覆盖单调增加，窄带(gap>+4)清晰、宽带(gap<+2)泄漏；(5) 字符尺度因果时域Morlet无法超越BASE-DOT。

Conclusion: FourierQK在双向注意力场景（编码器式，如BERT）中有效，因为训练和推理时均可获得全序列上下文；而自回归生成需要因果频谱变体（如MorletQK，解码器式，如GPT）。

Abstract: Frequency-collapse attention [Zeris, 2026e] achieves large gains over standard dot-product attention by replacing the Q/K dot product with a bandpass-filtered inner product at a learned frequency. A natural follow-up question is: which filter shape works best, and why? We test five hypotheses about filter properties -- DC suppression, Nyquist suppression, bandwidth, centre frequency, and multi-scale coverage -- using a controlled ablation on character-level language modelling (TinyShakespeare, 6-layer GPT). Our main findings are: (1) DC and Nyquist components are actively harmful (val ~= 2.0, equivalent to phase randomisation), confirming that oscillatory bandpass structure is essential, not just any low-dimensional spectral summary; (2) the optimal single-scale bandwidth is sigma ~= 2 bins centred at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), giving a clean gain of Delta = +1.15 nats over BASE-DOT; (3) admissible filters (zero-mean, Mexican Hat DOG m = 2) outperform non-admissible Gaussians at the same scale and provide partial protection against bilateral FFT leakage; (4) bilateral FFT leakage scales monotonically with spectral coverage -- narrowband filters (gap > +4) are clean, wideband filters (gap < +2) are leaky; and (5) causal time-domain Morlet at character scale cannot beat BASE-DOT (K=128 taps covers 50% of T=256 context), motivating word-level experiments in the companion MorletQK paper [Zeris, 2026f]. Together, findings (1)-(5) characterise FourierQK as effective in bidirectional attention settings (encoder-style, e.g. BERT), where full-sequence context is available at both training and inference time; autoregressive generation requires a causal spectral variant such as MorletQK [Zeris, 2026f] (decoder-style, e.g. GPT). Code available at: https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention

</details>


### [384] [Integrating Fairness and Explainability in a Multiple Instance Reinforcement Learning System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00035)
*Bente Hinkenhuis,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究将强化学习多实例学习(RL-MIL)、对抗去偏与偏好条件超网络结合的多目标框架，用于学生风险预测，但发现超网络扩展出现模式坍缩，偏好权重无法有效控制公平性-性能权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从教育交互数据预测学生表现需要既准确又透明的模型以支持有效干预，同时人口统计信息带来不公平预测风险，因此需要兼顾性能与公平性的多目标方案。

Method: 提出RL-MIL框架：将每个学生建模为弱标签交互的"包"，用RL智能体选择信息量大的实例供下游分类；结合对抗去偏进行公平性优化；并评估两种超网络变体，检验用户定义的偏好标量能否连续控制预测性能与Equalized Odds之间的权衡。

Result: 基础RL-MIL取得强分类性能，但两种超网络扩展均出现模式坍缩：改变偏好权重几乎无法沿着预期的公平性-性能前沿产生系统性移动。失败归因于目标主导、条件机制的梯度传播微弱及动态生成参数的相互作用。

Conclusion: 公平目标可被纳入可解释的RL-MIL流程，但仅靠偏好条件无法保证可控的多目标行为。稳健的公平RL-MIL需要显式的梯度平衡机制、目标分离与稳定性分析。

Abstract: Predicting student performance from educational interaction data requires models that are both accurate and sufficiently transparent to support meaningful intervention, while demographic information introduces an additional risk of unfair predictions. This study investigates a multi-objective framework that combines reinforcement learning-based multiple instance learning (RL-MIL), adversarial debiasing, and preference-conditioned hypernetworks for student-at-risk prediction. MIL represents each student as a bag of weakly labeled interactions, while an RL agent selects informative instances for downstream classification. Two hypernetwork variants are evaluated to determine whether a user-defined preference scalar can continuously control the trade-off between predictive performance and Equalized Odds. The underlying RL-MIL baseline achieves strong classification performance, but both hypernetwork extensions exhibit mode collapse: changing the preference weight produces little systematic movement along the intended fairness-performance frontier. The failure is associated with objective dominance, weak gradient propagation through the conditioning mechanism, and interactions between dynamically generated parameters. The results show that fairness objectives can be incorporated into an interpretable RL-MIL pipeline, but preference conditioning alone does not guarantee controllable multi-objective behavior. Robust fair RL-MIL therefore requires explicit mechanisms for gradient balancing, objective separation, and stability analysis.

</details>


### [385] [Fast Polynomial Transcendentals for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00049)
*Robert Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 测试短多项式程序能否加速LLM中的SFU操作，用3-4次BF16多项式替换sigmoid/tanh/SiLU，在GB200上获得吞吐提升且训练损失差异小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU各代在矩阵、特殊函数和内存管线上以不同速率扩展，导致硬件演进中内核瓶颈发生转移。FlashAttention-4在Blackwell上暴露了注意力内部的这种不平衡，作者据此假设短多项式程序也能加速LLM中其他SFU操作。

Method: 先做隔离的FP16实验，比较原生PyTorch与packed FMA多项式程序，覆盖L2常驻与HBM常驻工作集；再用3次或4次BF16多项式替换四种GB200任务中的原生sigmoid、tanh、SiLU（dense SiLU、tanh-softcapped attention、sigmoid attention、routed-expert SwiGLU），多项式结合解析对称性、目标格式舍入及消费内核内的packed算术。

Result: 隔离路径在L2提升1.19–2.19x，HBM提升1.00–1.70x。dense-SiLU、tanh-softcapped attention和routed-expert替换分别提升完整训练步吞吐2.7%、2.9%和8.0%；sigmoid-attention替换提升完整注意力前向7.4%、完整GPU步0.3%。约1000亿token时，四项任务最终平滑训练损失差异（多项式减原生）在−0.107到+0.079之间。

Conclusion: 短BF16多项式可有效替代原生SFU操作，在保持模型行为基本不变（训练损失差异小）的同时显著提升部分LLM任务的训练吞吐，且经同检查点开权重消融与配对预训练对比验证。

Abstract: Graphics processing unit (GPU) generations scale matrix, special-function, and memory pipelines at different rates, so kernel bottlenecks move as hardware evolves. FlashAttention-4 exposed this imbalance inside attention on NVIDIA Blackwell. We test whether short polynomial programs can accelerate other special-function-unit (SFU) operations in large language models (LLMs). We first compare native PyTorch evaluation with packed fused multiply--add (FMA) programs in an isolated IEEE binary16 (FP16) sweep spanning L2-resident and high-bandwidth-memory (HBM)-resident working sets. We then replace native sigmoid, tanh, and sigmoid linear unit (SiLU) with degree-3 or degree-4 bfloat16 (BF16) programs in four GB200 integration tasks: dense SiLU, tanh-softcapped attention, sigmoid attention, and routed-expert Swish-gated linear unit (SwiGLU). The programs combine analytical symmetry, target-format rounding, and packed arithmetic inside consuming kernels. The isolated paths improve by 1.19--2.19x in L2 and 1.00--1.70x in HBM. The dense-SiLU, tanh-softcapped-attention, and routed-expert substitutions improve complete training-step throughput by 2.7\%, 2.9\%, and 8.0\%, respectively. The sigmoid-attention substitution improves complete-attention forward by 7.4\% and the complete GPU step by 0.3\%. Same-checkpoint open-weight ablations and one paired pre-training comparison per task extend the evaluation to model behavior. At common horizons near 100 billion tokens, the final smoothed training-loss differences (polynomial minus native) range from $-0.107$ to $+0.079$ across the four tasks.

</details>


### [386] [SW-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Stieltjes-Wigert q-Orthogonal Polynomials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00050)
*Amirhosein Azarpour,Seyyed Moein Kazemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SW-KAN，用定义于(0,∞)的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式替换固定激活，解决多项式型KAN的域不匹配问题，并实现高精度高效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KAN以边上可学习的一元函数替代固定节点激活，提升可解释性与参数效率。但基于多项式的KAN存在域不匹配：输入为无界实数，而正交多项式基定义在有界或半无限支撑上。该问题尚未被充分研究。

Method: 采用定义在半无限域(0,∞)的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式构建KAN；引入平滑的tanh指数映射稳定桥接域鸿沟并保持良好梯度条件；利用数值稳定的三项递推公式以O(N)复杂度求值，且无需调用特殊函数。多项式具有对数正态权重结构和可学习q参数作为归纳偏置。

Result: 在图像分类与连续函数逼近任务上，SW-KAN取得更优的精度-效率权衡；在特征维度降低、训练数据受限等资源受限条件下表现稳健；在标准基准上超越已有多项式KAN基线，并能以极少参数逼近复杂多元函数。

Conclusion: SW-KAN通过域匹配的q-正交多项式、稳定映射与高效递推，在资源受限场景下展现出强表征能力与效率优势，是高效函数逼近与分类的有力替代方案。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a paradigmatic shift in deep learning by replacing fixed node activations with learnable univariate functions on edges, offering enhanced interpretability and parameter efficiency. While recent polynomial-based KAN variants have addressed the computational overhead of original B-spline implementations, they introduce a fundamental yet underexplored challenge: the domain mismatch between unbounded real-valued inputs and the bounded or semi-infinite support of orthogonal polynomial bases. To address this limitation, we propose the Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (SW-KAN), a novel architecture that employs Stieltjes-Wigert q-orthogonal polynomials defined on the semi-infinite domain (0, infinity). We introduce a smooth exponential-of-tanh mapping that stably bridges the domain gap while preserving well-conditioned gradients, and leverage a numerically stable three-term recurrence that evaluates polynomial expansions in O(N) operations without special-function calls. Through comprehensive experiments spanning image classification and continuous function approximation, we demonstrate that SW-KAN achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across diverse tasks. The log-normal weight structure and learnable q-parameter of Stieltjes-Wigert polynomials provide a distinct inductive bias that enables robust performance under resource-constrained conditions, including reduced feature dimensionality and limited training data. The proposed architecture not only outperforms established polynomial KAN baselines on standard benchmarks but also exhibits strong representational capacity for approximating complex multivariate functions with remarkably few parameters, making it a compelling alternative for efficient function approximation and classification in resource-constrained settings.

</details>


### [387] [Format-Aware Fusion for Fast FP4 Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00053)
*Robert Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"格式感知融合"方法，让FP4量化的生产者与缩放域、消费者布局协同设计，实现Llama-3 8B高效预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FP4 Tensor Core虽能加速矩阵乘法，但缩放计算、操作数打包、布局构建及反向状态保存会抵消收益，需要整体协同设计。

Method: 对每类量化生产者与缩放域、消费者布局协同设计，覆盖native mxfp4、global nvfp4及CTA-local nvfp4；采用bf16输出投影、编译交叉熵、行梯度随机舍入及固定符号32值Hadamard权重梯度预处理。

Result: 在1600亿token的Llama-3 8B预训练中，bf16与TE nvfp4为18.8K和27.6K tokens/s/GPU，最快自定义路线达37.9K；mxfp4方案达37.2K（86.3% bf16模型FLOP利用率），训练损失终点高2.11%。

Conclusion: FP4效果取决于缩放契约、操作数与执行路径的联合作用，且下游任务排名与训练损失排名并不一致。

Abstract: Four-bit floating-point (FP4) Tensor Cores accelerate matrix multiplication, but scale computation, operand packing, layout construction, and saved backward state can erase the gain. We present \emph{format-aware fusion}, which co-designs each quantization producer with its scale domain and consumer layout for native \mxfp{}, global \nvfp{}, and cooperative-thread-array-local \nvfp{}. We evaluate Llama-3-family 8B pretraining through 160 billion tokens using bfloat16 output projections and compiled cross entropy. In matched same-accelerator probes, bfloat16 and Transformer Engine \nvfp{} reach 18.8K and 27.6K tokens/s/GPU, while our fastest custom route reaches 37.9K. \mxfp{} with row-gradient stochastic rounding and fixed-sign 32-value Hadamard weight-gradient preconditioning reaches 37.2K tokens/s/GPU (86.3\% bfloat16 model FLOP utilization) and ends 2.11\% above the raw bfloat16 training-loss endpoint. A Transformer Engine recipe with four final bfloat16 blocks ends 0.87\% above bfloat16 at 27.1K tokens/s/GPU. Downstream rankings differ from training-loss rankings, showing that FP4 outcomes depend jointly on scale contract, operand, and execution path.

</details>


### [388] ["very likely" Means "uncertain"? How LLMs Diverge from Humans in Linguistic Uncertainty Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00083)
*Jinhao Duan,Zicheng Liu,Zijie Liu,Kaidi Xu,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究LLM的言语不确定性量化，提出METHODNAME算法，通过学习最优不确定性映射揭示人机置信语义差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数LLM不确定性量化依赖似然或一致性信号，忽视人类通过言语标记表达不确定性的能力，缺乏认知视角的人机对比。

Method: 整理心理学与决策科学的言语不确定性标记语料，据此基准测试LLM；提出METHODNAME——基于优化的算法，直接从LLM输出学习标记到不确定性的最优映射，而非重复采样估计。

Result: LLM编码的言语不确定性数值水平与人类显著不同；METHODNAME能发现每个言语标记应传达的概率质量，揭示人机置信语义的系统性差异。

Conclusion: 言语标记可可靠量化LLM不确定性，METHODNAME实现标记层面的人机置信语义直接对比，解耦不匹配并揭示系统性差异。

Abstract: Humans express uncertainty verbally via markers (e.g., "possible," "likely"), yet most LLM uncertainty quantification (UQ) relies on costing likelihood- or consistency-based signals. From a cognitive perspective, accurate verbal uncertainty reflects metacognitive monitoring, representing knowledge boundaries ("knowing that you don't know") to support regulation and information seeking. In this paper, we investigate how LLMs diverge from humans in verbal uncertainty quantification and whether verbal markers can reliably quantify LLM uncertainty. We curate a corpus of human uncertainty markers from psychology and decision-science literature and benchmark LLMs against it. We observe that LLMs encode verbal uncertainty with numerical levels that differ substantially from those of humans. We then introduce METHODNAME, a novel optimization-based algorithm that learns an optimal uncertainty profile over uncertainty markers directly from LLM outputs. By fitting a marker-uncertainty mapping to best explain empirical correctness, METHODNAME discovers how much probability mass each verbal marker should convey, rather than estimating uncertainty via repeated sampling. METHODNAME enables a direct, marker-level comparison of confidence semantics between humans and LLMs, disentangling mismatch and revealing systematic confidence disparities in verbal expressions.

</details>


### [389] [Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00094)
*Pranav Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文区分了智能体记忆的学习、源校准与修正认证，证明学习与认证有用决策所需的样本量可比源校准二次级更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于信念的智能体记忆需要可靠的当前状态决策，但其证据可能有噪声、被复制或过期；核心问题是记忆是否必须先校准来源才能改进决策。

Method: 在一个四模型隐马尔可夫族上分离学习、校准和修正认证；在未知身份加背景报告通道下刻画政策改进的锐利可识别区间，并利用可观察见证区域导出有限样本证书；进一步扩展到有界历史依赖误设与条件复制场景。

Result: 学习未知贝叶斯决策需Theta(l^-2)记录，认证其相对信息性基线的改进为O(l^-2)新记录，而固定精度源估计需Theta(l^-4)。实验在45,000条可变状态历史和9,000个MiniGrid episode上测试，新证书接受9/9对常数基线的改进、4/9对last-write-wins的改进，旧证书则无一通过。

Conclusion: 结果为“记忆决策可在不恢复源可靠性的情况下被学习与证明”提供了统计解释，而非提出普遍更优的记忆算法。

Abstract: Belief-based agent memory needs reliable decisions about current state, yet its evidence may be noisy, copied, or stale. Must a memory calibrate its sources before it can improve its decisions? We separate learning, calibration, and revision certification. On one four-model hidden Markov family, learning an unknown Bayes decision requires Theta(l^-2) records and certifying its improvement over an informative incumbent takes O(l^-2) fresh records from the same observation law, while fixed-precision source estimation requires Theta(l^-4) as persistence l vanishes. Thus learning and certifying useful decisions can require quadratically fewer records than source calibration. A broader model class retains the decision rate and source lower bound. Under an unknown identity-plus-background report channel, we characterize the sharp identified interval for policy improvement and derive a finite-sample certificate using observable witness regions, without pure-class anchors. A robustness extension tolerates bounded history-dependent misspecification and conditional copying; split-trained witnesses apply to arbitrary history spaces with explicit power conditions. We integrate policy-bound receipts with Nous Dimensions and test 45,000 held-out mutable-state histories and 9,000 episodes in three external MiniGrid memory environments with an introduced noisy-report interface. The new certificate accepts 9/9 improvements over a constant incumbent and 4/9 over last-write-wins, versus none for the earlier certificate in MiniGrid. Strong established inference baselines remain competitive or better. The result is a statistical account of when memory decisions can be learned and justified without recovering source reliability, not a universally superior memory algorithm.

</details>


### [390] [One Mastery Threshold Does Not Fit All Knowledge Tracing Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00095)
*Xianghui Meng,Yujing Zhang,Jionghao Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 掌握阈值与知识追踪(KT)模型强耦合：同一阈值在不同模型下不代表相同掌握水平，更换模型或教学优先级时须重新校准阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 辅导系统用掌握阈值决定学生何时停止练习并进阶，但同一数值阈值在不同KT模型下会产生截然不同的决策，缺乏对阈值敏感性和跨模型可比性的系统评估。

Method: 在4个公开教育数据集上比较6种KT模型，评估0.50–0.99共12个阈值，使用进阶后表现、进阶覆盖率、练习负担及不同先前表现群体间的差异作为指标，并在30种预设教学情境下寻找平衡阈值。

Result: BKT对阈值变化相对不敏感，神经模型随阈值升高显著变得更具选择性；部分源于BKT估计潜在掌握概率而神经模型预测下一次作答正确概率，故同一截断含义不同。最优平衡阈值随模型与情境大幅变化，半数情境中神经模型与BKT所选阈值相差超过0.10；更严格阈值并不能可靠缩小表现差距，反而可能限制进阶，强先前表现学生的进阶率可达弱者的3.26倍。

Conclusion: 掌握阈值应随KT模型或教学优先级变化而重新校准，并需从表现、练习、进阶与机会获取四方面综合评估其效果。

Abstract: Tutoring systems use mastery thresholds to decide when students can stop practicing and advance, but the same numerical threshold can lead to very different decisions when the underlying knowledge tracing (KT) model changes. We examine six KT models across four public educational datasets and evaluate 12 thresholds from 0.50 to 0.99 using post-advancement performance, advancement coverage, practice burden, and disparities across prior-performance groups. We also identify thresholds that balance performance, extra practice, and advancement under 30 predefined instructional settings. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) is relatively insensitive to threshold changes, while neural models become much more selective as thresholds increase. This partly reflects different model outputs: BKT estimates latent mastery probability, whereas neural models estimate the probability of a correct next response, so the same cutoff does not represent the same level of mastery. The best-balanced threshold varied substantially across models and settings. In half of the tested settings, neural models and BKT differed by more than 0.10 in their selected thresholds, although this gap became smaller when greater priority was placed on reducing extra practice and allowing more students to advance. Stricter thresholds also did not reliably reduce performance gaps and could disproportionately restrict advancement, with stronger-prior students advancing up to 3.26 times as often as weaker-prior students. These results show that mastery thresholds should be recalibrated when the KT model or instructional priorities change and evaluated by their effects on performance, practice, advancement, and access.

</details>


### [391] [Uncertainty-Aware Learning from Multi-Expert Interval Targets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00102)
*Samira Alkaee Taleghan,Younghyun Koo,Andrew P. Barrett,Farnoush Banaei-Kashani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出保留个体专家区间的概率建模方法，分离标签内不精确与专家间差异，并引入分解匹配对齐预测不确定性来源，在海冰浓度上MAE降低31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
