Result: 有效电阻被逆度数主导，随共表达过滤网络增大退化加深(Spearman -0.955)；残差在所有24个网络中超过保度零图。控制变量后，残差在19/24网络中解释额外损失，随深度单调增强，增量达0.37%方差(为置换下限5.6倍，而保度零世界重训仅为1.5倍)。选择性预测提升可忽略。

Conclusion: 该信号可复现，但受度数退化限制，对选择性预测的实际增益有限。

Abstract: Protein function annotation needs to know which predictions to distrust, not only what a model predicts. We ask whether tissue-specific interaction structure carries that information. Our candidate signal is effective resistance, used previously to relieve over-squashing by rewiring. Across 24 tissue-specific interactomes it is dominated by inverse degree, and the degeneration deepens as the co-expression filtered network grows, with a Spearman correlation of -0.955. The residual departure from that limit exceeds degree-preserving null graphs in all 24 networks. Controlling for predictive entropy, degree, annotation cardinality, local structure and feature-only difficulty, the residual explains additional per-node loss in 19 of 24 held-out networks once a permutation floor is subtracted, at every depth, and the effect strengthens monotonically with depth. The increment reaches 0.37% of the variance the controls leave unexplained, 5.6 times a permutation floor, against 1.5 times when the model is retrained in a degree-preserving null world. Selective prediction improves negligibly. The signal is reproducible; degree degeneration bounds it.

</details>


### [644] [From Gradients to Capabilities: Understanding Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02179)
*Siqi Zhu,Suozhi Huang,Kaixuan Zhang,Yuheng Yang,Zhanyang Jin,Yihang Sun,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多教师on-policy蒸馏(MOPD)中教师信号如何影响参数变化，发现损失平均、Adam一阶矩、BF16舍入和KL梯度方式都会显著影响学生模型的学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MOPD旨在将多个RL训练教师的优势整合到单个学生模型中，但教师信号如何影响参数变化尚不清楚，因此需要系统研究。

Method: 以Qwen3-1.7B为学生，使用从同一初始化训练的四个领域RL教师，比较梯度、优化器更新和任务学习曲线，并辅以SmolLM3-3B诊断。

Result: 1) 损失平均隐式加权响应，token平均偏向更长响应，均衡领域贡献后仍保留域内加权；2) Adam一阶矩缩小参数更新差异，教师间余弦相似度0.83，平均规则间0.96；3) BF16舍入隐藏小变化，约97% FP32主权重偏离初始化，但仅7-11% BF16权重偏离；4) top-64交集KL梯度与Qwen全词表梯度接近，但任务性能依赖平均方式：响应平均下数学准确率高2.6分，全局token平均下低2.1分。

Conclusion: 教师信号受损失平均、Adam优化器、数值精度和梯度方式多重影响；蒸馏设计需谨慎选择平均策略与梯度计算方式。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) aims to combine the strengths of RL-trained teachers in a single student, but how teacher signals affect parameter changes remains underexplored. We study Qwen3-1.7B with four domain teachers trained with RL from the same initialization as the student, comparing gradients, optimizer updates, and task learning curves, with additional SmolLM3-3B diagnostics. We find that several factors influence teacher signals. First, loss averaging implicitly weights responses: token averaging favors longer responses, and equalizing domain contributions retains this weighting within domains. Second, Adam's first moment reduces differences in parameter updates: the cosine similarity is 0.83 between teachers and 0.96 between averaging rules, despite differences in raw gradients. Third, BF16 rounding hides small changes: about 97\% of FP32 master weights differ from initialization, but only 7--11\% of BF16 weights do. Finally, the top-64 intersection KL gradient closely matches Qwen's full-vocabulary gradient, but the effect on task performance depends on averaging: mathematics accuracy is 2.6 points higher than with sampled-token policy-gradient (PG) under response averaging and 2.1 points lower under global token averaging.

</details>


### [645] [SoftServe: A Scalable Quasi-Newton Method for Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02182)
*Joohwan Ko,Tetiana Parshakova,Diana Cai,Robert M. Gower*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SoftServe是一类用于深度学习的准牛顿方法，无需线搜索或曲率修正，能从变分目标中获得正定曲率估计，支持对角与Kronecker分解变体，并用耦合Newton-Schulz迭代实现高效矩阵运算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准牛顿方法在凸优化中很有效，但深度学习中受限于非凸性与超大参数量，传统方法需要线搜索或曲率修正，难以扩展。

Method: 基于Berglund等人(2025)的变分目标推导正定曲率估计，即使存在负曲率也适用；提出对角和Kronecker因式分解变体以保持正定性并扩展到大规模网络；采用稳定的耦合Newton-Schulz迭代替代矩阵分解，用GPU友好的矩阵乘法实现矩阵运算。

Result: 在病态严重的问题上表现优异，包括循环网络、深度自编码器、物理信息神经网络及1.36亿参数的物理信息扩散模型，通常比Adam、Muon和SOAP等基线获得更低损失。

Conclusion: SoftServe克服了准牛顿方法在深度学习中的非凸和大规模障碍，无需线搜索或曲率修正，可扩展到超大规模模型并在病态问题上超越主流优化器。

Abstract: Quasi-Newton (QN) methods have long been among the most effective methods for large-scale unconstrained convex optimization. Two obstacles have limited their use in deep learning: non-convexity and enormous parameter sizes. We introduce SoftServe, a family of QN methods designed to overcome these obstacles without line searches or ad hoc curvature corrections. SoftServe derives positivedefinite curvature estimates from the variational objective of Berglund et al. (2025), even in the presence of negative curvature. We develop diagonal and Kroneckerfactored variants that preserve positive definiteness by construction and scale to massive neural networks. Finally, SoftServe relies on the stable coupled Newton-Schulz iteration for the required matrix operations, replacing costly matrix decompositions with GPU-friendly matrix multiplications. SoftServe excels on problems that are severely ill-conditioned, including tasks such as recurrent networks, deep autoencoders, physics-informed neural networks, and a 136M-parameter physics-informed diffusion model, often achieving lower losses than established baselines including Adam, Muon, and SOAP.

</details>


### [646] [Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02185)
*Weihao Liu,Huangjie Zheng,Tianrong Chen,Rohit Dilip,Richard He Bai,Yizhu Jiao,Yuyang Wang,Ruixiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LoopCD是一种免训练的对比解码框架，利用循环Transformer早期循环的弱预测来引导最终强预测，在提升解码质量的同时减少推理计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer在重复执行共享块时，每个循环都会产生可解码的中间表示，但标准解码丢弃了早期状态。由于早期循环计算量更少，循环机制天然提供了对齐的“弱-强”预测对，无需辅助模型或额外训练。

Method: 提出LoopCD，通过将最终预测与早期循环预测进行对比来引导token选择。有两种模式：LoopCD-Logits在logit空间操作，需一次额外输出前向；LoopCD-Hidden在隐藏状态空间操作，零输出开销。

Result: 在四种循环Transformer上取得一致增益：LoopCD-Logits将Ouro-2.6B-Thinking的AIME 2024 pass@1从61.88%提升至73.33%；LoopCD-Hidden将Huginn的HumanEval pass@1从22.56%提升至31.71%。性能提升使得循环次数减半仍可匹配或超过全深度基线，减少前向FLOPs 22.5%至48.2%。

Conclusion: LoopCD将中间循环状态转化为有效引导信号，在实现更优解码质量的同时大幅降低推理计算。

Abstract: Looped Transformers achieve parameter efficiency by repeatedly executing a shared block across recurrent loops. Each loop yields an intermediate representation decodable for the same next token, yet standard decoding discards earlier states. Because earlier loops embody less computation, recurrence inherently supplies aligned weak-and-strong prediction pairs without auxiliary models or external training. We introduce LoopCD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework that guides token selection by contrasting the final prediction with an earlier recurrent pass, operating either in logit space with one extra output pass (LoopCD-Logits) or in hidden-state space with zero output overhead (LoopCD-Hidden). Across four looped Transformer families, LoopCD delivers substantial, consistent gains at full recurrent depth: LoopCD-Logits raises Ouro-2.6B-Thinking's AIME 2024 pass@1 from 61.88% to 73.33%, while LoopCD-Hidden lifts Huginn's HumanEval pass@1 from 22.56% to 31.71%. Crucially, these performance gains enable halving the number of recurrent loops while still matching or exceeding full-depth unguided baselines, reducing forward FLOPs by 22.5% to 48.2%. By transforming intermediate recurrent states into effective guidance signals, LoopCD achieves superior decoding quality while substantially reducing inference compute.

</details>


### [647] [Higher-Order Molecular Grammars for Generative and Foundation Models in Chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02186)
*Yiming Huang,Yujie Zeng,Vijay Prakash Dwivedi,Simone Foti,Jianmin Wang,Jure Leskovec,Tolga Birdal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HGR将分子提升为组合复形，用上下文无关高阶文法解析为产生式规则序列，从而以序列模型高效编码高阶拓扑（环系、重复基序），并在生成与表示学习中全面领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准序列/图表示难以显式编码环系等高阶拓扑；现有高阶表示计算昂贵且难以解码为有效分子。

Method: 提出高阶文法表示HGR：将分子映射为组合复形，并在上下文无关高阶文法下解析为紧凑的产生式规则序列，使高阶拓扑可直接用于序列模型；同时构建环系丰富的RingDiv基准（118万分子，含RingDiv300k）并提出环多样性指数RDI。

Result: 生成任务中，HGR模型在五大基准FCD均排名第一，且构造上保证100%有效性，分布对齐领先；表示学习中HGR-FM在七个MoleculeNet基准上（probing与full fine-tuning两种协议）取得最高平均AUC，分别超出最强基线8.3和3.3个AUC点。

Conclusion: HGR是一种高效的高阶分子表示，适用于分子生成与可迁移表示学习。

Abstract: Molecular learning models are strongly shaped by their underlying representations. Yet standard sequential and graph formalisms struggle to explicitly encode higher-order topology, such as ring systems and recurring motifs. Existing higher-order representations can capture these structures directly, but they are often computationally demanding and difficult to decode into valid molecules. Here, we introduce Higher-order Grammar Representation (HGR), a principled, topology-aware framework that lifts molecules to combinatorial complexes and parses each complex into a compact sequence of production rules under a context-free higher-order grammar. By serialising higher-order topology into rule sequences, HGR makes these structures directly compatible with standard sequence models, avoiding the computational overhead of explicit higher-order encodings while preserving topological expressiveness. To reduce benchmark bias towards simple ring systems, we construct RingDiv, a ring-enriched benchmark containing 1.18 million molecules, including the curated RingDiv300k subset, and introduce the ring diversity index (RDI) to quantify ring-system coverage. In molecular generation, HGR-based models uniquely combine 100% validity by construction with leading distributional alignment, ranking first in FCD on all five generation benchmarks. In representation learning, HGR-FM achieves the highest mean AUC across seven MoleculeNet benchmarks under both transfer protocols, improving on the strongest baseline by 8.3 and 3.3 AUC points under probing and full fine-tuning, respectively. Collectively, these results establish HGR as an efficient higher-order representation for molecular generation and transferable representation learning.

</details>


### [648] [Generative modeling of intrinsically disordered protein regions by reinforcing sparse autoencoder features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02189)
*Jason X. Liu,Sebastian Ibarraran,Frank Hu,Soojung Yang,Xinyu A. Feng,Abigail Park,Anagha Aneesh,Lacramioara Bintu,Alexander R. Dunn,Grant M. Rotskoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出IDiom（在5400万预测IDR上训练的自回归蛋白语言模型）及RL-SAE后训练方法，实现可控、可解释、可组合的IDR设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IDR在转录调控、信号转导、亚细胞定位中作用关键，但基于结构的设计方法不适用，且现有蛋白语言模型在全长序列上训练，先验偏向折叠结构域，导致IDR功能设计困难。

Method: 构建IDiom-DB数据集（从AlphaFold Database整理5400万预测IDR）；训练自回归蛋白语言模型IDiom；提出RL-SAE，用稀疏自编码器特征作为奖励进行强化学习后训练，以控制功能相关的序列模式。

Result: IDiom生成序列能重现天然IDR的组成、模式、基序和预测无序度；在8个IDR设计任务中，RL-SAE平均激活30个目标特征中的90%，而激活引导仅24%；相比引导和监督微调，RL-SAE提升了预测亚细胞定位与转录活性，并能将不同生物功能的特征组合到单条序列中。

Conclusion: IDiom与RL-SAE通过显式控制功能相关序列特征，实现可解释、可组合的IDR设计；RL-SAE有望推广到其他以可解释特征为设计目标的蛋白设计场景。

Abstract: Intrinsically disordered protein regions (IDRs) play central roles in cellular processes such as transcriptional regulation, signal transduction, and subcellular localization, yet their functional design remains challenging. Structure-based design methods do not readily apply to IDRs, and existing protein language models are trained on full-length protein sequences, thus learning a prior that is biased towards folded domains. Here, we present IDiom, an autoregressive protein language model trained on IDiom-DB, a dataset of 54 million predicted IDRs curated from the AlphaFold Database. IDiom generates diverse sequences that recapitulate the composition, patterning, motifs, and predicted disorder of natural IDRs. To control function-associated sequence patterns, we also introduce reinforcement learning with sparse autoencoder features (RL-SAE), a post-training method that rewards the generation of sequences that activate specified feature sets. Across eight IDR design tasks, RL-SAE sequences activate, on average, 90% of 30 targeted features, compared to 24% for activation steering. We demonstrate that RL-SAE improves the predicted subcellular localization and transcriptional activity of generated IDRs compared to steering and supervised fine-tuning, and enables features associated with distinct biological functions to be combined within individual sequences. Thus, IDiom and RL-SAE enable interpretable and composable IDR design through explicit control of function-associated sequence features. More broadly, RL-SAE could extend to other protein design settings where interpretable features provide useful design targets. Code is available at https://github.com/rotskoff-group/idiom.

</details>


### [649] [The Missing Primitive: Diagnosing and Repairing Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02191)
*Shuo Xing,Zilin Dai,Chengyuan Qian,Fangzhou Lin,Wenjing Chen,Ping He,Pan Lu,Alvaro Velasquez,Mohit Bansal,Zhengzhong Tu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"数学基元"概念与MathLEI基准，系统诊断LLM的结构化数学理解，发现发现(Discovery)是主要瓶颈，并提出基元优先的自蒸馏框架PAS提升数学推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在前沿数学题上表现亮眼，但其是否具备支撑解答的结构化数学理解尚不清楚，需要系统研究其数学理解能力并从诊断走向改进后训练。

Method: 1) 提出MathLEI基准，沿发现、生成、消化、执行四个维度评估数学推理；2) 系统诊断分析能力轮廓与瓶颈；3) 提出PAS，一种基元优先的自蒸馏框架，选择性将基元引导的推理迁移到学生模型。

Result: 诊断显示解题准确率掩盖了不同能力轮廓，基元可释放大量潜在执行能力，发现是数学推理的主导瓶颈；发现受限的失败更易修复；PAS在多种模型规模和挑战性基准上持续优于基线。

Conclusion: 从诊断到改进，本文表明结构化数学理解研究能指导后训练，基元优先自蒸馏是提升LLM数学推理的有效途径。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated striking capabilities on frontier mathematical problems, it remains unclear whether they possess the structural mathematical understanding underlying their solutions. In this paper, we take a first step toward systematically studying mathematical understanding in LLMs, from diagnosing its distinct capabilities to leveraging these findings to improve post-training. First, we introduce the notion of Mathematical Primitive to probe structural mathematical understanding and propose \hlei{}, a novel benchmark that evaluates mathematical reasoning along four distinct dimensions: Discovery, Generation, Digestion, and Execution. Second, our systematic diagnosis shows that solution accuracy masks distinct capability profiles, primitives unlock substantial latent execution capacity, and Discovery is the dominant bottleneck in mathematical reasoning. Our post-training analysis further shows that discovery-limited failures are particularly amenable to repair. Finally, building on these findings, we introduce \abs{}, a primitive-privileged self-distillation framework that selectively transfers primitive-guided reasoning into the student model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \abs{} consistently improves mathematical reasoning over baselines across model scales and challenging benchmarks.

</details>


### [650] [Cost-augmented Schrödinger bridges on graphs are exactly solvable: a Feynman-Kac tilt replaces learned control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02195)
*Akshay Balsubramani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出图上广义Schrödinger桥的精确求解方法：将状态代价作为Feynman-Kac倾斜融入参考过程，使代价增强桥等价于普通桥，从而无需时间差分惩罚；通过交替两端重缩放（各为一次稀疏矩阵指数运算）精确计算，不涉及时间离散或学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图上广义Schrödinger桥依赖学习受控连续时间马尔可夫链的速率，并需时间差分惩罚来恢复代价，方法复杂且需学习。作者希望消除这种学习与惩罚，直接精确求解问题。

Method: 将状态代价以Feynman-Kac倾斜折入参考过程，把代价增强桥转化为关于倾斜参考的普通桥，从而去掉惩罚项；用交替两端重缩放算法精确计算桥，每次仅需一次稀疏矩阵指数应用，无时间离散、无学习；对时间平均占据量的二次拥挤代价，采用围绕精确桥的阻尼最优响应，等价于强凸函数上的梯度下降。

Result: 交替算法收敛率仅由端点耦合决定；阻尼最优响应的残差可界定其误差。应用方面：在蛋白质折叠模型上，自由能代价降低了折叠路径的期望势垒；在学习方法所用的道路网络上，精确桥的采样结果与目标在采样误差内一致；在数百万交叉点的网络上，内存随规模线性增长。

Conclusion: 广义Schrödinger桥可在图上被精确、高效地计算，无需学习或时间离散；Feynman-Kac倾斜与交替重缩放提供了简洁且理论保证良好的框架，并能扩展到大规模网络与复杂代价场景。

Abstract: The generalized Schrödinger bridge on a graph moves mass between two distributions while charging a cost for the states visited. It has been approached by learning the rates of a controlled continuous-time Markov chain, with a temporal-difference penalty that restores the cost. A state cost folds into the reference process as a Feynman-Kac tilt. The cost-augmented bridge is then a plain bridge against the tilted reference, and the penalty is unnecessary. The bridge is computed exactly by alternating two endpoint rescalings, each one sparse matrix-exponential application; nothing is discretized in time or learned. The alternation converges at a rate set by the endpoint coupling alone. For a quadratic congestion cost on time-averaged occupancies, damped best response around the exact bridge is gradient descent on a strongly convex function, and its residual bounds its error. On a protein-folding model, a free-energy cost lowers the expected barrier of the folding paths. On the learned approach's road network, roll-outs of the exact bridge match the target within sampling error, and on networks with millions of intersections its memory grows linearly.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [651] [Who Judges the Frame? Auditing Multimodal LLM Judges for News Framing Across Event-Level Perspectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00071)
*Antonela Tommasel,Markus Schedl*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文对多模态大语言模型作为媒体框架与视角分析工具进行审计，考察其输出受模态、元数据和提示设计影响的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新闻框架分析日益依赖LLM作为可扩展测量工具，但LLM输出可能反映模型自身倾向、提示设计及社会/文化假设，而非纯粹的内容属性，因此需要审计其作为测量工具的可靠性。

Method: 构建2025–2026年事件中心数据集，每个事件包含左、中、右倾向的同一标题文章；结合基于嵌入的视角相似度度量与模型驱动的框架构念评估，覆盖不同模态和元数据可见性条件。

Result: 研究不将数据集标签或模型输出视为真值，而是揭示了LLM媒体分析的可用性与局限，识别出模态效应、元数据敏感性和提示诱导的伪影。

Conclusion: 提出一套审计协议，强调在关于新闻框架和意识形态视角差异的实质性论断之外，须同时报告模态效应、元数据敏感性与提示诱导伪影。

Abstract: News coverage of major world events is shaped not only by what is reported, but also by how events are framed through text, images and their combination. At the same time, Large Language Models (LLMs), including multimodal LLMs, are increasingly used as scalable instruments for analysing framing, sentiment, ideological slant and perspective differences in multimodal media datasets. This creates a methodological challenge. When used as measurement instruments, LLM outputs may reflect not only content properties, but also model-specific tendencies, prompt design choices, and social, political, cultural, linguistic or modality-specific assumptions. This work audits LLMs as instruments for large-scale framing and perspective analysis in multimodal news coverage. Using an event-centered dataset of 2025--2026 news coverage, where each event includes left-, center- and right-oriented articles about the same headline, we combine embedding-based measures of within-event viewpoint similarity with model-based assessments of framing constructs across modality-specific and metadata-visible input conditions. Rather than treating either dataset labels or model outputs as ground truth, our goal is to examine the usefulness and limitations of LLM-based media analysis. The study contributes an audit protocol that highlights the need to report modality effects, metadata sensitivity, and prompt-induced artifacts alongside substantive claims about news framing and ideological viewpoint differences.

</details>


### [652] [White Men Without Degrees Receive the Lowest Ratings from Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00185)
*Maxim Chupilkin*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 大语言模型在信用、招聘和租房评估中，对无本科学历的白人男性给出的平均评分在八个性别-种族-学历群体中最低，而对有学历的黑人女性评分最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验大语言模型在受控评估中是否存在群体差异，并揭示常被宽泛种族或性别分类掩盖的特定弱势群体（无学历白人男性）。

Method: 对来自12个开发者群体的18个模型开展全因子情景实验（vignette），在固定各情景财务或职业条件下变化性别、种族、年龄、公民身份和学历；每个模型在每种情境中对全部32种画像各评10次，共获得17,280个评分。

Result: 跨模型平均后，无学历白人男性在三类情景中评分最低：信用75.87、招聘92.71、租房86.62（0-100分）；有学历黑人女性最高，差距分别为2.94、3.66、3.56分；单项属性效应均偏向女性、黑人和有学历者；无学历白人男性在54个模型-情景组合中有46个（85.2%）为最低或次低。

Conclusion: 大语言模型评估呈现出与"无学历白人男性经济与健康脆弱性上升"相符的模式，提示该群体的劣势可能被宽泛的种族或性别类别所掩盖。

Abstract: White men without an undergraduate degree receive the lowest average ratings among eight gender-race-education groups in controlled large-language-model evaluations of credit, hiring, and rental applications. We conduct full-factorial vignette experiments with 18 models from 12 developer groups, varying gender, race, age, citizenship, and education while holding stated financial or occupational circumstances constant within each setting. Each model evaluates all 32 profiles ten times per setting, yielding 17,280 ratings. Averaging over models, age, and citizenship, ratings for White men without degrees are the lowest among the eight groups, at 75.87 in credit, 92.71 in hiring, and 86.62 in rental housing on a 0-100 scale. Black women with degrees receive the highest average ratings, with corresponding gaps of 2.94, 3.66, and 3.56 points. Separate attribute effects favor women, Black applicants, and degree holders in all three settings. White men without degrees have the lowest or second-lowest mean in 46 of 54 model-scenario combinations (85.2%). This pattern connects to evidence of growing economic and health vulnerabilities among White men without degrees, highlighting a group whose disadvantages can be obscured by broad racial or gender categories.

</details>


### [653] [TeamLens in Critsly: A Consent-Based Team-Composition Interface and Synthetic Readiness Evaluation for Design Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00288)
*Nizam Kadir*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: TeamLens：一个可选加入的 Critsly 界面，用于在特定看板上自愿分享自报的 MBTI 类型，实现披露与聚合分离并附可审计的技术评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 讨论工作偏好可支持设计团队的反思，但人格标签不应成为绩效预测或参与条件。需要一个尊重自愿性、分离账号激活与信息披露、并明确其正确性与隐私边界的工具。

Method: 实现 TeamLens 界面：将账号激活与 MBTI 披露分离，展示描述性组成计数，并提供关闭可见性、撤回单份报告、删除全部报告的控制。评估包括开源代码审查、独立指定的合成聚合用例、访问与生命周期检查、浏览器组件测试、本地数据库微基准及部署记录。

Result: 十六个固定类型报告的 65,536 个二元资格子集全部匹配独立预言机；经 4,259 次合成分享调用后，128 个带种子的多重性夹具也匹配。隔离 HTTP 套件通过 183 项断言。180 次顺序内存 SQLite 读取试验中，中位服务调用时间从无档案行的 0.064 ms 增至 1,024 行的 200.932 ms；插桩 SQL 操作为 11+3n。

Conclusion: 结果仅涉及已测试的软件行为与有限工作负载，不证明人类可用性、心理测量效度、学习收益、团队绩效效应或生产容量。贡献是已实现的披露到聚合工作流及其正确性边界、隐私限制与扩展成本的可审计技术说明；论文披露了 OpenAI Codex 的辅助使用及其局限。

Abstract: Discussing working preferences may support reflection within a design team, but a personality label should not become a performance prediction or a condition of participation. This technical report presents TeamLens, an optional Critsly interface for voluntarily sharing a self-reported MBTI type with a particular board. It separates account activation from disclosure, displays descriptive composition counts, and provides distinct controls for disabling visibility, withdrawing one report and deleting all of one's reports. The evaluation combines released-source inspection, independently specified synthetic aggregation cases, access and lifecycle checks, browser component tests, a local database microbenchmark and deployment records. All 65,536 binary eligibility subsets of sixteen fixed, distinct type reports matched an independent oracle; 128 seeded multiplicity fixtures also matched, after 4,259 synthetic share calls. The isolated HTTP suite passed 183 assertions. In 180 sequential in-memory SQLite read trials, median service-call time increased from 0.064 ms with no profile rows to 200.932 ms with 1,024 rows; instrumented SQL operations followed 11+3n. These findings concern exercised software behaviour and a bounded workload. They do not establish human usability, psychometric validity, learning gains, team-performance effects or production capacity. The contribution is an implemented disclosure-to-aggregation workflow and an auditable technical account of its correctness boundaries, privacy limitations and scaling cost. OpenAI Codex assisted with implementation, evaluation and manuscript preparation; the paper discloses this use and its limits.

</details>


### [654] [CALLIOPE: A Source-Grounded Oral Assessment System and Synthetic Readiness Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00290)
*Nizam Kadir*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: CALLIOPE：一个溯源式口语评估系统。将版本化教材、学习者语音记录与转录、自适应提问、双供应商评分、教育者复核和可导出证据整合。基于2026年9月25日保留的合成验证记录，展示已部署功能、候选安全措施及剩余需求，但不主张评分有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI口语评估不能只有对话界面，教育者需将语音回答与教材来源、评分标准、模型输出及人工判断关联起来，因此需要一个可检查的"响应到复核"工作流。

Method: 构建CALLIOPE系统，整合版本化教材、学习者轮次录音与转录、自适应提问、双供应商量规评分、教育者审阅和可导出证据。用3个语音样例和1个静音对照，跨两次发布运行验证；后续零流量候选版本加入版本绑定同意检查、只插入式首评收据和单独授权的编码导出，并有本地回归测试。

Result: 最终发布演练中，语音样例AI总分分别为100、62、8（满分100），触发两个供应商分歧标记；两次运行检索的8个音频文件均与输入逐字节一致。零流量候选版本未做新的完整实时研究流程评估。

Conclusion: 贡献在于可检查的响应到复核工作流，以及针对具体发布版本说明其工程证据"能"和"不能"证明什么。未报告人类参与者结果，区分了已部署功能、候选保障措施及尚存恢复、并发与学习运营需求。

Abstract: Oral assessment with generative AI requires more than a conversational interface: educators must connect a spoken response to its source material, scoring criteria, model outputs and subsequent human judgement. This technical report presents CALLIOPE, a source-grounded oral assessment system integrating versioned instructional material, learner-turn recording and transcription, adaptive questioning, two-provider rubric scoring, educator review and exportable evidence. We examine implementation and retained synthetic verification records from 25 September 2026. Three spoken fixtures and a silence control were exercised across two release runs. In the final release rehearsal, the spoken fixtures received aggregate AI scores of 100, 62 and 8 out of 100; two elicited provider-disagreement flags. All eight retrieved audio files across the two runs were byte-identical to their inputs. These observations establish operation of specific exercised paths, not scoring validity or learning gains. A later zero-traffic candidate added version-bound consent checks, insert-only first-pass rating receipts and separately authorised coded exports, supported by local regression tests but not a new full live research workflow evaluation. We distinguish deployed functionality, candidate safeguards and remaining recovery, concurrency and study-operation requirements. The contribution is an inspectable response-to-review workflow and a release-specific account of what its engineering evidence does, and does not, establish. No human-participant outcomes are reported. OpenAI Codex assisted with technical verification, evidence synthesis and manuscript preparation.

</details>


### [655] [From Scroll to Sale: Exploring the Impact of Interaction Type and Device Price on TikTok Advertisements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00684)
*Nazanin Sabri,Cat Mai,Haodi Zou,Isha Varada,Damon McCoy,Deepak Kumar,Kristen Vaccaro*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过56个自动化账号审计TikTok信息流，收集超8万条视频，研究设备价格（作为收入代理）及互动行为对广告投放的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业与品牌越来越多地使用动态定价，包括根据收入向社交媒体用户投放定向广告，因此需要审计平台广告投放行为，探究其是否基于用户经济状况进行差异化投放。

Method: 使用56个自动化账号、12部不同价位手机（低$0-$250、中$400-$650、高$750-$1000+）作为收入代理，收集超8万条视频，测试设备价格、互动类型（点赞、评论、分享）、年龄、性别对广告数量和内容的影响，共两项研究。

Result: 总体广告负载为29.4%；点赞和分享显著增加广告负载；账号在TikTok上停留时间越长，广告负载持续增加；设备价格影响广告负载和内容——较贵设备收到更少广告，最便宜设备收到更多折扣广告。

Conclusion: 平台广告投放存在基于设备价格（收入代理）的差异化，提示动态定价和定向广告可能对低收入用户不利，需引起对广告公平性的关注。

Abstract: Companies and brands increasingly use dynamic pricing, including targeting social media ads to users based on their income. In this work we audit TikTok's feed using 56 automated accounts, which collect data on over 80,000 videos, across two studies. We test the impact of device price on ad load and ad types, using 12 phones of low ($0-$250), medium ($400-$650), and high ($750-$1,000+) price as a proxy for income. We also test the impact of interaction type (i.e., like, comment, share), age, and gender on the frequency and content of ads. Overall, the ad load was 29.4%, but liking and sharing content increased ad load significantly. We also found that as accounts spend more time on TikTok, the ad load steadily increases. We found some evidence that device price impacts both ad load and content -- more expensive devices were targeted with fewer ads, while the least expensive devices received more discounts.

</details>


### [656] [Visibility on Terrains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00796)
*Laura Toma*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本章综述地形可视性模型、算法与应用，涵盖从视线、单视点视域到累积/总视域的定义，覆盖TIN与规则网格地形，回顾精确与近似算法，并介绍考古、绿视暴露、风景路线管理与土地保护等应用领域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地形可视性在多个领域有广泛应用，但相关模型、算法与应用分散于不同文献，缺乏系统性梳理，因此需要一篇综述来整合基础知识与进展。

Method: 采用综述方式：先给出基本定义（视线、单视点视域、累积视域与总视域），分别在三角不规则网络（TIN）和规则网格两类地形上展开；再回顾精确算法与近似算法。

Result: 系统整理了地形可视性的定义体系与算法分类，并归纳了考古、绿视暴露、风景路线管理、土地保护等主要应用领域。

Conclusion: 该综述为地形可视性研究提供了统一的概念框架与算法、应用概览，有助于后续研究与实际应用参考。

Abstract: This chapter surveys terrain visibility models, algorithms, and applications. It introduces basic definitions, from line-of-sight, single-viewpoint viewsheds to cumulative and total viewsheds, on both Triangulated Irregular Network (TIN) and regular grid terrains. Reviews exact and approximate algorithms and highlights key application domains including archaeology, visual exposure to greenery, scenic route management, and land conservation.

</details>


### [657] [Learning and Predicting Patent Technology Reuse Trajectories from Emergence-Time Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00806)
*Ayham Yousef,Qiang Ye,Qiang Cheng*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文以20年专利复用轨迹为对象，用GRU自编码器潜在空间k-means构建复用模式标签，检验新兴期特征对标签的可预测性，并警示日历年份效应与标签构造的合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测新出现专利技术将如何被复用是技术情报的核心问题，但复用模式标签并非预先存在，必须从轨迹中构造，而构造方式决定了预测的含义。作者因此希望建立一种基于学习式序列表示的标签构造方法，并检验其可预测性与效度。

Method: 研究对象为201,710项新专利技术（首次IPC代码配对，USPTO 2002–2022）。主标签在GRU自编码器学习到的20年复用轨迹潜在空间中用k-means聚类获得，不使用手工特征；另用7个新兴期（首年可观测）特征做一 vs 其余预测。同时用Fractal Autoencoder做特征选择，并单独对新兴期特征聚类以检验其与GRU标签的一致性。轨迹形状任务采用GBDT与已发表构造进行复现比较。

Result: 7个新兴期特征恢复GRU标签的宏ROC-AUC达0.914，但仅用出现日历年即可达0.874；对观测满十年、无右删失技术的复现表明该日历年效应主要反映时间上专利内容的变化。新兴期特征自身的聚类与GRU标签仅略高于随机一致（ARI≈0.04）。轨迹形状任务上GBDT以全部7特征达0.831，用所选子集达0.740，而已发表0.728来自不同语料与标签，仅作参考。另量化了两个特征在最早队列中的左截断问题。

Conclusion: 基于学习式序列表示的标签构造可行且新兴期特征具有高可预测性，但高预测性能部分被出现年份混杂所驱动；新兴期特征的划分并不等同于复用模式分类体系，不应如此解读。复用模式预测的效度取决于标签构造方式，需谨慎对待日历年份效应与左截断问题。

Abstract: Forecasting how a newly emerged patent technology will be reused is central to technology intelligence, but reuse-pattern labels do not exist in advance: they must be constructed from the trajectories themselves, and how they are constructed determines what a forecast means. We study $201{,}710$ novel patent technologies (first-time IPC code pairings, USPTO 2002--2022). Our primary labeling applies $k$-means in the latent space of a GRU autoencoder trained on the $20$-year reuse trajectories, using no hand-crafted features; to our knowledge this is the first use of a learned sequence representation for this task. Seven emergence-time features, observable in a technology's first year, recover these labels at a one-vs-rest macro ROC-AUC of $0.914$, but the calendar year of emergence alone reaches $0.874$. A replication on technologies observed for ten full years, none of them right-censored, indicates that this calendar-year effect mainly reflects change over time in what was patented. Separately we cluster the emergence-time features themselves, after Fractal Autoencoder feature selection. That emergence-profile partition agrees with the GRU-based labels only marginally above chance (Adjusted Rand Index $\approx 0.04$), so a partition of emergence-time features is not a reuse-pattern taxonomy and should not be read as one. On a trajectory-shape task following the published construction, GBDT reaches $0.831$ with all seven features and $0.740$ with the selected subset; the published $0.728$, from a different corpus and labeling, is a reference point rather than a benchmark. Two features are additionally left-truncated for the earliest cohorts, which we quantify.

</details>


### [658] [Correctness, Convergence, and AI-Generated Code Detection: A Longitudinal Study of Student and Large Language Model Code in Introductory Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00863)
*Runlong Ye,Jing Fan,Angela Zavaleta Bernuy,Oscar Karnalim,Paul Denny,Juho Leinonen,Michael Liut*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 研究通过29,970份学生提交与90,000份LLM生成解，检验"生成参考库匹配"能说明什么：多数匹配短、且会随年级上升，但个体归因仍需过程证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM能生成看似合理的编程作业解，因此教师倾向用"生成解参考库"匹配学生代码来检测AI使用。但若作业本身只有少数自然实现方式，相似代码也会自然出现，使"匹配"究竟证明了什么变得不确定。

Method: 使用十门Python实验课、2021/2023/2025三个年级共29,970份学生提交，以及三个前沿LLM回顾性生成的90,000份解。用隐藏教师测试验证生成解正确性；剔除起始代码后用MOSS比对代码相似度；并分析选定函数的精确AST形态。

Result: 模型通常给出正确解，且在多数作业上收敛到相似实现。学生提交与生成参考的匹配率在较晚年级更高，包括通过全部隐藏测试的提交。对规格严格限定的函数，模型收敛到少数精确AST形态，学生侧的不同形态数量也随年级下降；开放式函数在两类来源中都保持多样。多数重叠较短，最小匹配长度是审阅时的关键选择。

Conclusion: 建议教师在发布作业前先构建生成解参考库，以识别哪些任务上生成解会收敛、判断一次匹配需要多少人工审阅，并重新设计任务以引出测试、推理与中间过程。研究支持在群体层面追踪提交代码的变化，但要把AI使用归因到单份提交，还需关于其产生过程的额外证据，如提示、修改记录、中间代码与学生声明。

Abstract: Large language models can generate plausible solutions to programming assignments, making it tempting to detect their use by matching student code against a reference bank of generated solutions. Yet similar code can also arise when an assignment admits only a few natural implementations, which leaves open what a match actually shows.
  We investigate generated-reference matching using 29,970 student submissions from ten Python labs offered in 2021, 2023, and 2025, together with 90,000 solution attempts generated retrospectively by three frontier LLMs. We validate the generated solutions using hidden instructor tests, compare code with MOSS after excluding the starter code, and examine the exact abstract syntax tree (AST) forms of selected functions.
  The models usually produced correct solutions and, across most assignments, converged on similar implementations. Student submissions matched the generated references more often in later cohorts, including among submissions that passed every hidden test. On tightly specified functions, the models converged on a few exact abstract-syntax-tree forms, and the number of distinct student forms also declined across cohorts, whereas open-ended functions remained diverse in both sources. Most reported overlaps were short, making the minimum match length an important choice when reviewing students' code.
  Finally, we discuss how instructors can build a reference bank of generated solutions before releasing an assignment to identify tasks on which generated solutions converge, decide how much review a match warrants, and redesign tasks to elicit tests, reasoning, and intermediate work. These findings support tracking population-level changes in submitted code, while attributing AI use to an individual submission would require additional evidence about how it was produced, such as prompts, revisions, intermediate code, and student disclosures.

</details>


### [659] [From Digital Capabilities to Non Linear Growth: The Exponential SME Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01129)
*Dhushy Thillaivasan,Kristina Nicholls,Sathyapriya Govindarajulu,Ken Mardaneh*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出"指数型中小企业框架"(Exponential SME Framework)，整合数字动态能力、数字化转型实践、组织转型与指数型组织(ExO)属性，解释中小企业如何从数字能力发展走向非线性增长潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中小企业面临数字化转型压力，但难以将数字举措转化为可持续的组织能力与增长成果，且现有研究分散、缺乏整合性理论框架。

Method: 概念性研究。基于数字动态能力(DDC)、数字化转型实践、组织转型、指数型组织(ExO)属性及中小企业增长等文献，构建整合性概念框架。

Result: 框架提出：数字动态能力是基础，支撑数字化转型实践(DASAT)，进而推动商业模式、价值链、客户关系与组织文化等关键领域转型；这些转型促进ExO式属性(实验、仪表盘、自主性、社区参与)的采用，增强组织适应性、学习与响应能力，最终提升非线性增长潜力。

Conclusion: 本文通过整合多研究流派构建统一框架，厘清能力、实践、组织转型与增长赋能机制间的关系，为未来实证研究奠定基础，并为管理者与政策制定者提供强化中小企业数字化转型与增长准备的启示。

Abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) face increasing pressure to navigate digital transformation, yet many struggle to convert digital initiatives into sustainable organisational capability development and growth outcomes. This paper develops the Exponential SME Framework, an integrated conceptual framework that explains how SMEs may progress from digital capability development to non-linear growth potential. Drawing on literature relating to Digital Dynamic Capabilities (DDC), digital transformation practices, organisational transformation, Exponential Organization (ExO) attributes, and SME growth, the framework synthesises previously fragmented streams of research into a coherent conceptual structure. The framework proposes that Digital Dynamic Capabilities provide the foundation for Digital Transformation Practices (DASAT), which contribute to transformations across key organisational domains, including business models, value chains, customer relationships, and organisational culture. These transformations may support the adoption of ExO-like attributes, specifically experimentation, dashboards, autonomy, and community engagement, that enhance organisational adaptability, learning, and responsiveness. Through the interaction of these organisational elements, SMEs may strengthen the conditions associated with non-linear growth potential. The paper contributes to the SME and digital transformation literature by integrating multiple streams of research into a unified framework, clarifying the relationships between capabilities, practices, organisational transformation, and growth-enabling mechanisms, and providing a foundation for future empirical research. The paper also offers managerial and policy implications for strengthening SME digital transformation and growth readiness.

</details>


### [660] [Virtual Global Collaboration in Data Analytics and Machine Learning Education: A Mixed-Methods Study of Asynchronous Cross-Border Teamwork](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01147)
*Sehrish Basir Nizamani,Saad Nizamani,Khyati Goyal,Sarwat Nizamani,Zannah Zeiw*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 研究考察美巴本科计算课程间的结构化虚拟全球协作(VGC)活动，混合团队通过六阶段数据分析与机器学习项目协作，结果积极，证明短期结构化VGC能有效促进技术学习与全球胜任力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 支持技术与跨文化技能发展，探索将虚拟全球协作整合进计算课程以培养全球胜任力。

Method: 美巴本科生组成混合机构团队，采用共享计算工具，异步跨国协作完成六阶段项目：文化导向、数据集选择、数据清洗、分析、入门机器学习、结构化报告。通过问卷调查与质性反思数据分析协作体验、沟通与文化动态、学习成果、感知价值及全球准备度。

Result: 两个队列学生体验均为积极；协作过程与学习和感知价值强相关；跨文化沟通是全球准备度的主要驱动因素。

Conclusion: 短期、结构化的VGC可有效融入计算课程，同时支持技术学习与全球胜任力培养。

Abstract: This innovative practice full paper examines a structured Virtual Global Collaboration (VGC) activity between undergraduate computing courses in the United States and Pakistan. The project was designed to support technical and intercultural skill development through asynchronous international teamwork in data analytics and introductory machine learning. Students worked in mixed-institution teams through a six-phase project including cultural orientation, dataset selection, data cleaning, analysis, introductory machine learning, and structured reporting. Using shared computational tools, teams coordinated across time zones to complete a joint data-driven project. Survey and qualitative reflection data were analyzed to examine collaborative experience, communication and cultural dynamics, learning outcomes, perceived value, and global readiness. Results show consistently positive student experiences across both cohorts, with collaborative processes strongly associated with learning and perceived value, and cross-cultural communication emerging as the primary driver of global readiness. These findings demonstrate how short-term, structured VGC can be effectively integrated into computing courses to support both technical learning and global competence.

</details>


### [661] [Understanding Student Use of Large Language Models Across Computer Science Subfields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01158)
*Sehrish Basir Nizamani,Yoonje Lee,Nikitha Donekal Chandrashekar,Margaret Ellis,Naren Ramakrishnan*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 研究211名本科生在CS不同子领域使用LLM的情况，发现使用率、角色认知和验证行为因作业类型而异，作业特征是关键影响因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM融入计算机教育，需理解其使用如何随技术与教学情境变化，以设计子领域感知的教学。

Method: 在一门专门设计支持负责任LLM使用的问题求解课程中，收集7个教学模块（跨多个CS子领域）的作业后反思数据，分析提示次数、LLM角色认知和验证行为。

Result: LLM采用率因作业差异显著：算法和Web开发较高，软件工程较低；学生多将LLM视为辅助工具而非权威来源；验证普遍且多用多策略，结构化任务多用测试，开放式任务多用网络搜索。

Conclusion: 作业特征在塑造学生与LLM交互及评估中起核心作用，即使在统一教学设计下亦然；研究为跨子领域的LLM采用、角色认知与验证行为提供实证证据，扩展了结构化反思式教学的研究。

Abstract: This research full paper examines how undergraduate students use large language models (LLMs) across computer science subfields. As LLMs become increasingly integrated into computing education, understanding how their use varies across technical and pedagogical contexts is essential for designing effective, subfield-aware instruction. This paper presents a cross-subfield analysis of LLM usage among 211 undergraduate students in a problem-solving course intentionally designed to support responsible and effective LLM use through structured instruction and reflection. Using post-assignment reflection data collected across seven instructional modules spanning multiple computer science subfields, we examine prompt counts, LLM role conceptualization, and verification behavior. Results show that LLM adoption varies substantially by assignment, with higher usage in algorithms and web development and lower usage in software engineering. Students predominantly treat LLMs as assistive tools rather than authoritative sources, and verification is common across all subfields, with most students using multiple strategies. Verification behavior also varies by assignment context, with testing more common in structured tasks and web search more common in open-ended tasks. These findings suggest that assignment characteristics play a central role in shaping how students interact with and evaluate LLM outputs, even under a single, consistently applied instructional design. This work contributes empirical evidence on how LLM adoption, role conceptualization, and verification behavior vary across computer science subfields, extending our prior work on structured, reflective LLM instruction to show how its effects differ by task rather than only in aggregate.

</details>


### [662] [WIP: DBWorkout: A Gamified SQL Practice Platform to Support Formative Learning in Database Courses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01174)
*Sehrish Basir Nizamani,Deepika Devaraj,Tien Nguyen,Khyati Goyal,Saad Nizamani,Sally Hamouda,Jaren Goldberg*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: DBWorkout是一个基于网页的SQL形成性学习平台，整合沙盒执行、自动结果反馈和游戏化机制，并通过LLM辅助任务生成。170名本科生的课堂部署显示学习价值与参与度较高，但自动反馈的可操作性不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本科学生SQL学习困难，主要因缺乏交互式练习机会与即时反馈。同时教师工作负担重，需要降低生成模式与任务的成本。

Method: DBWorkout平台包含三部分：基于沙盒的实时数据库SQL执行；多维度自动化结果反馈（行值、列结构、排序）；基于会话的游戏化。并引入LLM辅助的schema与任务生成，采用human-in-the-loop工作流。

Result: 助教试点与170名本科生两次课堂部署表明：90%认可学习价值，87%感到有趣，仅22%报告压力。但只有42%认为自动反馈足够可操作，40%开放式回答也提出反馈质量问题，形成跨方法三角验证。

Conclusion: DBWorkout在技术可行性与早期教学潜力上得到验证，未来需提升反馈质量并支持长期SQL学习。

Abstract: This research WIP paper presents DBWorkout, a web-based platform that supports formative SQL learning through sandbox-based execution, automated result-based feedback, and session-based gamification. Learning Structured Query Language (SQL) remains challenging for undergraduate students due to limited opportunities for interactive practice and immediate feedback. Students iteratively practice SQL on live database instances while receiving multi-dimensional feedback on query correctness, including row values, column structure, and ordering. To reduce instructor workload, DBWorkout incorporates large language model (LLM)-assisted tools for schema and task generation within a human-in-the-loop workflow. A pilot study with teaching assistants and a classroom deployment involving 170 undergraduate students across two in-class sessions show strong perceived learning value (90% agreement) and engagement (87% enjoyment), alongside low reported pressure (22%). However, only 42% of students found the automated feedback sufficiently actionable, a finding independently corroborated by 40% of open-ended responses raising feedback quality concerns, providing cross-method triangulation of this gap. These findings demonstrate the technical feasibility and early pedagogical potential of DBWorkout while identifying directions for enhancing feedback quality and supporting sustained SQL learning.

</details>


### [663] [Judgement in the Age of Jev: From Evaluation Scarcity to Evaluation Abundance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01231)
*Richard Hill*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个"条件性杰文斯假说"，探讨当机器评估的边际成本大幅降低时，其组织性使用是否会因潜在需求而增加，并考察这一"稀缺性转型"对组织判断与决策权的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI降低了符号产出的成本，使学界关注评估与辨别成为约束。但作者指出另一种可能：机器评估本身也可能变得足够廉价并被大规模常规部署，从而改变组织中的稀缺结构。以TypeSafe AI的Jev模型（引用杰文斯）为触发点，提出需要理论化这一问题。

Method: 概念性/理论性研究。将TypeSafe的宣称视为"技术挑衅"而非既定实证结果，整合反弹经济学（rebound economics）与廉价预测、生产丰裕、机器评估、决策分配、权威、依赖及"执行判断"等研究，构建条件性杰文斯假说。

Result: 提出区分预测、机器评估、组织判断与授权四种功能活动，指出其成本不必同步下降；并指出机器评估可能共享证据、标准与错误，放大错误设定的评分标准，基于已丢失关键限定的表征运作，并通过阈值与例外路由改变实际决策权。

Conclusion: 研究问题为：廉价机器评估何时替代人类评估工作、何时重新分配或创造对判断的需求，以及它如何影响组织在关键承诺时可用的判断依据。

Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence has reduced the cost of producing plausible symbolic artefacts, leading recent organisation scholarship to identify evaluation and discernment as constraints under conditions of production abundance. This perspective examines a further possibility: that machine evaluation itself becomes inexpensive enough to be deployed routinely and at scale. The investigation is prompted by Jev, TypeSafe AI's specialised model for typed probabilistic decisions. TypeSafe explicitly invokes William Stanley Jevons to argue that lower-cost machine intelligence can unlock previously uneconomic uses. Treating this as a technological provocation rather than an established empirical result, the article formulates a conditional Jevons hypothesis for machine evaluation: sufficiently large reductions in the total marginal cost of usable machine evaluation may increase its organisational consumption where latent demand is substantial and complementary costs do not dominate. The article integrates rebound economics with research on cheap prediction, production abundance, machine evaluation, decision allocation, authority, reliance and Executive Judgement to examine this possible scarcity transition. It distinguishes prediction, machine evaluation, organisational judgement and authorisation as functional activities whose costs need not fall together. Evaluations can share evidence, criteria and errors; scale mis-specified rubrics; operate on representations from which consequential qualifications have disappeared; and change practical decision rights through thresholds and exception routing. The resulting research problem is when cheap machine evaluation substitutes for human evaluative work, when it redistributes or creates demands for judgement, and how it affects the grounds available at consequential organisational commitment.

</details>


### [664] [Architecture Without an Architect? Global Governance of Artificial Intelligence in a Divided World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01716)
*Simon Chesterman*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文评述Matthijs Maas的《全球AI治理架构》,肯定其社会技术变迁与制度复杂性框架,但批评其"我们"的集体主体掩盖了权力分配差异,指出全球AI治理的真正难题是权力分散、激励分化的多元行为者共同塑造的架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI治理面临独特困难:技术发展快、跨境性强、行为者资源堪比国家,而国际回应碎片化、代表性不足且多为非约束性。核心挑战不仅是找规则,而是理解谁有能力与激励去创建、执行和调整规则。

Method: 这是一篇评述性论文(review essay),通过分析Maas的《Architectures of Global AI Governance》展开,运用社会技术变迁、治理瓦解与制度复杂性三个视角进行批判性讨论。

Result: Maas的框架有力抵制了技术决定论和单一制度蓝图,强调碎片化、演进式治理架构的可能。但本文认为其制度设计脱离权力分配,忽视了国家与科技公司之间的能力与激励差异。

Conclusion: 全球AI治理的核心问题或许不是"有架构却无建筑师",而是由拥有不同权力形式、激励分歧且缺乏共同计划的多重行为者共同塑造的新兴架构。制度设计无法与权力分配分离。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence presents an unusually difficult problem for global governance. The technology develops rapidly, crosses borders easily, and is shaped by actors whose resources and capabilities may rival those of states. Yet international responses remain fragmented, unevenly representative, and overwhelmingly non-binding. The challenge is therefore not simply to identify appropriate rules or institutions, but to understand who has the capacity and incentive to create, enforce, and adapt them.
  This review essay examines these questions through Matthijs Maas's Architectures of Global AI Governance. Maas offers an ambitious framework for thinking about AI governance through the lenses of sociotechnical change, governance disruption, and regime complexity. His account usefully resists both technological determinism and the search for a single institutional blueprint, emphasizing instead the possibilities of a fragmented and evolving governance architecture.
  The essay argues, however, that institutional design cannot be separated from the distribution of power. Maas frequently invokes what "we" should do about AI, but that collective subject obscures important differences among states, international institutions, and technology companies. States retain formidable powers over markets, infrastructure, strategic inputs, and firms themselves. At the same time, many consequential decisions about frontier AI - what is built, how quickly, with what safeguards, and when it is released - are concentrated within a small number of private companies. The central problem of global AI governance may therefore be less architecture without an architect than an emerging architecture shaped by multiple actors possessing different forms of power, divergent incentives, and no common set of plans.

</details>


### [665] [Participation-Sensitive Convergence and the Fragment First, Converge Later Pattern in Asynchronous Online Learning: A Topological Analysis Across 22 OULAD Courses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01738)
*Hitoshi Inoue,Koichi Yasutake*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该论文基于OULAD全部22门课程（N>22,000，857个周对），验证了Zigzag持久同调中$β_0$（行为簇数量）作为异步在线学习"参与敏感型"结构指标的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步在线学习虽具时间灵活性，但学习社区易碎片化而非凝聚；$β_0$可刻画此结构，但两个问题未在大规模上验证：(1)$β_0$收敛是真实行为对齐还是学习者流失？(2)考核截止日期是否产生可复现的"碎片化-收敛"周期？

Method: 对OULAD全部22门课程、857个周对计算$β_0$，分析其变化与活跃学习者数量变化的协变关系，检验截止日期事件引发的碎片化-收敛周期，并进行3阶段长期轨迹分析。

Result: $β_0$变化与活跃学习者变化强共变（合并r=0.387；中位课程r_delta=0.459，20/22门课程），表明$β_0$为参与敏感指标且二者共同响应截止日期而非因果；82.6%考核产生碎片化，60.2%出现完整"先碎片后收敛"(FFCL)周期；3阶段分析显示结构碎片化为主导长期轨迹（90.9%课程），受课程结构调节。

Conclusion: $β_0$是参与敏感的结构性指标，对AI增强学习分析设计具有直接启示。

Abstract: Asynchronous online learning offers temporal flexibility at a structural cost: learning communities tend to fragment rather than cohere. $β_0$, the number of disconnected behavioral clusters from Zigzag Persistent Homology, serves as a cohort-level indicator of this structure. Two questions remained unverified at scale: (1) does apparent $β_0$ convergence reflect genuine behavioral alignment or learner dropout? and (2) do assessment deadlines produce reproducible fragmentation-convergence cycles? We address both across all 22 OULAD courses (N > 22,000; 857 week-pairs). Changes in $β_0$ strongly co-vary with active learner changes (pooled r = 0.387; median per-course r_delta = 0.459, 20/22 courses), identifying $β_0$ as a participation-sensitive indicator: $β_0$ and active learner counts co-respond to deadline events rather than one causing the other. Deadlines produced fragmentation in 82.6% of assessments and the full Fragment First, Converge Later (FFCL) cycle in 60.2%. 3-phase analysis confirmed structural fragmentation as the dominant long-term trajectory (90.9% of courses), moderated by curriculum structure. These findings establish $β_0$ as a participation-sensitive structural indicator with direct implications for AI-augmented learning analytics design.

</details>


### [666] [Designing for Interpretation Uncertainty: Architecture and Principles for Topological Learning Analytics Dashboards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01749)
*Hitoshi Inoue,Koichi Yasutake*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文开发了TopoLA仪表盘系统，将Zigzag持续同调应用于学习管理系统数据，并提出三条面向新兴分析方法解释支持的设计原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TDA在复杂系统时序动态分析中很有前景，但在信息系统设计中面临核心挑战：当解释框架尚未成熟时，系统应如何呈现分析结果。此问题随新计算技术进入应用领域而愈发普遍。

Method: 开发TopoLA仪表盘，对学习管理系统数据应用Zigzag持续同调；采用模块化三阶段流水线（特征提取、拓扑计算、解释支持），并提出三条设计原则：客观测量与情境解释分离、从指标到模式再到反思提示的渐进披露、明确承认方法不确定性。

Result: 系统实现了三阶段流水线并支持扩展至其他分析方法，同时产出三条早期设计原则作为初步设计知识。

Conclusion: 本文为信息系统研究贡献了针对"缺乏既定解释规范的分析方法"的初步设计知识，回应了新计算技术进入应用领域时普遍面临的沟通与解释挑战。

Abstract: Topological Data Analysis (TDA) offers novel methods for understanding temporal dynamics in complex systems, yet its application in information systems design faces a fundamental challenge: how should systems present analytical outputs when interpretation frameworks are still developing? This paper reports on the development of TopoLA, a dashboard system applying Zigzag Persistent Homology to learning management system data, and proposes three early design principles for interpretation support in emerging analytics: (1) separation of objective measurement from contextual interpretation, (2) graduated disclosure from metrics through patterns to reflective prompts, and (3) explicit acknowledgment of methodological uncertainty. The system implements a modular three-stage pipeline--feature extraction, topological computation, and interpretation support--enabling extension to additional analytical methods. This work contributes to information systems research by articulating preliminary design knowledge for systems that must communicate analytical insights from methods lacking established interpretation norms--a challenge increasingly common as novel computational techniques enter applied domains.

</details>
